row.name: Thieves' Paradise
row.detailed_description: ABOUT THE GAME: 'Thieves’ Paradise' is a stealth-action heist game with a narrative-driven aspect. Players choose one of three storylines to participate in, stealing target items throughout an over-the-top shopping complex called Shopper's Paradise, at the behest of their chosen character or characters. Performance and player choices during the heists will alter NPC dialogue, and dialogue options can equally affect the heists. WELCOME TO SHOPPER'S PARADISE! In 'Thieves' Paradise', players will take control of the Thief, a poorly disguised man who has but one goal: break into Shopper's Paradise and steal what he needs. Shopper's Paradise is an elaborate mall-like shopping center filled with many different stores and 3 distinctly themed areas, each with their own lovable mascot! - Come listen to the gnarly tunes of Kevin the Lobster over in the Miami Vice area! - Let your kids come check out Sunset Sam the Gila Monster's play-pen and train ride over in the toy store by the Wild West area! - While the kids are gone, come relax near Tanuki Jones' Zen Garden in the Tokyo streets area! Each shop is designed from the ground up and filled with original props to create a world worth exploring for the player. Many shops will contain gadgets and tools for the player to use during their heists, which can be used as distractions or ways to trip pursuers. A STORY-DRIVEN NARRATIVE FILLED WITH MEMORABLE CHARACTERS! The narrative in 'Thieves' Paradise' is presented in a visual novel style. where the player will speak to one of three characters depending on the story they are presently on. The player's choices in the story matter, as it gives them a voice and can lead to different story paths depending on how the player chooses their dialogue. The player will explore three different stories, each filled with 3 different heists, as they learn more about the characters they interact with and just what kind of thief they really are. Each story focuses on a single main character besides the Thief, each with their own motives for requesting the Thief's talents. The narrative doesn't just stop after the cutscene ends! In addition to the visual novel segments 'Thieves' Paradise', the gameplay sections contain Radio Messages, which feature a character speaking directly to the Thief during their heists. The dialogue can range from help/advice as it serves as a tutorial for newer players, or it can just funny dialogue to endear some characters to the player and give the feeling that you have someone watching over your heists. YOUR HEISTS, YOUR RULES! The Thief will enter the Shopper's Paradise with a single goal: steal what they need. And it is up to the player to decide just how to go about accomplishing this. The player can choose to stealthily move through the level without getting caught by any of the guards or security cams, or they can go sprint through the level tripping up every guard they come across as they grab what they need and run out before they can get caught. Through reading the visual novel sections, the player will have an understanding of the main item they need to steal, as well as some side objectives that may appear. What the player decides to steal on some levels may actually affect the story based on their efforts! Each story contains multiple different endings the player can achieve through their choices both in narrative and in heists. CREDITS: Producer: Kevin Davis Creative Director: Temprian Zaliasukas Design: William Beatty, Emily Woods, Alec Nicholson, Matthew DeMeo Art: Charles Price, Kyle Remy, Steven Chikuji, Jacob Young Code: Patrick Wilshere, Shaquille Griffin, Nicholas Martin, Joseph Demeritt An original soundtrack by: Gin Zaliasukas & Logan Labanna
row.short_description: Welcome to Shopper's Paradise! Thieves' Paradise is a stealth action game where you will break into the capitalistic wonderland known as Shopper's Paradise in order to steal what you need. Explore 3 different storylines and 9 individually designed heists!

row.name: One-armed cook
row.detailed_description: Experience the challenge of cooking, but now with only one arm! Grab a friend and you'll have two arms in total. One-armed cook is a chaotic co-op cooking game for up to 4 people. Work as a team or cook on your own, set your own pace, and don't let the stress of a full restaurant catch up to you. The goofy physics-based aspect of the game gives one-armed cook a new twist. Take orders from customers With many different dishes for the customers to order you will never run out of something to do. Prepare and cook your food Simple and intuitive recipes make the experience much more fluent But should you ever be in doubt, you can always check the recipe book Mess around . have fun with friends and create chaos with the physics
row.short_description: One-armed cook is a chaotic co-op cooking game for up to 4 people. Work as a team or cook on your own, set your own pace, and don't let the stress of a full restaurant catch up to you. The goofy physics-based aspect of the game gives this cooking game a new twist.

row.name: Endless Bullet Heaven
row.detailed_description: Endless bullets! In this game, you move using just the mouse to avoid any and all projectiles that come your way. After a few seconds of surviving the bullet pattern, a target will appear. Either wait out the attack timer or click the target to advance to a new, randomly selected bullet pattern! Survive as long as you can, beat bosses, secure helpful meta-progression upgrades, and ascend back to the Heavens to reclaim your home! Featuring: A main story with a roster of unique and charming characters! 54 unique bullet patterns (which can then be given additional modifiers!) 6 challenging bosses to conquer! A practice mode to hone your skills! Meta-progression that unlocks new mechanics: including weapons, special attacks, and more! 77 achievements to collect! Other fun stuff! (Secrets, MTX-free cosmetics, etc.)
row.short_description: In this endless bullet avoidance game, you join the fallen angel named Brace in her fight to reach the heavens in which she once resided!

row.name: Skylost
row.detailed_description: On a rescue mission, brave the mysteries of Spire, a series of beautiful, floating islands to which none yet have dared to travel. Armed only with your wits, limited supplies, and the items you discover during your journey, traverse the exhilarating verticality of this sky world. Craft, climb and glide your way past the Spire’s dangerous beasts and find your missing love, Amelia and save her from her fate! Uncover Secrets: What has become of Amelia? What is the origin of the mysterious glowing red light? Discover the secrets behind these mysteries of the spire. Exploration Emphasized: Explore this strange and wonderful world, to discover new materials, dangerous beasts, and exciting inventions! Crafting Creativity: Craft new and exciting items to help you on your journey and overcome the obstacles you face however you want to; from a Noisemaker to distract or a stealth field to hide. Exciting Traversal: Throw your grappling hook to climb to dizzying heights and soar high over the world with the glider. Traverse the floating islands of Spire in whatever way you see fit.
row.short_description: Skylost is a 3D exploration and crafting game where you climb and glide your way through dangerous floating islands in search of your lost love Amelia.

row.name: 一代掌门
row.detailed_description: 《一代掌门》是一款大型多人同服经营模拟类游戏，您将扮演一位没落的掌门人，当意识到自己的身世后，展开自己重建门派之旅，您将通过招揽各种能人异士为您打造神兵利器，贩卖给武林中人赚取大量金钱，通过招募武侠中的各路豪侠为您开疆扩土，奠定武林地位，在华丽的3D武侠世界中，逐步成为武林至尊！ 游戏特色： 1、装备打造：抡起大锤，在熊熊烈火中敲打每一块待锤炼的好钢，锻造者的汗水低落在铁器之上，融入了汗水与热能的钢铁，在一阵柔水的滋润下，退去燥热与沉渣，一件巧夺天工的神兵横空出世！亲手打造的兵器，咱们用得乘手、用得放心！ 2、集市自由交易：海纳天下宝物的交易所，可以让你买到任何东西，你也可以在交易所上架各种道具、装备、材料，来自世界各地的掌门都汇聚在这里，拿着真金白银，购买自己心仪的物品，更有不少掌门将自己意外收获的神秘至宝放在交易所出售，一笔订单赚得盆满钵满。在这真实无套路的交易所，一定会是你发家致富的好地方！ 3、门派经营：曾经闻名武林的门派，如今却是如此残破不堪，身为前掌门的继承人，岂能看着门派就此衰败！你将在长老辅佐下，率领门派内弟子，重建各类设施，施展你的经营策略，恢复门派运转，开展装备打造、丹药炼制、招纳贤才等各种经营事项，并在往来的客人中结交武林各派，提升门派威望，逐渐壮大起来！ 4、江湖秘闻录：江湖中，汇聚了各类奇人异事，因此总会流传着各种神秘的传闻。一件名为“江湖秘闻录”的宝鉴，将每件神秘传闻背后的挑战任务记录下来，若是将其悉数完成，就能得到最后的神秘宝藏，在无尽的挑战中，觉醒更强大的自己吧！ 5、武林：游侠名士、强盗劫匪、奇珍异兽......都在这偌大的武林之中。作为一代掌门，你需要在武林中完成各门派的委托与挑战，展现出你那傲人的实力，让对方都拜服在你面前，除此之外，武林中还埋藏着各种宝物等你去发现，你需要善于发现一些细节，哪怕是一个普通的无名小卒，也不要忽视他的存在，也许他正好知道宝藏的线索，但要怎么才能问出来，就看掌门你的本事了！ 6、特色战斗：武侠神功，经典再现！玉女心经、降龙十八掌、金蛇剑法......各派奇侠的秘传神功，在这里都可以学到。战斗中，合理搭配神功的施展顺序，面对强敌也能轻松拿捏。在武林的各个门派都藏有神功秘籍，请将它们尽数收于囊下，无论是自己使用还是赠予门派弟子，都是不错的选择！ 7、势力：武林被分割为四大势力，不仅拥有最强的实力，更有着名震五湖四海的威望，完成他们发布的任务，可有效提升门派的名望。除此之外，还有这极具挑战性的大型副本——【势力秘境】吸引着无数强者前来挑战，当你积累到足够的名望之后，就能开启【势力宝库】兑换各种稀世珍宝！
row.short_description: 大型多人同服经营模拟类游戏

row.name: GunBoxing
row.detailed_description: A FPS WITH FIGHTING GAME MECHANICS Use classic fighting game mechanics like parries, ducking and sidestepping attacks, melee combos/air juggles, meter for super attacks, etc. in a first person shooter game mode, combining precise long range combat of shooting games with crazy close range combat of fighting games. ITS ALL ABOUT THE METER Your meter gets filled when you deal damage, gets kills, etc. Once your meter is full you win but that's not all. You can use your meter to unleash powerful moves, if the moves land you get overwhelming advantage but if they miss you waste your meter. Its all about that meter. RAGE Low on health? Your opponent would be more worried than you because a player on low health gains access to rage, making that player a much bigger threat on low health. In rage, you become fast, small and explosive so taking out your opponent is a piece of cake. ONLINE AND OFFLINE MULTIPLAYER You can play online with up to 8 players and offline with splitscreen for 2 players.
row.short_description: GunBoxing is a free-to-play, fast-paced multiplayer shooter with a heavy focus on fighting game mechanics like melee combos/air juggles, parries, ducking and sidestepping attacks to punish, meter for super attacks, etc. combining long range shooting combat with crazy close range melee combat.

row.name: Loskop
row.detailed_description: Loskop is a single-player puzzle game where you are the only one to blame in the end if Loskop the Junkbot never gets to see the outside world. You are being put behind the wheel of the robot and will maybe through what is considered mostly luck and grain of determination guide the robot through the old factory and to the outside world. The obstacles you will find on the way will challenge your previously gained experience from other games and most likely give you a headache or some grey hairs. Experience a different type of puzzle solving that you arent used to. By introducing the concept of second person puzzle solving you will meet and have to interact with puzzels that you cant solve from refrencing older games. Complete levels one by one in a linear structure.
row.short_description: Experience a new type of puzzle-solving in this new linear second and first person puzzle solving game. Control the little robot also known as Loskop and help him escape his old factory and out into the wild.

row.name: Rival Rides
row.detailed_description: Rival Rides is an exciting multiplayer VR party game taking place in an out-of-this-world theme park. Compete with your friends online in various games and wild rides, in order to collect the highest amount of golden egg trophies and become the Rival Ride’s champion! Discover 4 fun action-packed games offering different challenges and clever uses for your VR headset. Race through a wild underground cart-ride while you switch your own or your rivals' routes. Fight against evil monsters with various weapons in a fast and scary haunted house ride. Jetpack your way through zero-gravity while shooting lasers at each other, or just try not to burn everything when you cook yummy meals for the theme park’s very hungry guests. Don’t forget to customize your appearance, and choose from a variety of awesome and hilarious outfits to outshine your rivals. So, what are you waiting for? Hop on in and join the ride! Race against the clock as you cook some yummy dishes for the very hungry park visitors, while trying to slow down your rivals in the wackiest and most hilarious ways. Let the food fight begin! Did you know? All the ingredients we use in our tasty dishes are imported from “Foodland”, where life is like an endless All-you-can-eat buffet, but the residents somehow always stay in shape. It’s a mystery! Race through an underground railroad and switch railways while picking up various weapons and diamonds with unique abilities! This exciting ride is inspired by the muddy “Earthland” where everybody lives deep underground. Did you know? Our hard-working “Rival Rides” employees mined each one of the “Earthland” diamonds themselves! Try to survive this scary ride! Shield yourself using your cart’s blue button, or push the red one to draw a random weapon and bust these paranormal beings. This haunted ride is inspired by the infamous “Monsterland”, where demons, ghouls, and ghosts all manage to get along with each other in perfect disharmony. Be careful! While officially the monsters in this ride are our employees, they do tend to take their job way too seriously sometimes. Use your jetpack to float through space and shoot lasers at your rivals. But try not to hit the hovering rocks because some of them might bounce your lasers right back at you! Inspired by the faraway “Cosmicland” where there’s no gravity, asteroids are everywhere, and the word oxygen has no meaning. Did you know? Our giant turtle is equipped with huge rockets that allow it to make its way all the way up to space and back.
row.short_description: Rival Rides - the ultimate VR PARTY game! Compete, laugh, and mess with your friends in a 4-player online setting.Uncover ridiculously fun games. Who will dominate the competition? Strap on your VR headset, hop on your ride, and dive into a world of hilarity and excitement. Ready, set, ride!

row.name: Cyphers Game VR
row.detailed_description: DISCOVER THE DEEPEST MYSTERIES OF ESPIONAGE AND FEEL THE RUSH OF VICTORY IN VIRTUAL REALITY Take the role of soldiers, cryptologists, and communication experts during the Polish-Bolshevik War of 1920! Operate historical communication devices, decode enemy ciphers, and gain access to secret information that shaped the outcome of the war. Discover the inner workings of Bolshevik armored trains and participate in crucial missions that led to Poland’s victory. Every aspect of the game has been meticulously crafted with the help of source materials or accurately replicated from historical exhibits. Players engage in documented historical events, with each character assigned a unique, vital role in determining the battle’s outcome. Now you can experience it in Virtual Reality! Key Features: A captivating story inspired by real events and featuring authentic Polish cryptographers and soldiers from the Polish-Bolshevik War Elements of stealth, cryptographic puzzles, and interaction with historical communication devices Attention to historical detail, with all devices and elements in the game carefully recreated from source materials and historical artifacts Gameplay that blends action, puzzle-solving, and exploration, offering a unique combination of education and entertainment in Virtual Reality
row.short_description: It is the end of 1920. The Polish-Bolshevik war has been going on for almost two years. The battle for Korosteń – a key railway junction and technical supply base – is underway. Break Bolshevik cyphers, ensure radio communication, and neutralise the fearsome armoured trains - now in Virtual Reality.

row.name: Mayonnaise Simulator
row.detailed_description: You play as a jar of mayonnaise who has to launch mayo at some bottles before they get to you. You will have to jump around to avoid them as they approach because if they touch you too many times, you lose. Stay on the shelf and stay alive. Game includes third person shooting Minor 'platforming' Jumping jar of mayonnaise Aggressive condiments (ketchup, mustard, relish, and bbq sauce) Mayo splat sound
row.short_description: Third person shooter with minor platforming. You have to eliminate the condiment threat.
row.reviews: “i put it together and its awesome” 10/10 – Nuke “It's a demo reel of what computer graphics are capable of in the year 1993” 5/10 – My friend

row.name: AQtion
row.detailed_description: Lights, Camera, ACTION! Experience the adrenaline-fueled intensity of classic first-person shooter action with AQtion, the ultimate evolution of the beloved mod, Action Quake 2. AQtion combines the latest engine enhancements with the signature gameplay mechanics and updates from the Action Quake community, delivering a nostalgic yet revitalized gaming experience. Engage in fast-paced, skill-based combat where every move counts. With realistic weapon handling, limited ammunition, and a focus on tactical gameplay, AQtion tests your reflexes and strategic thinking like never before. Master the art of precision shooting, maneuver through dynamic environments, and outsmart your opponents in heart-pounding battles that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Featuring regularly updated game modes and features, engine enhancements and an active pickup game community, AQtion brings the classic Action Quake 2 experience into the modern era. Jump into the action and unleash your skills in intense multiplayer matches or thrilling single-player challenges. If you're an old school veteran to first person shooters, this is the Action Quake 2 you remember, with the original charm and modern enhancements you would come to expect. If you're new to the scene, welcome to what classic first person shooters are all about!
row.short_description: Get ready for intense, skill-based FPS action with AQtion! Featuring the best of Action Quake 2, enjoy fast-paced combat, realistic weapons, and thrilling multiplayer battles. Dominate the arena now on Steam!
row.reviews: “Action Quake 2 had a huge amount of influence over a series that has been an industry powerhouse for over 20 years now.” Fat Studios “While a standalone release for a nearly 30-year-old Quake mod may seem random, it’s just the latest development in the game’s vibrant mod scene.” PCGamesN “Yeah, no other game has come close to it in terms of delivering the full package.” Rock Paper Shotgun
row.notes: Gunshot related violence with blood, headshots, bodies turning into giblets

row.name: GoRogue
row.detailed_description: Gorogue First person & third person shooter with multi player support via epic games, single play mode is also supported. Based on Unreal Engine Lyra Sample Game modified to include first person mode in 'Last Standing' and 'Firing Range', also SciFi map and City Map with option to change character in the main menu. Extra weapons (rocket launcher etc). Free to play with multiple game modes including quick play mode, host a match and search for a hosted match online. The game modes include elimination mode where the objective is to find an eliminate enough enemies. A second game mode is included where the object is to secure the control points with your team mates in order to increase your score and win. Also included is capture the flag and last player standing . Copyright 2021 – 2022, Dromosys All rights reserved. GoRogue uses Unreal® Engine. Unreal® is a trademark or registered trademark of Epic Games, Inc. in the United States of America and elsewhere. Discord:
row.short_description: GoRogue is Third person shooter with multiplayer support.

row.name: Dissent
row.detailed_description: About the Game Dissent started as a game jam and acts as a quick introduction to characters, setting, and the secrecy surrounding them. With three possible endings, discover friends, reveal enemies, and provoke the inevitable aftermath found in the award winning sequel: Coalescence. The Sequel Want to know what happens next? Expand your story with Coalescence! Key Features Explore a story driven world. Enter the corporate office space of Moniker, where you will meet fascinating characters that drive story rich elements throughout the game. One of the many characters you will encounter at Moniker. Gather Evidence. Encounter unique objects and obscurities while you sneak around the grounds. Perhaps some of these will assist in your adventure! Choices like these will affect your story. Uncover Mysteries. While interacting with these story rich characters, uncover the mystery of what Moniker is doing throughout the world. Could this be what Moniker has under wraps?
row.short_description: A visual novel with mild choice-based progression. In this prologue story, follow an inquisitve college student into the depths of deceptive corporate lab: Moniker Innovation. Begin to unravel a mystery larger than the young journalist looking for answers and even this game itself.

row.name: Coalescence
row.detailed_description: About the Game Coalescence is a visual novel that invites you into a corrupted facility known as Moniker Labs for a night of festivities, romance, and terror! Key Features As you explore Moniker's halls, you'll meet several people who have all been affected by the corporation in some capacity. These unique individuals come from a variety of backgrounds and express themselves in distinctive ways. This makes your dialogue choices very important if you want them to trust you, reveal secrets, help you in your endeavors, or depending on what you find most important; flirt! Play as one of three characters, each with their own backstory, motivation for investigating, and special abilities to use in dialogue. Playable Characters A cunning reporter who will stop at nothing to uncover the truth behind Moniker. With their strong experience in investigative reporting, the Journalist can use the Investigate ability to ask insightful questions that gives more information on the current subject. A private investigator who’s been pulled into a bigger case than they ever could’ve realized. From their many years on the force, the Detective , a now free agent gone rogue is able to use Deduction to pick up on small details that help get a better picture of the situation. A scientist who’s been forced into the Moniker conspiracy due to an incident on the job at the very facility under investigation. With their newfound ability, [REDACTED] , the Lab Tech aims to stop Moniker’s plot by any means necessary! Additional Content Enjoy Coalescence? Try Dissent! The product of a game jam that lead to the creation of this award winning release! Expand the story with the prologue game that built a foundation for our development team to iterate and evolve.
row.short_description: Coalescence is a visual novel that takes you deep within Moniker Labs to explore its secrets. Play as one of three characters, each with their own storyline and dialogue options. Form relationships with the companions you encounter and try to make it out alive!

row.name: Hyperland
row.detailed_description: A multiplayer game with one Boss player and multiple tiny players. Boss players dodge the attacks of players and attack using their throwing items, grenade launcher, hammers, etc., and tiny players perform cooperative play to attack huge Boss players. tiny players' means of attack consist of regular bombs and explosive bombs, and chemical bombs that temporarily blind the opponent. An electronic bomb that temporarily limits an opponent's movement, a painkiller bomb that removes all restrictions and restores energy. The basic map terrain of the game is in the form of a cube, and in the future, we plan to allow users to create and distribute custom maps and to play the game in more diverse backgrounds. Languague: English Feature: [*Multiplayer action game for cooperation and resolution between Boss and tiny users (1 vs7). Adopt simple game execution and play methods. A game that all family members can play.
row.short_description: Pick up, fire and dodge the bombs! An action-packed multiplayer casual shooter with basic moves but still easy to play.

row.name: 7Groves
row.detailed_description: There's no rush. Just take a leisurely stroll through beautiful and surreal forests that look like paintings come alive. 7Groves is a relaxing game of exploration and walking simulator. You can take your time exploring the game's strange worlds. Along the way, you'll collect items and complete puzzles to explore the furthest reaches of the game and experience all seven dream-like worlds. 7Groves is a labour of love and started life as a graphics demo that was meant to have 3d worlds look like 2d paintings. I've had a lot of comments that the game looks like it has been AI generated, but it is not. The painterly effects are achieved with loads of deferred lights, the creative use of textures as well as tons of post processing, including real-time Kuwahara filters. I hope you enjoy wandering about these pretty -entirely human generated- forests as much as I enjoyed making them! - Explore 7 strange worlds - Enjoy beautiful 3d graphics that look like impressionistic paintings that have come alive - Collect and puzzle to unlock all areas of the game - Listen to gorgeous choral soundtracks tailored to the game's environments
row.short_description: A game in which you explore surreal and beautiful forests.

row.name: FreedroidRPG
row.detailed_description: FreedroidRPG is an open source role playing game. The game tells the story of a world destroyed by a conflict between robots and their human masters. Play as Tux in a quest to save the world from the murderous rebel bots who know no mercy. You get to choose which path you wish to follow, and freedom of choice is everywhere in the game. FreedroidRPG features a real time combat system with melee and ranged weapons, fairly similar to the proprietary game Diablo. There is an innovative system of programs that can be run in order to take control of enemy robots, alter their behavior, or improve one's characteristics. You can use over 50 different kinds of items and fight countless enemies on your way to your destiny. An advanced dialog system provides story background and immersive role playing situations. The game is complete, fully playable, and can provide about 12 hours of fun. While release 1.0 is stable, it is still being actively developed, and help is welcome in many areas. People having - or trying to acquire - programming, map editing, or writing skills will find FreedroidRPG to be an exciting, fast-moving project in which they can fully express their creativity.
row.short_description: FreedroidRPG is an open source sci-fi role playing game, where the player fights against hordes of bots in order to free humanity from rebel bots whom know no mercy.
row.reviews: “FreeDroid RPG is one of those rare free games that really is fun and interesting to play. The storyline is pretty decent, and the little jabs at “MegaSys” will really give you a chuckle every now and then throughout the game.” Make Use Of

row.name: Two Colours
row.detailed_description: Two Colours is a simple platformer with three, core concepts: you have to keep moving, you have to stay patient, and you can't lose your focus. Combining the traditional elements of a platformer with the idea of certain platforms ping-ponging from being safe to stand on to being dangerous to stand on, Two Colours features 20 basic levels, 20 advanced levels, 20 keys to collect, and a secret to unlock at the end of the game. As additional features unlock over the course of the game, making the game increase in difficulty as you progress, you must keep your focus. You primarily have two seconds to get onto and to get off of the red and blue platforms as they bounce back and forth from being platforms which you can stand on, and platforms which will kill you, as you try to reach the golden blocks to beat the level. Don't lose your focus, don't lose your patience. Rushing is a sure-fire way to death and frustration.
row.short_description: Jump from platform to platform, red to blue, blue to red, timing your jumps precisely, and dodging falls and blocks which kill you over the course of 40 levels, grabbing the 20 collectibles to unlock a secret at the end of the game. Don't lose your focus, don't lose your patience.

row.name: Ultra Sweeper
row.detailed_description: Explore a Minesweeper-style game with a twist, featuring four game modes: Normal, Honeycomb, Pentagon, and Triangular. Each mode offers a different layout, from traditional square grids to complex triangular and polygonal patterns, challenging players to adapt their strategies and uncover hidden mines. Whether you're an experienced player or new to Minesweeper, these diverse modes provide engaging gameplay for all skill levels.
row.short_description: Minesweeper puzzle game with multiple game modes

row.name: BEWBEWBEW
row.detailed_description: BEWBEWBEW is a lovingly crafted, unique, and colorful action-arcade game! Completely original fighting system! Charge spawns before releasing them in one big wave. Fights are all about optimizing your move usage to hit as many spawns as possible. A ton of playable characters and abilities! 50+ characters, each with their own set of abilities from a pool of 150+ unique moves of different types, elements, and usage. No two characters play the exact same! Partake in intense 1-vs-1 and whole party fights! Each side can have up to 3 party members. Hectically switching between your party members to burn through all your Energy and cooldowns is key! Hand-drawn graphics! Nearly every sprite and background in this game was drawn on paper first before being digitally colored, all done to make the art pop out. Combine different attacks for devastating effects! Set embers ablaze to start a fire! Place down a lightning rod before using a shock attack to do massive damage! Plant seeds and grow spiky roses! Play through 70+ fun levels, including a challenging Adventure mode! Some levels have unique twists and conditions. Be ready for anything! Endless Classic mode! Unlock characters and play through an endless gauntlet of levels as your power up your party!
row.short_description: BEWBEWBEW is a lovingly crafted, unique, and colorful action-arcade game!

row.name: Rounds of Zombies
row.detailed_description: free to play recreation of the original zombies survival. the more rounds you survive, the harder the game will get. Buy doors to unlock sections of the map. Buy guns off the wall to defend yourself against the waves of zombies. Get a random gun out of the Lucky Shot. Upgrade your gun at the Exalter. Buy upgrades from the booster machines located around the maps. Features: Online co-op, Versus, and Singleplayer Global leaderboards 4 Maps Multiple types of zombies Upgrades to your player and guns leveling system and player skins i am aware that there are problems with multiplayer. i have not been able to fix them, i apologize.
row.short_description: Classic zombie round survival. choose a map and see how many rounds you can survive with friends or alone.

row.name: Outpost Defender 2-Beta
row.detailed_description: The Space-Outpost is under assault! You must defend it. Fight off infinite waves of alien invaders. Survive as long as possible. A retro/arcade pixel-art outbreak challenge to set the highest score! Single-player and Local Co-Op enabled. Use stackable powerups to increase your abilities. Use Challenge Mode to design your own creative enemy waves!
row.short_description: The Space-Outpost is under assault! You must defend it. Fight off infinite waves of alien invaders. Survive as long as possible. A retro/arcade pixel-art outbreak challenge to set the highest score! Single-player and Local Co-Op enabled.

row.name: WordWar
row.detailed_description: What is it? WordWar is a couch multiplayer game from 1 to 4 players. Its particular aspect is that it combines word game goals with chaotic couch game dynamics. In fact, the players have to fight for the letters scattered in the Arena in order to build words and score points What it looks like? In WordWar you will chase the opponents to steal the letters they have and try to carry them on your team's base. A big part of the game is based on throwing the letters around, to your teammate (pass) or to your opponents (hit) - this last part is the funniest one😂 You can write any word with 2 or 3 letters, so be creative!
row.short_description: Word War is a unique party game based on making words. Fight for the letters in the Arena and try to create words with them in order to score points.

row.name: Equinox
row.detailed_description: Equinox is a free-to-play, fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter. Equinox mixes advanced movement techniques and projectile-based combat, producing a high-skill combat system. The game's objective is to capture the enemy's flag with adjustable team size, max score and match time. Developed initially as a school project using Unreal Engine with a group of programmers and artists, the game evolved into something more. Key Features Objective-Based Gameplay The objective of both teams in Equinox is to capture the enemy's flag. The opponent's flag is located in the opponent's base. The flag can also not be scored if both are currently being carried. Physics-Based Weapons The weapons that the player can utilize in Equinox resemble dodgeballs. Once thrown, the dodgeballs will bounce around corners and if travelling slow enough, can be picked up. Various Weapon Types There are three types of dodgeballs in Equinox. First, there is the standard dodgeball which the player always has access to. This dodgeball deals a flat amount of damage. Special dodgeballs spawn around the map at critical locations. The special dodgeballs include fireballs, which deal damage over time, and iceballs slow the target for a duration. Abilities There are three abilities that the player can utilize throughout the match. The first ability is a ball repulsor, which protects the player from any dodgeballs for a duration. The second ability is a dash, which allows the player to move quickly in a desired direction. The third ability is a strafe, which enables the player to gain momentum and direct their air movement. Online Play The game can be played online with 2 to 8 friends via lobby hosting. When hosting a lobby, the host can define the team size, max score and match time. The game also utilizes VOIP, with a proximity voice chat system to communicate with other users.
row.short_description: Equinox is a free-to-play, fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter. Equinox mixes advanced movement techniques and projectile-based combat, producing a high-skill combat system. The game's objective is to capture the enemy's flag with adjustable team size, max score and match time.

row.name: Shadow Racer
row.detailed_description: Shadow Racer is a third-person driving adventure game where the player controls the Shadow Rider, a car built by the resistance able to eliminate the darkness of the empire. In a post-apocalyptic future, the world has been corrupted by the darkness. The only place in the world that remains free from the control of the dark empire is The Grand Canyon. Master the four-car elements: Drifting! Flashing! Boosting! Bumping! Save the valley by exploring a cursed world, filled with battles, secrets, amazing characters, and exciting racing challenges against the best racers in the land. Will you be worthy of being the new shadow racer? Racing mechanics mixed with exciting combat A world full of secrets to uncover Scenic landscapes Languages: English, Spanish, Basque This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Master the four car elements and save the valley by exploring a cursed world, filled with battles, secrets, amazing characters, and exciting racing challenges against the best racers of the land. Will you be worthy of being the new shadow racer?

row.name: Hitstun
row.detailed_description: Hitstun is a turn based fighting game. Play cards in your hand to move and attack. Win the game by reducing your opponent's health points to zero. Chain your Attack cards in a combo to show off your skills and deal more damage. Whether you like to play neutral, rush down, or zoning, express your playstyle with Movement cards. Choose between 8 different characters with all unique card lists.
row.short_description: Hitstun is a turn based fighting game with online matchmaking. Challenge your friends to an exciting battle with diverse characters and movesets.

row.name: Static of Eve –凝滯聖夜–
row.detailed_description: 「時間，彷彿永遠停在了那個夜晚」 《凝滯聖夜》是一款2D橫向捲軸的解謎遊戲，扮演溫特在宅邸遇到各種事件並解開謎題，還原故事的全部真相。 ◆◆◆◆◆ 12月24號，聖誕夜的早晨，窗外的世界充滿了節慶的氣息，但偵探溫特的事務所裡只有一位正在打掃的偵探與他閒到發慌正在大鬧的助手夏洛特。 整理事務所的過程中，他們無意間發現了一張老剪報─「名工匠□□□□一家失蹤」，在夏洛特的強力要求之下，兩人前往了案發的宅邸。 遊戲特色 ◆ 如同現實的密室逃脫遊戲般，更有挑戰性的解謎思維 ◆ 利用放大鏡功能仔細觀察地圖每一處，尋找關鍵線索與道具 ◆ 精心安排的劇情演出，讓玩家與角色呼吸同樣的空氣 ◆ 豐富的有趣小互動 ※像個偵探一樣用放大鏡仔細觀察！ ※仔細思考！將解謎的線索通通串起來 ※來自過去幻影，這家人究竟發生了什麼？
row.short_description: 扮演偵探溫特前往多年前發生案件的宅邸，遭遇各種事件並解開謎題，還原故事的全部真相。

row.name: Interitus
row.detailed_description: ABOUT THIS GAME: Travel to the Hidden Monastery to the East In Interitus you play as a young elf, Liara, plagued by a soul-corrupting curse who must travel to a long-forgotten monastery located far behind the vast forests of the world of Nai'ru. You must fight through countless enemies and ensure your survival through the maze-like corridors of the monastery while searching for keys to open doors and progress further into the darkness. Defeat the boss and find the cure to your curse and unveil the secrets of the environment to complete the game. Interitus is a dark and atmospheric Souls-like with Roguelite-elements, realistic 3D graphics and a grotesque, medieval-styled environment. Slash your way through monsters with satisfying combat moves and find your way through the ever-changing dungeon, that is built different with every playthrough. BEAUTIFUL VISUALS: Immerse yourself with enchanting visuals, stunning 2d-cutscenes and a dazzling beastiary!
row.short_description: Embark on a dangerous journey to a monastery where only death and decay remain. Explore the cursed hellscape and fight against challenging monsters in a realistic 3D-environment. Each play-session is unique from the previous one thanks to a randomized dungeon, with handcrafted rooms.
row.notes: Interitus contains fantasy gore, blood, violence and religious elements.

row.name: MewMew - PewPew
row.detailed_description: Key Features: • Lots of Shooting • Endless Waves of Enemies • Items and Powerups • Combo Counter • Highscores MewMew – PewPew is an endless wave arena shooter where you play as MewMew, whose home gets invaded by dinosaurs from alternative reality. Your goal is to survive for as long as you can, while trying to break the highscores. To gain the maximum score, stay in combat and kill the enemies to increase your combo counter, which directly affects your score gained. Get hit or stay out of combat for too long and your combo will decrease. In short, kill everything that moves until the inevitable death reaches you.
row.short_description: Dinosaurs have invaded MewMew’s home and now it's time for him to pick up his trusty old meteor gun and send them right back to extinction. Keep your combo as high as possible and get stronger with items and powerups as you try to gain highscores in this chaotic 2D horde shooter.

row.name: Cosmic Purge
row.detailed_description: Key features - Single player - Action FPS - Cosmic Horror, Dark Fantasy - Game has 3D stylized art - Lots of shooting enemies - Power Punch has a cooldown and it heals - 4 levels, yard and mansion three floors - Checkpoints Gameplay In this FPS the player moves through unique environments killing enemies, while trying to destroy Spawners from which they emerge. Different weapons are used to kill enemies and enemies drop ammo for the player. Ammo drops are randomized. Player is goal is to reach the top floor to kill the boss of the game. Story The bounty hunter Cassius has an arsenal of weapons and has been sent on a mission to purge the corruption from a mansion in this cosmic horror inspired FPS game. In an alternative universe a cosmic creature from vast space appeared before humanity. This being granted its power to mankind, and quickly became a god to them. What we knew as the industrial revolution came to be known as the golden era. Unfortunately their god wasn't so benevolent. After 200 hundred years, corruption started to spread and consume every living thing on its path. In this new age humanity, now on the brink of extinction, formed a new organization to fight back against this plaque of destruction.
row.short_description: In this apocalyptic world a cosmic being has taken over Earth and spread its corruption all over. Join the bounty hunter Cassius on his mission to destroy the corruption from the mansion in this FPS game. Be warned, grotesque monsters are hell-bent on stopping Cassius from reaching his goal.
row.notes: Blood shoots out of the enemies, uncomfortable environment, strong language and violence.

row.name: Watercolor Hell
row.detailed_description: Watercolor Hell is a wave survival bullet hell focused on evolving base weapons each run. Customize a base wand into a large fire blast that knocks back enemies or a defensive ice razor that shoots down projectiles. Evolve base weapons with meaningful choices that change your run's playstyle. After each run buy upgrades and change your starting weapon. Each time you fully complete a Chapter, your character unlocks new weapons, permanent stacking damage, and other stat bonuses. 33 level upgrade choices to complement the weapon style you're building 8 wand weapon specializations 6 base weapons 9 xp upgrades 10 chapter unlocks A wave survival game with rogue-lite elements.
row.short_description: A rouge-lite wave survival bullet hell focused on customizing weapons. Evolve weapon specializations from base weapons each run. Level up to compliment your next build with more projectiles, speed, and starting weapons. Complete chapters to get permanent stacking damage and new weapons.

row.name: Heaven Snakes [Beta]
row.detailed_description: A new generation of a Snake arcade game fully in 3D and online😍! Stay alive, grow and become the top 1 snake on the server 🐍! Use new mechanics to absorb enemies, control your character and have fun 🎮! Eat food to grow, use a boost to speed up, paying for this your length, create a shape by your tail and use your ability to create a locked space and try not to lose 👾! Early Beta The game is in the early beta. Lags, errors, bugs, crashes and etc. are possible. Many features will be released with updates. Sorry for the inconvenience.
row.short_description: A new generation of a Snake arcade game with unique mechanics, fully in 3D and online😍! [Beta]

row.name: Kunai Strike
row.detailed_description: Kunai Strike is a fast-paced ninja styled 3D-platformer with first person controls. Compete in time trials utilizing the teleport kunai ninja tool to instantly warp from platform to platform. Mastering movement in combination with teleportation will strike you straight to the top of the leaderboards. Game Features 3D percision platforming Cyberpunk ninja asthetic Keyboard and mouse first person controls Unique first person movement mechanic Teleport, wall-run, and jump along high elevation platforms 5 time trial based levels Local in game leaderboard system Compete to prove your skill as a high flying shinobi
row.short_description: A cyberpunk-ninja FPS 3D-platformer. Throw kunai and teleport to them across 5 individual levels. Chain teleports with wall-runs and jumps to reach the goal in the fastest time and avoid falling to certain death along the way.

row.name: Awakening of Legend
row.detailed_description: One of the four heroes of legend awakens from their slumber and protects a small army amidst the end of the world. Features Random loot system Rarity-based events with matching rewards Moddable perks: Dismantle an item and add its perk to another item Energy-based combat inspired by the Active Time Battle (ATB) from retro JRPGs Learn new active combat skills by equipping new weapons Experience three heroes, each with distinct playstyles: Saber, Lancer, and Blademaster
row.short_description: Awakening of Legend is a free, retro-inspired, rogue-like adventure with randomized loot, transferable perks and combat inspired by the Active Time Battle (ATB) system from old school JRPGs.
row.notes: Cartoon Violence

row.name: Viltnemda
row.detailed_description: You are viltnemda. A retro PSX style era horror game You've been called into the forest to investigate a wounded deer, but the forest is dark and all you have is a flashlight. Oh bother, what a Tuesday you're having. --- Viltnemda is a horror walking-sim experience with a retro artstyle With your trusty flashlight, you must traverse through the dark forest to find the wounded deer and uncover the secrets of the forest. Flashlight mechanics that turns the flashlight on AND off! Possibly a deer So spooky the programmer won't even play it A lot of trees like, a lot of trees Atmospheric audiodesign that resembles an actual forest Viltnemda was developed over the course of 5 days for Brackeys Game jam 2022 Was also entered to participate in Norwegian Game Awards 2022. This game would not be released on Steam without the help of Skeive Spillutviklere
row.short_description: You've been called into the forest to investigate a wounded deer, but the forest is dark and all you have is a flashlight. Oh bother, what a Tuesday you're having.A retro PSX style horror game

row.name: Extract Me
row.detailed_description: DESCRIPTION: A unique level-based third person obstacle course with shooter elements. This game boasts a non-procedurally generated environment with high attention to detail. Set in a densely-filled post-apocalyptic city, the player is tasked with traversing across the destruction in order to reach the extraction zone where you will be airlifted to safety. Along the way, rescue as many survivors as you can, and kill any sewer mutants that have taken over what's left of the city. TECHNICAL DETAILS: The game is kept fresh with 3 difficulty settings that alter the course in a number of ways, each one being unlocked by the completion of the previous. An extensive library of 100 playable characters is available from the very beginning, comprised with both male and female options. NPC's have generated voice acting, delivering funny lines when saved! WHAT TO EXPECT: - Unlocked frame-rate. - Optimized for disk space. - 4k quality. - Banging music by Tim Beek. - Continued support and updates. - Discord community. - Zero micro-transactions. DISCLAIMER: - This is not an endless runner, however the game does adopt similar elements. - We have chosen not to implement controller support given that both speed and accuracy in the shooting parts of the game are essential, and become increasingly more difficult.
row.short_description: Omg zombies!! Wait!.. Not zombies?! But it's the apocalypse..?.. Oh, we're doing sewer mutants..! Is that a thing?.. I thought we were doing zombies.. no? oh... YAY SEWER MUTANTS!!

row.name: ULTRAFUN
row.detailed_description: ULTRAFUN is a game about patience, rewards, and goals. ... Take care of the last remaining fragment of Planet Ky , a world obliterated long ago by the Greater Void lying within. The Kyzt , in a last-ditch effort to tether itself to our world, formed into one Kyztling: ... Qubert. A renowned scientist, you must help Qubert to restore the ecological balance of Planet Ky, and to eventually reconnect your species with the Intergalactic Federation . Relax . You've got this. This is all you have to do: Feed your scientists some delicious and ethically-sourced Voidling cuisine! Channel your progress into the psychic relay, a natural and vaguely tree-like organism growing within the Ky Fragment. Make friends with your Kyztlings. To be clear, this is not a multiplayer game. I am talking about virtual friends. Realize that this game challenges you beyond the limits of any lesser game. Are you gamer enough to attain GAMER VALHALLA ? . That's right. If you download & play this game, I will personally send you to GAMER VALHALLA . I'm the developer and I am allowed to send you there. Buckle up, because you're going to be sent there at an extremely high velocity. Wear a helmet. Join the Discord!
row.short_description: Explore the Void. Gamer.

row.name: Chromatic
row.detailed_description: The world is monochrome. It is your quest to defeat those evil adversaries who have taken the color, and restore the world to its colorful state. In this 2D Side-Scroller, you will travel across four different levels, restoring color to the world as you progress. Jump, Dash, Grapple, and more in this colorful 2D adventure! Progression In Chromatic, you will fight multiple bosses, each releasing a new color when you defeat it. As you restore color to the world (and yourself), you will also discover new abilities to help you traverse difficult landscapes and give you an advantage against enemies. Features - Four unique levels containing varying landscapes, themes, obstacles, enemies, and bosses - Four special abilities unlocked with new colors - Themed music for each level - Color. Development This game was made across two semesters (15% of the game in the first semester, and 85% in the second). Warning: This game may not be for you if you have an avid fear of any of the following: water, color, vibrance, bunnies that pelt you with wooden pellets, giant two-dimensional frogs, music, clouds, wind, annoying lava chickens, falling, failing, running, dashing, jumping, moving, sand, people, or fun.
row.short_description: Chromatic is a 2D Side-Scroller where your goal is to bring color into a monochrome world by using your abilities to traverse new terrain and defeat enemies.

row.name: Cosmopoly
row.detailed_description: COSMOPOLY is an economic/random/strategic board game for groups of up to 6 players. Look for optimal ways, hope for luck and capture as many businesses on the field as possible, avoiding penalty cells and other people's businesses. Build your strategy by collecting and using items at the right moment. Be careful and monitor the situation in the system, Anthony will help you keep up to date with all the latest news. And don't forget, the longer the game goes on, the higher the penalties and costs! Take money from other players, make profitable deals and become the richest man in the solar system! And detailed statistics at the end of the game will help you analyze the game and measure success with other players. Chat, argue, laugh and have fun If you like Monopoly, Manager or Merchant, then this game is for you.
row.short_description: COSMOPOLY - is a multiplayer board game for 1-6 players. Play with friends, buy planets and space stations, participate in auctions and trade, build upgrades and become dominant in space.

row.name: MYRNEscapes
row.detailed_description: Explore 4 vast, scenic landscapes with audio-reactive elements inspired by the music of MYRNE's EP 'Circles'. What Can I Do: Set amongst red sands, this world is littered with runes and artefacts of a once-powerful society. Undiscovered constellations and celestial bodies move across the sky above you as you explore, illuminating new secrets to discover. Circles: A spelunking adventure within a vast, mystical cave. Unlock and interact with the mysteries of the Circles as you make your way through an ancient cave system. Emotion: Set in a verdant, lush plateau, explore the remnants of a lost tribe as they try to tell you their stories through flickering artefacts. Relax in a stoic experience atop the cliffs; but stay away from the edges. Faithless: A dense, forested jungle is littered with bioluminescent flora, surrounding a mystic river. Cliffs and otherworldly plants keep vantage points well-hidden. Daylight cycles are extremely short, so plan your explorations wisely.
row.short_description: A single player exploration game, with audio-reactive elements set to the music of MYRNE's Circles EP

row.name: Temple Trashers
row.detailed_description: Temple Trashers is a couch co-op tower defense game, in which the towers you build can hurt you and your friends just as much as they can hurt your enemies. Build towers, aim them towards your foes and collect the crystals that drop in order to build more turrets and survive the endless hordes of enemies! You can play both: alone or with friends, with keyboard or controller, but we do recommend friends and controllers :) The only limit to the amount of players able to play at the same time is the amount of controllers and/or friends you have! The game is developed by a group of volunteer students from the Hackerspace NTNU student organization over the span of 2 years. The game is open-source and 100% free! Want to contribute, give feedback, report a bug or even just peek at our code? Head over to the official github page! For other projects and information, take a look at Hackerspace's website.
row.short_description: A couch co-op tower defense game, in which the towers you build can hurt you and your friends just as much as they can hurt your enemies. Build towers, aim them towards your foes and collect the crystals that drop in order to build more turrets and survive the endless hordes of enemies!

row.name: 打工吧！天使酱 ~天使在魔界的劳改生活~
row.detailed_description: 我们的新作《觅光》第一章现已发行，欢迎来玩~！ About the Game 【常见问题】 ①本游戏使用键盘操作 ②如果遇到黑屏bug： 1存档再读档 2使用下雨天捡的蘑菇（若以上方法都无法解决请重新开始游戏orz） 如果遇到其他问题，欢迎来玩家QQ群：839078994 进行反馈w 也可以下载免费的攻略书DLC，查看结局和成就的收集方法哦~ 【故事介绍】 这个世界分为三界，天界、人间、魔界。天界和魔界一同平衡着人间。 天使需要回应人类的祈祷，满足他们的愿望；恶魔则会惩罚那些过于贪婪的人类。 天使一年要回应777个人类的祈祷，而你身为天使，却没有完成这个任务。 于是——你被发配到魔界进行劳改。 只有在限定时间内完成劳改才能返回，否则你会…… 【玩法介绍】 这是一个轻松愉悦的rpg小游戏，请控制天使酱进行每日的工作。 完成业绩是你的首要任务 ，请去公司与同事、老板对话，开始你的工作。 当然，你可以勤勤恳恳地工作，也可以选择摸鱼一整天。 一直工作也会导致疲劳值太高，请适当放松一下，回家或者街上就行小歇吧。 多跟遇到的角色们聊聊天 ，也许会有奇妙的发现哦。 也可以花费你的古金币，在酒吧里买些有用的小道具。 对了，魔界似乎还有很多美男子呢——不过……在期待这样那样的展开之前，还是先去打工吧！ 你的劳改任务可是有天数限制的哦！请在限定时间达成100业绩！ 【操作指南】 使用方向键移动，shift键加速 使用空格对话调查，长按空格可跳过对话 使用Esc键打开菜单 【其他信息】 游戏类型：rpg（探索、策略、养成） 游戏时长：全结局2~3小时 结局数：10 STAFF： 制作\美术\程序：lidogegg、简单 音乐音效：淘声网、爱给网、甘茶音乐工坊 插件：Triacontane、飒雪子、芯☆淡茹水、SumRndmDde、CGMZ、mikan、百合子 发行：梦结界工作室
row.short_description: 身为业绩不达标的天使，你被迫降到魔界进行劳改。 为了不要永远留在可怕的魔域，你必须完成业绩，否则……

row.name: The Tyrning Combat Challenge
row.detailed_description: Game Overview: The Turning: Combat Challenge, is a 3rd person action combat game that takes place in a gladiatorial arena. Playing as Tal, the player will re-enact the final battle in Tim Fox’s Novel Scavenger Hunt . The player and enemy each start with a set of items that include a weapon, armor and a shield. Each item is unique and comes with a corresponding special ability. You will participate in a one-on-one duel to the death in order to secure your team’s position in the Tyrning. This game was made by four Drury University students using the Unreal Engine. Features: Interaction system that allows the player to mix and match with equipping different unique items Five equippable items each with unique attributes and special abilities Combo attack system for the player Intelligent enemy that can chase, attack, block and use special abilities. Advanced Niagara and Cascade particle systems for VFX Cool atmosphere with post processing, lighting, and animated crowd. Informative and sleek HUD Crisp UI that matches the atmosphere and aesthetic of the game Settings for adjusting key bindings and audio Custom artwork and models such as the arena and characters Used assets and writing material that was given to us directly by author Tim Fox Original music composition System that changes the music based on the state of the game Sound effects
row.short_description: The player, Tal, has been issued a combat challenge. Participate in a one-on-one duel to the death in order to secure your team’s position in the Tyrning. Using artifacts secured during previous hunts, engage in melee combat with the opposing team’s champion. Made by four Drury University students.
row.notes: There is blood, violence and one mild swear word.

row.name: Traffic Safety
row.detailed_description: About This game is used to educate everyone on the importance of traffic safety。 Include BREAK OUT SATURN：Fly the spaceship to avoid meteorites in the air. ENEMY GUNFIRE：Drive tanks on the battlefield to avoid enemy bombardment. AIR SCRAMBLED：Pilot the plane carefully to avoid the birds on the route. DANGEROUS WATER：Steer the boat in the rapids carefully avoiding the rocks. CROSS THE ROAD：Carefully avoid vehicles and cross the road Feature The difficulty of the game increases dramatically as the levels increase, making it ideal for those who are more than willing to challenge themselves.
row.short_description: This game is used to educate everyone on the importance of traffic safety。 Include: BREAK OUT SATURN、ENEMY GUNFIRE、AIR SCRAMBLED、DANGEROUS WATER、CROSS THE ROAD. Five mingame.

row.name: Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge
row.detailed_description: Collect the mightiest factions in the Warhammer 40,000 universe, build the ultimate deck and fight in fast-paced card battles to forge your path to glory! Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge is a free-to-play collectable digital card game based on the grim dark future of the 41st Millennium. COMMAND YOUR FAVOURITE FACTION RIGHT AWAY Play with ten of the most popular Warhammer 40,000 factions from the start, with more factions coming to the game in the future through regular content expansions. You will get a starter deck for each faction from the beginning and can choose which faction you earn rewards for through the in-game campaign system. Build your ideal deck quickly and conquer the rankings! PLAY A CARD GAME LIKE NO OTHER Discover unique gameplay mechanics, perfectly tailored to the Warhammer 40,000 universe. Your Warlord leads your army from the front, actively engaging enemy units. Units can choose to attack in Ranged or Melee mode, adding a new dimension and depth to combat. Each faction boasts unique mechanics evocative of their fighting style: Orks benefit from ‘Mob’ attacks, Tyranids ‘Swarm’ together and Necrons ‘Reanimate’ their troops! FIGHT IN SHIFTING BATTLEFIELDS Scenarios also play a role in battle. At the start of each match, the player going first will be able to choose the moment of the attack, triggering environmental effects for both players and changing the scenario itself! Each battleground provides different options, each adding new factors to take into account when strategizing your path to victory. A LOVE LETTER TO THE WARHAMMER 40,000 UNIVERSE Explore the lore and universe of the Warhammer 40,000 franchise as you fight in stunningly crafted battlefields, from Black Legion spaceships to the interior of Aeldari Craftworlds. All cards feature amazing artwork and voice acting, representing the breadth and depth of each faction, and transporting you to the heart of the battlefield, with numerous dialogue options for each warlord and unique interactions among them. Prepare to fight for survival in brutal card battles in the 41st Millennium!
row.short_description: A free-to-play digital collectible card game set in the 41st millennium, Warpforge brings together the major factions of the Warhammer 40,000 universe as digital cards for players to collect and do battle with in brutal and fast-paced skirmishes.
row.notes: This game contains content not appropriate for all ages, including infrequent strong language, depictions of violence and gore, and online interaction between players.

row.name: Memoir
row.detailed_description: The Emotional Visual Novel About Memories of First Love Synopsis Jaeyoon founded a programming club at school, cleverly disguising it as a gaming club. The club, on the brink of disbandment due to a lack of members, is invigorated by the introduction of a new member, infusing new life into Jaeyoon's otherwise mundane daily routine. Understanding Seo-ah's need for a quiet space, Jaeyoon finds himself confronting an unexpected and hidden side of her defensiveness. When he discovers that Seo-ah may soon depart for Finland as an exchange student, he comes to the realization that their time together is limited. - This cute puzzle game features a single ending and full voice acting for the heroine, offering 1-2 hours of playtime.
row.short_description: A short memoir of first love.

row.name: Kādomon: Hyper Auto Battlers Prologue
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME JOIN OUR DISCORD COMMUNITY About the Game Welcome to the world of Kādomon, a mysterious land where cute and quirky monsters roam freely. Journey through randomly generated regions, battling and collecting Kādomon on your quest to be the best. There’s 180+ monsters to add to your Kādodex, and each Kādomon has 2 super rare misprints to discover! Find over 60 of these monsters and their misprints to build the ultimate unstoppable team in the Kādomon prologue! All Kādomon have special characteristics, such as activated abilities, passive abilities and different typings (there’s 12 types in total!). Synergise your Kādomon’s attacks and create a super effective combo of monsters. Grow even stronger with every battle by levelling-up and evolving your team! Once fully evolved, every Kādomon has the chance to get HYPER! Acquire very rare items that allow your Kādomon to break their limits and discover a hyper-powerful 4th form! With brand new designs and souped-up stats, you’ll be able to tackle the greatest of challenges, in the Kādomon prologue you will be able to discover Hyper Evolution for every starter Kādomon! Battle your team against elite enemies and bosses. Get your team ready to fight against MEGA opponents, and unlock brand new Kādomon if you win! Remember, there is always a greater foe to test your strength! The Kādomon world is bustling with secrets, including random events that will change the tide of battle! In the Early Access release, experiment with different items and monsters, Kādomon might evolve in different ways, and if you’re lucky you might just encounter a Legendary Kādomon to join your team… In between battles, take a mosey around Shonkka's Shop! Here you can use the Money Berries you’ve earned to buy new Kādomon and items. Held items are incredibly useful to have as they give you permanent buffs or powerful single use effects when used wisely!
row.short_description: Begin your monster-taming journey in Kādomon: Hyper Auto Battlers Prologue. Fight, collect, upgrade and evolve Kādomon to build your ultimate team in this prologue version of Kādomon: Hyper Auto Battlers. Experience the brand-new features, mechanics and Kādomon for the first time.

row.name: 집착의 망자 - 집으로부터의 탈출
row.detailed_description: 탈출 시리즈 About the Game Sorry. This game is not available in english. 집. 그것은 누구에게나 제일 편안하고 안전하며 자신만의 시간을 누릴 수 있는 소중한 공간이다. 하지만, 위급한 일이 생겼을 때 외부로 도움을 요청하거나, 위험한 일이 발생했을 때 외부로 도망치기에는 어렵다는 특징도 있다. 만약 당신의 집 안에 당신의 생명을 노리는 괴한이 들어오게 된다면? 당신의 목적은 단 하나. 세상에서 제일 위험한 공간이 되어 버린 집에서 괴한의 위협을 견뎌내고…살아남는 것이다. 집착의 망자 - 집으로부터의 탈출이란? [집착의 망자]는 인디즈 작가로 활동했던 TT씨가 2011년에 만든 ‘웹 브라우저용 게임 북’입니다. 80년대에 ‘게임 북’이라는 것이 일시적으로 유행했었습니다. 게임 북이란 일반 소설처럼 1Page부터 읽지만, 도중에 ‘선택지’가 나타나고 그에 따라 페이지를 넘겨가면서 다양한 전개와 결말을 볼 수 있는 책입니다. 집착의 망자는 웹 브라우저에 맞게 제작된 게임 북입니다. 비록 비주얼도, 사운드도 없지만 긴박한 내용 전개가 인상 깊었던 작품이었습니다. 이 게임은 그 웹 브라우저 게임 북 집착의 망자를 PC로 옮긴 것입니다. 원작을 살리고자 비주얼은 추가하지 않았고 BGM도 단순합니다. 그렇지만, 그 몰입감은 여전할 것이라 믿습니다. 특징 - 21가지나 되는 다양한 엔딩이 존재합니다. (비슷한 엔딩이 다수 존재하기는 함) - 실제 범죄 상황에 대한 경각심을 얻을 수 있습니다. - 오로지 문장으로만 설명하여 플레이어의 상상력을 자극합니다. - 갑자기 튀어나오는 연출이 없으므로 간 떨어질 걱정을 하지 않아도 됩니다. - 짧은 플레이 타임으로 바쁜 현대인들도 가볍게 즐기기 좋습니다. - 윈도만 움직인다면 쾌적하게 작동하기 때문에, 그래픽 카드가 매우 비싼 요즘, PC의 업그레이드를 하지 않아도 문제없이 즐길 수 있습니다. - 무료로 스팀 라이브러리를 하나 추가할 수 있습니다. 목적 괴한을 피해 살아남는 것이 가장 중요한 목적입니다. 어떻게든 살아남기만 하면 그것만으로도 승리했다고 할 수도 있습니다. 하지만, 주인공을 위해 최선을 다한 남자 친구의 생명까지 구하는 것이 진정한 해피엔딩이라고 말할 수 있겠죠. 행운을 빕니다.
row.short_description: 만약 당신의 집 안에 당신의 생명을 노리는 괴한이 들어온다면?

row.name: Ukraine War Stories
row.detailed_description: Ukraine War Stories is a set of visual novels about the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine. Set in the early months of the war, it tells the stories of civilians trapped on Russian-occupied territory. In their shoes, you will not be a fighter, only a survivor. The novels will take you from the first volleys of the war in Hostomel, to the terror in Bucha, to the defiant resistance in Mariupol. You will have to keep yourself and your loved ones safe, and eventually escape to safety. This will take courage and resourcefulness — and sometimes, sacrifices. Based on real events Every novel is a dramatization of eyewitness accounts and real events recorded in the area, condensed into one story. The gameplay is text-based and accompanied by music and illustrations. The game's art comes from authentic war photographs taken in the areas where the stories take place. Truly free — no catch The full game is completely free (no in-app purchases, etc) + a free Demo is available until the full game is released. We do not try to profit from this project. Our goal is to share the recent experiences of the people of Ukraine with a worldwide audience. Devs are from Ukraine Developed by a small team located in Kyiv, Ukraine, working from our office despite the wartime conditions. As a Ukraine-based company, we could not sit idly by as the war rages in our country, with enemy forces stopping 3 km short of Kyiv itself, and a large portion of Ukraine being occupied. One of the guys from our team was caught by the Russian invading forces in Bucha (where one of our stories takes place) and had to hide in a garage basement for a week with his family until they managed to evacuate. His house was plundered and looted by the Russians along with many other houses in the town. He told us his eyewitness account, which we used along with other public sources. A lot of our relatives' or friends' lives were also affected. Fortunately, everyone on our team survived so far, but the war continues… THREE STORIES The game includes three interactive novels about some of the first towns that were hit during the invasion: Hostomel, Bucha, and Mariupol. In each story you will play a civilian, completely outmatched against the invading Russians. Your only task is to keep yourself and your loved ones safe, and escape with your lives. But remember: as a civilian, you can only do so much. Hostomel Available in Free Demo On Feb 24, 2022 Ukrainians woke up to the sound of air raid sirens and rocket strikes. A massive Russian airborne attack upon the outskirts of Kyiv followed. The town of Hostomel was among the first targets. This is where it all began. As a retired aviation engineer, Oleksiy Borisov is not equipped to handle the challenges of the war. In this role, you will have to manage your survival resources, and take care of your group's emotional needs. It's not about winning the war — it's about seeing your loved ones to safety. Bucha Available in Full Game for free After a week of intense fighting, the North-Western outskirts of Kyiv fell to the Russians on Mar 5, 2022. Like many other small towns in the area, Bucha was under a month-long occupation. This occupation was among the most brutal in the history of warfare. Yarik Kravchenko and his sister Vika came to Bucha to wait out the assault on Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine. Their mother Yana is a medic defending the capital, while Yarik and Vika are stuck in Bucha, unable to escape on their own. And the occupation is becoming more brutal by the day. In this story, you will be the most vulnerable in the face of the war. You will face tough choices, and a happy outcome will not be assured. Mariupol Available in Full Game for free In the 8 years of the war, the city of Mariupol had already fallen under attack before. Back then it was over quickly. Now, it's about to become one of the biggest and bloodiest sieges of the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Dima Kornienko is a talented surgeon and a native of Mariupol. When the war comes to his city once more, he finds himself on the frontline along with other medics. Your staff is well-trained and motivated, but the situation in the city is growing desperate, and supplies are quickly running out. In this story, hard choices will have to be made — choices nobody can make for you. To save as many as you can, you must keep track of your hospital's readiness and your own mental state. You'll help no one if the hospital collapses… or you do. Support the project! The project is fully free, so if you liked our free Demo, please, support us by pressing Add to your wishlist and Follow. Spread the word You could offer us extra support by spreading the word about the project. Your support and feedback are very important to us. Talk directly with the devs Join our Discord channel and talk directly with the Devs:
row.short_description: Ukraine War Stories is a set of visual novels about the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine. Set in the early months of the war, it tells the stories of civilians trapped on Russian-occupied territory. All stories are based on real events and eyewitness accounts.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: texts-based alcohol abuse, text-based child abuse, text-based violence, and text-based suggested non-consensual sex.

row.name: Spectral Showdown
row.detailed_description: Do you like Prop Hunt? Too bad! This is Spectral Showdown! Overview In Spectral Showdown, You possess creatures and fight your friends, family or greatest enemies to the death using the creature's abilities! Similar to prop hunt, but animals instead! The last one standing wins! Play offline or online and watch as your friendships begin to crumble! Unlock achievements for being the greatest fighter out of your friends or even for simply trying your best (we won't judge). Key Features Offline/Online play (includes LAN) for up to 4 players. Same keyboard support so you can play together on the same keyboard (offline-only). 2 Maps. Achievements. Steam Cloud Support (to make sure your settings are on the cloud)! Cartoony style.
row.short_description: Spectral Showdown is a party brawl game where you fight your friends, family or greatest enemies to the death! Possess creatures at your will and use their abilities to help you! May the best fighter win!

row.name: The Looker
row.detailed_description: Explore several charmed locations on a mysterious island replete with over 55 creative puzzles. Over an approximately two-hour playing duration, you will face unique challenges, ponderous ideas, and feebly amusing in-jokes. The Looker is a single-player game that respects you as an intelligent player, and it treats your time as... reasonably valuable (I mean, don't let me pull you off solving the Riemann hypothesis or anything). As such, I will level with you here—not every joke will be a hit, but there is no filler material, the puzzles are fun, and, if you really think about it, aren't the real solutions the, uhh... friends we make along the way?
row.short_description: You wake up, alone, on a strangely familiar island full of puzzles that will frustrate and annoy you.
row.notes: References to Alcohol & Tobacco Use Some Crude / Sexual Humor Some Strong Language Cartoon Violence

row.name: A War of a Madman's Making
row.detailed_description: This is A War of a Madman's Making : A combination of Visual Novel and text-based RPG centered around war planning and political survival, inspired by games like Suzerain and Decisive Campaigns: Barbarossa . War of a Madman's Making is set in a fictional world where nuclear escalation has blackened the skies. You are a citizen who has been mysteriously called up to serve as Field Marshal of the Great Leader's army. Through a combination of resource management, political maneuvering, and strategic military planning, you must survive the impending war - and the purges and assassinations that will come along with it. You have the freedom to be ruthless in your methods, but doing so too freely could have consequences - particularly if you face a tribunal for crimes against humanity. However, mismanage your resources pursuing nobler causes, and you'll find a similar fate at the hands of your beloved Great Leader. Rein in the disaster, protect your family, and survive the purges. Features ~70k word story with 5 major endings. Resource management . Maintain a military budget, popularity with the Leader's cabinet, and favor with the Great Leader himself. Choose your allies and enemies . Scheme amongst the Leader's staff or even against the Leader himself. Manipulate your reports when you must give bad news to the Great Leader, but be careful not to push your luck. Retro-style soundtrack by Borealis (Shirli Ainsworth) full of tense overtures and bombastic battle themes. An encyclopaedia filled with lore and character details - including nuggets that an astute player will find useful. Join the Discord and contribute to game development!
row.short_description: You are subordinate to the deranged dictator and must plan his doomed invasion in this text-based RPG / Visual Novel. Navigate the shark-filled waters of the Great Leader's presidential cabinet, try to save your family, and survive the purges in a world of power-hungry leaders and nuclear warfare.
row.notes: This game contains content that is not suitable for all ages: Cursing and crude language, references to alcohol and drug abuse, references to gun violence and crimes against humanity, and other dark themes.

row.name: Kingdom Draw
row.detailed_description: A hybrid of challenging turn-based strategy and customizable card collection gameplay set in a medieval fantasy universe. Campaigns Gather your armies, ready your spells and delve into an engaging single player campaign. Complete missions for each of the 4 factions to gain more cards and immerse yourself in the unique story of each of Humans, Undead, Orcs, and Elves. With more chapters released each season, unravel the epic story arc underpinning the Kingdom Draw universe. Online Ladder Play Pit yourself against other players from around the world with cross-platform ladder play. Do you have what it takes to ascend the ladder with every victory and reap your rewards? At the end of each season, earn bonus rewards for how high you progressed up the ladder. Make it to the Titan league to have your alias displayed (and glorified for all time) in the Hall of Fame. Deck Building Buy randomised card packs with gems earned through ladder play and campaigns; or redeem victory tokens to obtain specific cards of your choice. Build your own custom, synergising decks to dominate your opponents and become a Titan of Kingdom Draw. With 185 distinct cards to collect, and more cards being released each season, you can always craft new variations to trial out in battle. Turn-based Strategy Hone your turn-based strategy skills. Matches in Kingdom Draw take place on a hexagonal grid where you play army, support, and beast cards on the map. Strategically control locations to earn more resources, take advantage of terrain, and be the first to destroy your opponent’s castle. Use power cards to decimate your enemies, alter your cards’ combat effectiveness, and modify the terrain. Friendly Matches Looking for something more casual? Stick with the devil you know and add friends to challenge them to friendly battles. Friendly battles do not alter your ladder ranking or provide rewards, so you can trial your deck creations in a more relaxed arena. Cross Platform Link your account across multiple platforms, allowing you to continue playing wherever you are. Available on PC, MAC, Linux, Android, Chromebooks, and IOS.
row.short_description: A hybrid of challenging turn-based strategy and customizable card collection gameplay set in a medieval fantasy universe.

row.name: Chaste Tris
row.detailed_description: Hard Drop In response to requests in the Steam reviews, which I do actually read, I have added the hard drop into the game now. Try it out with space bar or H key. About the Game Chaste Tris is my first complete video game I have made. It is based on Tetris but there is no gravity. Blocks can be freely moved up, down, left, and right with the arrow keys. They can be rotated with X or Y keys and can also be held for later use with C. The space bar or H key can also be used to hard drop the blocks! But my game also allows for a new feature that none of the other games have. It is possible to save the state of the game by pressing the I key and reload it with the L key to go back and correct mistakes. This makes it the perfect tool to test out playing styles which would be perfectly valid on other puzzle block style games but would be very difficult. Consider this game as a relaxing practice tool to test the limits of what you can think of when you have all the time in the world to get it right! This game is not meant to compete with the officially licensed Tetris games. However, I think it adds the feeling of the 1980s and 1990s. It is meant to run on even the oldest and slowest of computers. It is fully Open-Source and was developed on Linux. However, this Steam port is the Windows port which I have confirmed also works on Debian Linux using Proton Emulation. For more information on how you can use the source code and modify it to your own needs, you can visit the GitHub page
row.short_description: Chaste Tris is based on Tetris but there is no gravity. Blocks can be freely moved up, down, left, and right with the arrow keys. They can be rotated with X or Y keys and can also be held for later use with C. The space bar or H key can also be used to hard drop the blocks!

row.name: 猎魔战纪
row.detailed_description: 先声明本游戏战斗有一定难度，并不适合喜欢玩挂机刷刷刷的朋友。 由于并没有太多的测试人员，主要是我自己在测试，即便我玩了很多遍，但难免会有遗漏和不合理的地方。 如果有出现BUG或者大家觉得有某些地方难度不合理，希望大家能积极反馈，评论区留言或者进群@都行！感谢各位赏脸游玩！ 游戏着有不同于其他回合制游戏的战斗机制，每个角色有着独特且能产生质变的天赋加点，你可以把角色按你想的方向上培养。 但是注意你的天赋需要与你主要使用的技能搭配，才能发挥最大效果。 本游戏需要注意的点： 1.很多技能释放需要tp点，我们可以通过加攻速或者加tp回复来提高tp获取效率。 2.技能每次使用会获得熟练度，熟练度可以提升技能等级和伤害，技能熟练度达到要求会解锁更高级技能，所以我们要尽可能多的使用技能，把一个技能练到极致会比每个技能练一会要强得多！ 3.游戏的里控制技能对任何敌人都有效，但部分怪物被控制后会狂暴，狂暴状态下将免疫控制且伤害可能会略微提高。 4.按Q可以快捷保存。 5.设置里面有设置战斗加速，修改窗口样式等功能。 6.更换装备时镶嵌物品会自动转移到新装备上，不需要自己取下来重新镶嵌。 关于战斗： 与其他回合制战斗不同，游戏中有攻速属性。 攻速直接影响角色普通攻击造成伤害的次数，而普通攻击每次造成伤害恢复5点TP，物理系技能是没有冷却时间的只受TP点数的限制，所以攻速也间接的影响了技能的释放频率。 对于敏捷路线的角色，想要提升输出，提升敏捷和攻速是最佳方式。（前提是你的攻击不能太低） 对于力量和智力路线的角色，攻速带来的提升并不明显，所以TP恢复至关重要。很多时候直接增加伤害不如增加TP恢复来的实在！ 关于美术： 刚开始是有想请画师和美工的打算，可是了解了下价格我放弃了…… 整个游戏包括角色立绘、行走图、怪物图片、场景图块、技能特效、UI设计然后一堆图标感觉没个十来万下不来，这让我实在承受不住。 后来想找人已合作的方式给分成，但似乎也不现实，毕竟想找人来免费玩你的游戏都挺困难的…… 所以，只能咬咬牙自己瞎折腾了。游戏的UI素材大部分是RPG make和dlc自带的，也使用了部分其他资源，费劲力气也只能整成现在这样了！ 关于剧情： 作为一个rpg游戏剧情至关重要，但是很遗憾…… 我个人觉得游戏的剧情框架还是不错的，但是受限于自己的文笔和图片素材不足，很多剧情其实都是根据现有图片素材临时编的。 其实游戏中有很多东西没有讲，比如： 1.关于水斗的来历，其实佐克和水斗的父母其实曾经也是猎魔者，后来水斗父母意外死亡，于是佐克退隐照顾主角。 2.夜瞳的父亲其实是十几年前的被星玄打败的将军，整个军队全部战死无一生还。由于莫名其妙的被人团灭，他从受人尊敬的将军变成笑柄，夜瞳和母亲也饱受其他人的嘲笑，夜瞳的母亲也因此郁郁而终，所以长大后夜瞳来到帕拉斯是想弄清楚当年的事，为父亲正名。 3.乌诺斯为啥要打帕拉斯？其实是有人拱火，这个人和故事的幕后黑手麦迪文一样其实都来自的另一个大陆。他们就是想两边拱火，让两国打起来，他们就可以乘机进行实验，制造战斗用的魔物，说白了就是想把这片大陆当成战争实验室。 4.其实后续还有剧情，大致内容是：两国还是打起来了，之后再与夜瞳再见面，却不得不兵戎相见。然后会有新角色出现，阻止了战斗，新角色是另一个大陆的人，他正在调查他们那个大陆的一个邪恶组织，而这场战争就是这个邪恶组织在幕后操纵，目的是乘乱制造出可控制的魔物…… 其实整个剧情有点参考了一部日本动漫《大剑》，这是一部被禁的神作（个人觉得是神作！），至今我的电脑里还有这部动漫的资源，想看的可以加群@我，哈哈哈…… 后续： 虽然这个游戏还有后续剧情，但是暂时不打算出续作，因为我觉得自己目前还没有力能把剩下的故事讲好…… 也许等哪一天时机成熟了，我会回来继续填这个坑，也许…… 之后还是会接着做新的游戏，目前有一些思路，大致是一个策略经营+战棋的游戏。 新游戏的话打算用unity去做，也会花钱去请美工画师，有新进度我也会在群里通知大家，希望大家到时能关注一下。 游戏qq群：634019932 作者b站主页： 头条和西瓜视频：
row.short_description: 该游戏是一款独立制作的回合制RPG，喜欢回合制RPG的朋友一定不要错过！游戏中你可以体验逐步变强然后击败一个又一个强大BOSS的快感。每个角色可以选择不同的培养路线，你可以根据你自己的思路选择角色天赋，进行装备搭配，以及练习技能！ 总之，如果你喜欢回合制RPG这个游戏你一定要尝试一下，我相信你玩了之后绝不会后悔！

row.name: Grizelda:  Lynx and the Nine Lives
