row.detailed_description: Join Lynx on an adventure to rescue a princess and collect 9 souls. A retro-action RPG filled with puzzles, dungeons, and treasure. What happens when a sleeping kitty cat follows a mouse into his hole? Plunged into a magical land where dogs have taken over, Lynx must win back the mythical artifacts that will lead him to Princess Grizelda. Granny Tortoise sets you on a journey to defeat the soul guardians and rescue Whinnie and Ricky Mouse, Rascal the Racoon, Herb the Sheep, and more. Inspired by classic pixel RPG games like Zelda, Kings Quest, Final Fantasy, and more, rediscover the nostalgia of 1980 & 90s adventure games. Help kitties in real life, and consider donating to your local animal shelter or ASPCA.
row.short_description: Join Lynx on an adventure to rescue a princess and collect 9 souls. A retro-action RPG filled with puzzles, dungeons, and treasure. Play for free, donate to your local ASPCA.

row.name: Last Meow Standing
row.detailed_description: You play as the world renowned CATventurer fighting off the ferocious hordes of the mouse mutants. To survive you need to master your arsenal of deadly weapons... and the banana gun. Test your skill and shoot for the highscore on the leaderboards. Gameplay You start with your full arsenal at your hands, ready to fight the mutants. Don't worry about ammunition. When you empty your magazine you get a random new weapon. When you get hit you lose a random piece of equipment. Use your dash move to get out of precarious situations. And that's about it. Pretty straight forward, isn't it? So what are you waiting for? Hop in and see if you can beat the highscores of your friends!
row.short_description: This lightning fast arena shooter brings you right back to the highscore hunts of the arcade era. Use your arsenal of deadly weapons wisely against the increasingly ferocious monster hordes to survive as long as you can.

row.name: The Hunt of the Blood Moon Playtest
Mortmentum
row.detailed_description: Beat My Highscore, I Dare You. But like, this shit ramps up quick . Five types of enemies, deadly lasers, your own incompetence and only a grappling hook and physics to deal with it. Good luck :P Get creative and improve your control, dodge between enemies with more precision than it takes to do surgery on a grape, grab hold of an enemy and use their own laser to kill everyone else or go with the classic and slam your foes into the ground or each other. That's a least like, 3 possibilities (maybe more, I'm bad at math). Simple description: You play as a ball with a grappling hook in a small arena. You get points by destroying other shapes, where the shape corresponds to what they do (the triangles shoot lasers). The more points you have, the more difficult the game becomes and when you die, you try again from the beginning. You destroy shapes by grappling them and flinging them at walls or other hard objects.
row.short_description: Fight endless waves of different enemies using your grappling hook in clever ways while trying hopelessly to stay alive just a little longer so you can get a higher score.

row.name: Police Stories: The Academy
row.detailed_description: Main Game About the Game Police Stories: The Academy is a free version of Police Stories with a new story, missions, and locations. Here, Rick and John are still inexperienced trainees who are just learning to be cops. Another day at the police academy goes awry when unrest breaks out in the city. To make matters worse, a 'rat' who works with the local mafia has turned up at the police station. And, of course, only two student cops can defy all the trouble! Like the original game, The Academy is inspired by SWAT 4 and cop TV shows. A fresh take on top-down shooters with an emphasis on tactics where decisions have to be made in a split second. Rescue hostages, neutralize criminals and defuse bombs in single-player or co-op mode. And remember, shooting first is not the best decision! 3 new missions and locations, plus the police academy training ground. Help young Rick and John become brutal cops! The Surrender System allows you to apprehend the suspects without resorting to violence. Fire a warning shot near them or engage them in melee combat - those are just some of the ways you can make them submit. Issue commands to your fellow cop Rick Jones. Make sure to use him wisely - and who knows, he might save your life in return. Randomly placed criminals, hostages and evidence make every level run unique. The placement changes every time you restart, leading to new interesting situations and opportunities. As a law enforcement officer, you will have access to end-of-the-line police equipment, such as under-the-door cameras, door blast charges and many others. Various types of lawbreakers, from small petty criminals to well organised gangs and terrorists. Each type has not only unique weapons, but different behaviour and shooting skill. Complex Tactical Gameplay: Try not to get spotted, don't waste bullets, regularly check your surroundings and make sure to take criminals down quietly. All your actions are scored in real time. Playing aggressively won't get you a high enough result to start the next mission - so keep that in mind! Co-op. Complete mission together for better scores and more fun!
row.short_description: Welcome, trainee! Use tactics and special equipment to become a true cop in the free version of Police Stories: The Academy. Neutralize criminals, search for clues and find a 'rat' in the police station alone or in co-op with a partner.
row.notes: Includes cartoon violence and gore.

row.name: Jacktus Green: The Fluffy, the Spiky and the Spicy
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Sofrito Town, a fantasy city set in the Wild West, ruled by plants! Help Jacktus Green, a bounty hunter, who has been tricked into betting his pet Cattus in a poker game against the dangerous outlaw Guindilla. She is planning to use Cattus to find golden avocados, and Jacktus wants to recover his beloved friend! 🌵 Travel through 5 different levels: Discover new locations, skills and enemies, while the world reacts to your presence. Complete each zone as fast as you can to beat the previous mark! 🌵 Explore: Investigate and find hidden places, and discover the secrets of Sofrito Town! 🌵 Boss Fight: Challenge Guindilla in three unique encounters. 🌵 Destroy: Break walls and crates, throw dynamite and unleash chaos! COMING SOON! 🌵 Shop: Collect all the gold pieces you can find and exchange them for many goodies!
row.short_description: Chase Guindilla to retrieve your beloved Cattus! Jump, dash, and hook around in this 2.5D platformer. Discover different levels, fight enemies, ride minecarts and meet the bizarre neighbors of Sofrito Town.

row.name: MetälBörn
row.detailed_description: When was the last time you felt like a heavy metal fan? MetalBorn gives you the feeling of the golden age of the genre and also the emergence of a new musical group which is on the rise and it is called: Electronic Music. You will immerse yourself in this first person shooter in a world where our hero, the last follower of heavy metal, is chosen by his god to reconquer the key points of power in his neighborhood, these being three points of conquest. Set to fulfill his hellish mission, our heavy metal warrior heads to the streets of Blüdstock equipped with his Kilmister-blessed weaponry. Arriving at street level, he realizes that his house is the last bastion of the 'Metallic Fortress', the name by which Blüdstock is known, the flagship place and cradle of Heavy Metal. Finding himself surrounded by minions of the evil goddess Lillith, Robert fights his way through the angry mob to the sources of power. Having the path to trace under his choice, Robert will decide which party to conquer which he used to attend as a child, as this became a source of power after the incident with Father Judas, which allowed parties and concerts to celebrate Lilith's Faith. Once there, and after bathing in the electronic blood of his enemies, our dark paladin performs the sacred act of 'The Disc Change'. This deadly sin causes the source of power to change masters and therefore its former owner loses power. According to the scriptures of the Sacred Pantheon, when one of the sons of music decides to claim his territory, he must perform the ritual at least 3 times to rule it. Therefore, the main objective of our infernal hero is to reconquer the parties of the city while the followers of Lillith try to stop him. In this action game with acrobatic movements and verticality, it generates an atmosphere of tension and frenzy when facing the enemies of electronic music that don't stop appearing until they defeat you.
row.short_description: Techno has taken over your neighborhood. Honor your metal god Kilmister, arm yourself up to the baffles, raise the volume and show these punks which is the music that makes the shells shake. The metalheads are not dead, but the technos will be…

row.name: Seeking Light
row.detailed_description: Seeking Light is an action adventure game in isometric perspective with a focus on boss fights. Take control of Sunny, a girl immersed in her subconscious world through meditation where she will have to face her fears in order to leave behind all the pain from the past. Breath in… Breath out… Ready? USE YOUR ENVIRONMENT TO FIGHT Break pillars to get broken stones, pick up bombs and jumping platforms to help yourself through the levels. BE BRAVE, LITTLE GIRL! Explore your inner world and collect the pieces of your childhood diary to confront the causes of your fears. KEY FEATURES: Tightly tuned controls. Dash, attack and throw objects to defeat your fears. Five world zones with their own identity and theme. Five unique boss fights. Collect pages of Sunny's diary to discover the details of her past. Solve puzzles and explore the world of Sunny’s inner mind.
row.short_description: Seeking Light is an action adventure game in isometric perspective with a focus on boss fights. Fight your fears as Sunny and overcome the demons of your past. Explore your inner world, facing the personification of your phobias, and discover the story behind them.
row.reviews: “Thanks I didn't need to sleep anyway!” Late To The Game

row.name: Insurrection: Cyborgs Awakening
row.detailed_description: Chrome Hero Insurrection: Cyborgs Awakening features a classic beat em’ up gameplay. Make your way through the neon city of Beat Bay, a place where peace has never been an option. Fight as Michael, the pilot of the incredible TH-3000, unleash devastating combos to take down your enemies or destroy them completely by making powerful and unique abilities. Fight for humankind The corporation ‘Driftonics’ has taken advantage of this by providing cures to deadly diseases to its inhabitants through nanotechnology or modifying their bodies with robotic parts to achieve technological utopia. What no one knew is that this was all just an evil plan to possess the minds of their citizens and turn them into cyborgs ready to kill. Fight against a variety of enemies, from the weak and volatile Scout, through the agile and deadly gang members of the High Heels, to the mighty Iron Hearts. Stop the Massacre Help Michael take down the top executives of “Driftonics” Corporation. Starting with the beautiful but fearsome Cyberna, a powerful winged cyborg who will be willing to destroy everything in her path in order to complete her campaign of world domination. The Purest Retrowave Style Enjoy fantastic 3D graphics with handpainted textures. Move through the awesome Beat Bay, featuring four different levels with their own theme. Enjoy an exciting story of hilarious action in the purest style of the 80s and above all, be ready to kick metal asses.
row.short_description: Kick some asses in this cooperative retrowave game!!! Use powerful abilities and combos to destroy the evil minions of the Driftonics mega corporation and free humanity from the cyborg threat.

row.name: The Legend of Chibi Ninja
row.detailed_description: CHIBI NINJA is a ruthless 2D Puzzle platformer. Play as The Legendary Hero and destroy hordes of mechanical beasts to save your world from a mind controlling extraterrestial clown parasite using detonable BOMB SHURIKENS. Be very wary though, you can only endure one single hit. Explore 8 chapters full of action and exploration and get to the root of all evil as fast as you can before QUEEN AEUS brainwashes all the citizens of the world. Are you up to the task? FEATURES Precision based fast paced gameplay full of action. (Ideal for SPEEDRUNNERS!) Unique never seen before BOMB SHURIKENS! 8 Whole colorful chapters full of secrets and puzzles. 9 Super cool BADASS MECHANICAL BOSSES. Exciting and praised soundtrack that will make you feel all the action. SUPER HECTIC FRIENDSHIP DESTROYING MULTIPLAYER MODE! Tons of secrets and shortcuts that will test your gaming skills!
row.short_description: CHIBI NINJA is a ruthless 2D Puzzle platformer. Play as The Legendary Hero and destroy hordes of mechanical beasts to save your world from a mind controlling extraterrestial parasite using detonable BOMB SHURIKENS. Be very wary though, you can only endure one single hit. Are you up to the task?

row.name: Arclight Beat
row.detailed_description: Arclight Beat is a minimalistic rhythm-based 3D platformer in which you control various level elements by modifying the music. Jump and control the world at the rhythm of the beat in order to beat challenging music-inspired levels in this charming mix of platforming and puzzles! Create a custom soundtrack by placing beats in different spots and watch as the world adapts to the music. Rearrange the beat mixer, run and jump in order to reach the end! 20 levels with 4 different music themes Rhythm-based 3d platforming Engaging puzzles 4 bonus scrolling levels This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Arclight Beat is a minimalistic rhythm based 3D platformer in which you control various level elements by modifying the music.

row.name: Mebula
row.detailed_description: Champkin in Danger! Help Champkin to Escape from the Spiders-Trap! About the Game Hello Master! Mebula is a fantastical world where players can catch monsters called “Mebulies”, train them and compete against each other. Experience a journey into foreign lands and fight against your friends, NPCs or defeat the elite of the Mebula world in glorious battles. Explore this world and master many quests. Train your Mebulies and let them become great heroes. Play your game as you want it and get great rewards. Everything Has A Beginning To start you can choose between the plant Mebuly 'Sproutly', the fire Mebuly 'Flambini' and the water Mebuly 'Drizzlet'. Then you can start! Master Shin, a former Grand Master of Mebula, will assist you during your first steps. You will have to fight a fight with his student Daisuke and have to explore a few places on the starting islands and then fight a fight against the former champion himself. The Great Adventure Starts! Enter the world, fight your challengers and become stronger. The goal is not only to start with your Start-Mebuly and your first friend 'Sparokeet'. You need new team mates! Look for special places and look for other Mebulies there. A special volcanic crater or a hidden coastal section could harbor them! Train with your team to make it stronger, teach them new attacks, and then travel more areas with other Mebulies. Find the Challenge! As soon as you feel strong enough, compete against your friends or members in matches! Whether you need to train even more or take other Mebulies into your team, to become even stronger, will show up! Your strategy will never be perfect, someone will always try to defeat you with a new strategy! What Will the Future Bring? The disturbances of the Mebus, the most mythical of all Mebulies, are already visible. The large cloud serpent was very rarely seen by humans. But where it appears, there are great storms. Will the Mebu soon show up above Mebula?
row.short_description: Mebula, seal Mebulies, train them and fight to be the best!

row.name: Call Sign is Magic Liner
row.detailed_description: Call Sign is Magic Liner is an old school Shmups with a new twist. Players can leave lines on the paths they move. By drawing a circle with these lines, the player can call out a magic circle that shoots powerful lasers. In other words, movement is a strategic action that combines avoidance and attack.
row.short_description: Call Sign is Magic Liner is an old school Shmup with a new twist. You can strategically draw lines and defeat your enemies.

row.name: Silent World
row.detailed_description: After working or studying for a long period, you couldn’t imagine how fancy it is to leave your seat and listen to relaxing music on your skateboard, especially at sunset or early morning. Get rid of fatigue in Silent World ! This is a simple 2D pixel game. Here, being relaxed is the only purpose. Players can switch different scenes from home page. In your game, you only need to use the direction key (WASD) to control your character to accelerate, decelerate, flip and jump. Here are four different scenes, and new scenes will be continuously coming in the future. Main features: Leisure and relaxation Slide simulation Free content updates
row.short_description: Get rid of fatigue in Silent World! Listen to relaxing music and casual skateboarding in the sunset or early morning. It’s just a simple 2D pixel game.

row.name: DreamIsland
row.detailed_description: ~No.0 The Guiding Fairy 'I need you to collect '50 kinds' of cards that can be obtained by solving the problems of the inhabitants of the dream world. What? Suddenly? Once you activate the card, you can't return to your world until you fulfill the conditions. In other words, you need to collect 50 different cards before you can return to your world. We're about to enter the dream world! When you arrive, head to Term Town. There you will find a clue that will help you get the first card. The first card is in Termtown. DREAM ISLAND' is an open world 3D game. Collect 50 different cards and discover the legends and truths of the 'Dream World'. As you collect cards, the main story progresses. Legends of the dream world, the identity of the legendary 'Dream Master', and the truth about the island-destroying 'Dream Devil', And what is the dream world? All will be revealed only to the player who has collected all the cards. An RPG with a completely original story that you can enjoy as if you were reading a book. Let's go on an adventure to your own dream world! Controls You can change the viewpoint with the mouse. W or Up cursor→ Go forward A or left cursor' → Go left S or lower cursor' → Go backward D or right cursor' → go right Space' to jump F' → View conversation, bulletin board V' → Open the menu screen (*) Save & load is done automatically.
row.short_description: This game is an action exploration game where you complete various missions and collect 51 cards. The map is an open world, and you'll have to solve people's problems and unravel the mysteries of the world from a vast map!

row.name: College Craze
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Sugardale, a mid-sized college town and home of prestigious Sugardale University. You play as an incoming female freshman, ready to make your mark on the world. This game was made for the female gaze, and most pursuable relationships are heterosexual. Choose to study hard, work off-campus, or party every weekend. Manage your grades, followers, and bank account as you meet and interact with the 15 (and counting!) unique characters of Sugardale. Create your own story and get into steamy situations, all while helping (or sabotaging) your friends, keeping secrets, and revealing mysteries about the town's shady happenings. Ever want to see yourself in your games? Customize your character's skin tone, hair color, and hairstyle. See those changes appear in CGs throughout the game! Characters around you don't forget about what you've done. So be careful about what you do, what you say, and who you interact with. Not all paths lead to victory. Find endless sexy possibilities for your own college experience at Sugardale U with your custom female MC, the branching story structure, and +25 love interests. row.name: 佩尔霍宁
row.detailed_description: Introduction to playing method This is an adventure game with micro terror, shooting and puzzle solving. After a prologue that may be a little long, players will operate LXNS to explore the underground world called 'perhonen'. In the game, you may encounter many extraordinary things that you can't understand with common sense. And seemingly unstoppable enemies far beyond their own size. But fortunately, you are not alone. You have weapons and you can fight back. Although the protagonist 'LXNS' is just a weak girl, she can't even control her weapons to shoot perfectly. In this extremely cruel situation, fight with those 'guys' and discover the secrets hidden here. game features 1. Narrative mode: this game uses the traditional AVG mode to tell wonderful stories. The plot narrative adopts both linear narrative and nonlinear narrative, and integrates these elements into the decrypted plot. 2. Backpack system: including props collected in various ways, whether weapons, props or just unlocking the notes of the forward direction. 3. Scene interaction: almost all objects in the scene (whether buildings or objects) can interact, and the acquisition of some key props also depends strictly on this. 4. Shooting mode: the protagonist 'LXNS' is just a weak girl, so she can't control her weapons well and attack the enemy behind her. Moving and continuous shooting will make it more difficult for her to hit the enemy. Therefore, it may be a good choice to stop facing the enemy. 5. Cooperation mode: after completing the main plot, you can play additional content in the 'assault' module of the main menu. Here, you are allowed to cooperate with another player in the game (teammate damage is turned on, but you can press e close to your teammate to revive he/her). game duration Generally speaking, the duration of this game is about 2 hours. plot summary Fudge is my sister who once stayed at my house for a while. She invited me to her house a few days ago. Unlike my family, which runs a coffee shop, her family has a lot of money - I can't say how much, but I only know a lot. She left me a gift on the day she went back, but this thing... Well, I'll send it back to her when I go today. I can't keep it. It was called 'perhonen', but when I approached my destination, something unexpected happened. Introduction to people LXNS The protagonist of the game. Soviets and Allies are coming, and they are getting closer! For many, the fate of the war is doomed. However, those who are still fighting will fight with you to the end! In Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue, your job is to SURVIVE! The goal in the game is to constantly fight on the fronts in order to gain time and force enemy troops to move away from your base. Remember, you have to be vigilant at every step. Your enemies are just waiting for you to stumble. One of the main gameplay features of Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue is the constantly pressing fronts. In order to stave off the attack that surrounds you from almost every side, you will be able to use game mechanics such as: building a Research Center - in order to obtain amazing technologies, breaking codes, extracting resources, developing the technology tree and recruiting the best scientists, spies and agents into your ranks. They will provide you with the key information about the march of the opposing, destructive troops. So make good use of the time you have and create the most terrifying weapon in the history of mankind! Extracting raw materials is also a very important part of managing the entire underground base. The acquired resources will allow you to develop your base, obtain completely new materials - without which survival will be really difficult, and, most importantly, delay the enemy's attack. Use your resources wisely during the gameplay. Additionally, during the game, you can expect all sorts of challenges to thwart your plans. Your enemies will try absolutely anything, including destroying your base from within! Some of the challenges that await you in the game are sabotage or attacks on raw materials. row.name: Touhou Crisis
row.detailed_description: This is a derivative fan-work of the Touhou Project series and is not affiliated with Team Shanghai Alice. Remember to support the official games on Steam. Take on a menacing boss with nothing but your gun, your reflexes, and your other, bigger gun in this short, arcade-style, lightgun game! Originally developed in 72 hours for the 6th Touhou Fan Game Jam, the game has since been polished into a complete experience! Story One leisurely spring day, a large crate landed in a certain shrine courtyard, piquing the curiosity of a shrine maiden and her magician friend lounging nearby. Inside were some guns and a treasure trove of ammunition. Unfamiliar with kinetic warfare, the two girls treated the weapons as toys and played until the sun went down. It was then that a rare guest made a surprise visit to the shrine gates. 'So anyway, I started blastin'' , said the shrine maiden, recalling the incident. Also there are UFOs, but don't think about it. It's probably another Myouren Temple conspiracy. Two Playable Characters: Play as either Reimu with her powerful shotgun, or as Marisa with her full-auto assault rifle! Online Co-Op and Versus Modes: Bring along a friend to take out the boss together! If you're feeling competitive, compete with each other for a high score! Built for Lightgun Play: Everything from the gameplay, to the user interface itself, has been designed by a lightgun user, for lightgun users! Gameplay Modifiers: Hard mode? Lunatic mode? Easy Modo??? Make your own dang difficulty level! You can live out your power fantasy with infinite lives! Alternatively, you can just give yourself 1 life, you masochist !

row.name: Realms
row.detailed_description: You are Fortuna, a young guardian who travels from realm to realm in search of a monster that seeks The Die of Chaos and to destroy your universe. The Die of Chaos is the energy source in which this whole dimension is built on. It is always rolling and calculating random events happening across all realms within this dimension. It is also randomly creating new realms influenced by the Primordial Realms. Without it, the dimension will become still and lifeless. Your mentor, Alden, will help you explore the different realms as you fight, explore, solve puzzles and use all your powers for both exploration and combat. As you traverse through the realms you will have your trusty weapon, the Guardian's Gun. This is the only weapon able to channel The Die of Chaos' energy to aid the guardian. The gun however can also equip magic spells. Throughout the realms the player will encounter magic spells that will be needed to traverse through the realms and reach areas that otherwise would be unreachable. You will also have primary abilities mostly focused on environmental usage. These include double jump, dash, perception, and wave blast. Each episode develops its own unique story. Here are some of them: Episode 1. Good Morning! Good Morning is a cozy restaurant in Amsterdam. The owner, Leah, had gotten tired of her monotonous job at a bank. One day, she decides to change her life and rents an empty building to create a sunny restaurant. But the new work feels too hard, and Leah is about to give up and turn over the location to a fast-food chain. row.name: Pylorus - Footsteps of Greed
row.detailed_description: Pylorus is a 2d roguelite with fantasy medieval setting and a few peculiar twists. Enemies form a dynamic ecosystem with factions and rivalries, you'll need to learn how to exploit their behaviour if you want to succeed. It's up to you to decide when a run is over: escape as soon as possible or stay for more gold - but risk losing everything! Can you solve the mysteries hidden in the deepest tunnels? Long-time roguelike players and newcomers alike may enjoy the challenging (yet highly customizable) gameplay and the non-linear complex lore, set in a procedural environment that encourages experimentation and emergent gameplay. Everyone knows that the underground caves are full of gold coins, jewels and gems just scattered around for anyone to collect. But they're also home to horrible monsters, hideous and evil creatures that murder each other and anyone that dares to enter. For every ten people who get in, only one comes back: always traumatized, often wounded... sometimes filthy rich. With such low odds only a madman would willingly descend into the abyss... or perhaps someone with no other options left. Features Living ecosystem From the first few tunnels to the deepest reaches of the Abyss a great and bloody war is taking place. Monsters aren't just mindless entities solely focused on killing the player, their behaviour forms a deadly subterranean ecosystem with alliances and rivalries. You'll need to learn how to exploit these rules to your advantage if you want to survive. Each life is valuable... You can't 'save and reload' your way out of a difficult situation: choices have consequences, accept them and learn from your mistakes. Think twice before sacrificing your characters: 'at least I got a new highscore' means nothing to a newly deceased explorer. ... and each life is worthless This is not your war and you're not a hero. You're just a passerby trying to scavenge some gold and run away without being killed. Your presence underground is mostly inconsequential, and your demise isn't a great accomplishment to the monsters. It's a ruthless world, finding a way to make your life worth something is up to you. Risks and rewards At the end of each level you may decide to leave the underground: your character will return home with the gold he has found, hoping it'll be enough to secure a future for his family. You may decide instead to dive into deeper tunnels to find more gold, perhaps uncover forgotten secrets to help future explorers... But remember: all your efforts are meaningless if you die underground. Discovery and mystery Be mindful of your surroundings, there's more than meets the eye. The story is not directly or linearly told, you may find pieces of lore scattered all around the game. This also applies to game mechanics: the tutorial covers only the basics, it's up to you to figure out what to do. Try not to read guides, it's best if you succeed with your strength alone, learning at your own pace. Observe, make a hypothesis, test your hypothesis, improve, survive. Find your own path Your choices will influence the game, each option has pros and cons and sometimes you'll be making decisions without knowing it. The tools at your disposal will change: you'll need to adapt your strategies. Each level is procedurally generated to make every run unique. There are 'better strategies' but there's no entirely 'right' or 'wrong' way to play, find your own path. Great peril and great rewards await you, as you follow the Footsteps of Greed. My best wishes to you, Explorer. Good luck! FAQ > What the heck am I supposed to do? Discovery is part of the experience, set your own goal and figure out how to achieve it. More exaustive (but still spoiler-free) answer: progress is linked to an internal achievement system, if you feel stuck you may want to scroll through the missing objectives. Unlocking new items is often helpful to make progress. A 'true victory' exists, but finding it may not be easy... > The game is too hard / The game is too easy / The mechanic X is super annoying, can you change it? Each player has fun in different ways and the default experience may not suit everyone. I encourage you to try the game in the original mode first, if you feel it's not your thing you can use the Advanced Settings to make it easier, harder, or to fine-tune everything in detail (a wide range of game-altering options is present). > Is the game really 'free'? Yes, free means free. No content locked behind a paywall, no ingame purchases, no ads, no weird ingame currencies that you get with real-world money, no lootboxes (well, there are chests and crates with loot in the levels, but you probably get what I mean), no malicious software attached. Donations are accepted but not necessary to play. > Can I make videos of this game? Can I stream it? Can I do X, Y or Z? Most likely yes, the game is released under a fairly permissive license and I welcome derivative works in pretty much any form, as long as you provide proper attribution (i.e. a link to the official game page). Sidenote about music licenses, if you record/stream: it may be necessary to add the name of the author and list each track in the video description, i.e. by copying the relevant portions of the ingame credits screen. > Why the name 'Pylorus - Footsteps of Greed'? The first part was a temporary name that I grew attached to, while the second part finds an explanation in the game lore. > Can I change the list of predefined explorer names? Yes, edit the file explorer_names.txt in your game save folder. The list shouldn't be shorter than 100 names (300-400 or more is ideal). You can always input a custom explorer name when starting a new run, regardless of the current name list. > How accessible is this game? Alas, not as much as I wanted: various accessibility features were planned but cut due to lack of time. The missing features may be added in future updates, in the meantime you should check the Advanced Settings for workarounds. > Can you add the language X to the game? Maybe? I don't know language X at all / enough to make a translation, and I can't hire translators. I'm more than willing to add community-made translations however.
row.short_description: A free 2d roguelite where enemies form a living ecosystem with rivalries and alliances. This is not your war: scavenge some gold and escape with your life... Or stay longer to uncover secrets and more riches, the choice is yours. Strange things happen to those that follow the footsteps of Greed...

row.name: FakeGod
row.detailed_description: This is a single-player Roguelike 2D game. Over 3,000 character entities can appear on-screen simultaneously. Players can bring up to 4 automatically controlled characters into the game. Both these companions and the player character are equipped with a '‌ Sentinel ‌' that moves alongside them, periodically attacking the nearest target. The Sentinel's attack speed increases with level progression.At the start of a stage, both the player's faction and the enemy faction summon minor characters to engage in combat. The number of these minor characters can be expanded through in-game store purchases. During gameplay, the player-controlled character navigates the stage to evade enemy attacks, utilizing the Sentinel and active skills for tactical operations.
row.short_description: This single-player roguelike 2D game,Set in a vast continent within a Cultivation Realm, the game begins with the player controlling a Revived Patriarch – the first awakened elder of a dormant sect. Players assume this role to fulfill the mission of Developing the Sect.
row.notes: The game contains combat scenes and common adult content, which may not be suitable for all age groups.

row.name: FLAM THE PURGE OF THE CENTURY
row.detailed_description: Dans ce jeu à la 3ᵉ personne vous pourrez prendre des armes pour éliminer un maximum de zombies et d'ennemis. Vous avez des objectifs à compléter et une mission à accomplir. Nous sommes en 2036, les différents régimes politiques précédents, ont tous échoué. La flambée des prix de la nourriture et des taxes a conduit de nombreux pays, dont la France à l'état de purge. La ville de Paris est totalement assaillie, l'anarchie a propulsé la violence et des extrémistes ont pris le pouvoir. Si on ne les arrête pas, la terre entière sera à feu et à sang. De plus, une pandémie mondiale a frappé les peuples, un virus ultra puissant et mortel appelé Satan 22 condamne chaque vie humaine à l'état de zombie. La transmission se fait dans l'air ainsi que par morsure. Chaque personne est terrorisée à l'idée de l'attraper. Au milieu de cette guérilla urbaine, FLAM est un justicier des temps modernes. Les ordres lui sont transmis, au sein de son bataillon par le colonel 'Marco Banzini'. Il doit coûte que coûte se livrer à des missions pour régler les conflits tout en essayant de préserver sa propre vie. Bonne chance à vous, ensemble on vaincra au nom de la paix et de la liberté. . Vous aurez la possibilité de conduire un hélicoptère qui vous permet de survoler toue la carte du jeu, ce qui vous permettra de vous déposer auprès des ennemis. . Vous aurez la possibilité de monter sur des animaux de tout genre pour ne pas fatiguer votre personnage et pour éviter les zombies et vos ennemis . Vous pouvez conduire toute sorte de voitures, motos, trottinette et scooter, ce jeu est très réaliste, vous ne pourrez plus vous en séparer. La police et l'armée sont avec vous pour faire régner l'ordre, doc soyez gentil avec eux, car sinon ils vous tirent dessus. Le but de la première mission est de protéger la ville et sauver un restaurant remplie d'ennemis.
row.short_description: FLAM est un justicier des temps modernes. Les ordres lui sont transmis, au sein de son bataillon par le colonel 'Marco Banzini'. Il doit coûte que coûte se livrer à des missions pour régler les conflits tout en essayant de préserver sa propre vie.
row.notes: Dans cette première mission, il y'a des zombies à tuer qui jaillisse de sang, notre rôle comme étant donner que c'est une purge et de protéger les civiles, et sauver un restaurant tenu par des Russes. La police et militaires sont présents mais mon personnage qui est un justicier ne doit pas tirer sur eux car de base ils sont la pour faire régner la paix.

row.name: Arruyo
row.detailed_description: Spain. In the 1950s. the memories of the civil war still tower over the country. Alone at home, shut away, Francisco paints the horrors of conflict. Remembrances of famine and death torment him, and voices of betrayal echo through the house hallways. Something is near, calling him, crawling inside the walls, deep below the foundation of his house. The heart of the nightmare awaits, for the painter to face the darkest episodes of his life. Arruyo is a 3D first-person horror game inspired by Francisco de Goya’s “Black Paintings” and “ The Disasters of War”. The player will have to uncover the mysteries that await in the house to survive the horrors born of the disasters of the Spanish Civil War. Survival Horror mechanics 3 different levels inspired by the architecture of the country houses of Andalucia. Story inspired by the events that occurred during the Spanish Civil War. Original soundtrack inspired by classical Spanish music. Languages: Spanish, English, Basque. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Arruyo is a 3D first-person horror game, where the player is inside a farmhouse with different monsters that will try to kill him/her. To survive and discover the mystery of that place, the player will have to hide from these monsters while investigating the farmhouse.

row.name: Fruit Juice
row.detailed_description: About This game is a simulation fast food Fruit Juice game. First of all, you have to play the role of the receptionist and firmly remember what the guests ordered. Only the correct dishes can bring income, and the wrong dishes must be compensated for the guests. Secondly, Serve guests the right coffee Latte Art. Third, you have to prepare Cocktail for the guests, according to the requirements of the guests, if it is wrong, it may lead to failure. Fourth, you have to make hot Juice for the guests. The guests will ask for differentJuice, etc., and you need to record them immediately. Fifth, you have to mix and stir the juice for the guest, according to the guest's requirements until he is satisfied. Feature The difficulty of the game increases dramatically as the levels increase, making it ideal for those who are more than willing to challenge themselves.

row.name: Cheese Game
row.detailed_description: Survive! Play as a sentient slice of cheese. Armed with nothing more than a dash and a hunger for survival, fend off the beasts that desire to slice you up and put you on a platter. In this boss rush game, you are confined in a small enclosed space, and you must weave around the boss and their many attacks, and wait for an opportunity to retaliate. Three Unique And Challenging Enemies A miner from deep underground, a sheriff from far in the desert, a ghost king on a floating graveyard, and more to come... Challenge three difficult bosses, and die trying. Each boss has a range of different moves, and a completely different fighting style. Learn their movesets, and work your way to eventually defeating them. Difficulty Settings For All Gamers Fight and master the bosses in 3 different difficulty modes, and compete to beat them all with the least amount of deaths possible.
row.short_description: Armed with nothing more than a dash and a hunger for survival, fend off the beasts that desire to slice you up and put you on a platter (with bread or crackers as a palette cleanser of course).

row.name: Party Words
row.detailed_description: Party Words is a.... party word game. It combines a ton of decks covering people, places, categories, objects, and music, with a bunch of game modes like giving hints, answering prompts, and thinking on your feet for new ways to play! **Party Words is intended for in-person parties. There is no TV or 'group screen' required, so it can be played on the go. The game can be played 2 ways: everyone has their own device connected online, or everyone plays using a single device that is passed around. Your screen should be hidden from other players during play.** Multiple game modes to keep it fresh! We've got: giving hints to guess the word, coming up with responses to fit the category, doodle mode, and everything in between. Who's the fastest guesser? Who has all the ideas? Whose doodles are the best? Find out with Party Words. All decks include a Basic and Advanced version to match your playstyle and experience. Play the Basic Deck (100+ words) for more casual players, or for unfamiliar categories. Try the Advanced Deck with 500+ words for replayability, or for categories you know well. Play on a single device with Pass and Play, this is probably similar to games you've played in the past. Don't want to pass the device around? Join multiple devices to unlock new possibilities like drawing at the same time, letting the game handle whose turn it is, and having easy access to game information when it isn't your turn. Party Words supports cross platform multiplayer so your friends can join on their phones. No more handing off the device so someone else can play.
row.short_description: Party Words is a word party game with a bunch of different game modes and a ton of words to keep it fresh! Pass and play with a single device or join multiple devices to unlock new possibilities. Who's the fastest guesser? Who has all the ideas? Whose doodles are the best? Find out with Party Words.

row.name: Space Aces
row.detailed_description: Space Aces is a video game made for the spring 2022 offering of CAP 4053 at UCF. The player controls a space fighter capable of movement in 3 directions and rotation in 3 directions. The game supports any controller, keyboard, and the Thrustmaster 1600M flight stick. The game has 3 levels where you will fly a spaceship around a 3d space attempting to shoot down your enemies before they can do the same for you. In space, there is nothing to slow you down, so you will have to do your best to utilize your momentum to your advantage. It can be a challenge to control a spaceship in a dogfight, but that's part of the fun! Fly through asteroid fields avoiding enemy attacks as you get your sights on target and take down your enemies. The game features unique music in each level, with titles and attributions on the credits screen. Joystick Controls: trigger shoot, hat switch heave and sway strafing, center thumb button toggle Flight Assist, left thumb button thrust forward, right thumb button thrust backward, joystick left/right axis roll, joystick up/down axis pitch, joystick twist axis yaw Controller controls: right trigger shoot, left stick has yaw and pitch, right stick has roll and heave, left bumper is backwards thrust, right bumper is forwards thrust, south face button is toggle flight assist keyboard controls: See diagram above. qweasd are translational axes and uiojkl are rotational axes. left shift is toggle flight assit, and space bar is shoot. There is no pause menu. We had last minute issues getting it to work. If you cant beat the game, and you get stuck on a level, you'll have to alt f4 the game.
row.short_description: Space Aces is a video game made for the spring 2022 offering of CAP 4053 at UCF. The player controls a space fighter capable of movement in 3 directions and rotation in 3 directions. The game supports any controller, keyboard, and the Thrustmaster 1600M flight stick.

row.name: Cyrah's Ascent

Harness the power of Essence in its multiple forms to scale the mountain and destroy the source corrupting the land in Cyrah’s Ascent. In this 3D action combat game, channel ancient powers into several ranged spells and melee attacks to deal with several different enemies. Use your Essence-enhanced capabilities to jump and dash to the peak, traversing the snowy landscape riddled with crumbling remnants of a forgotten civilization. By destroying the source of their power, Cyrah hopes to bring peace to her ravaged homeland. Face-paced melee and ranged combat, allowing the player to choose how they approach enemy encounters. Dynamic ambient audio and music. Immersive environments, ranging from ancient temples to frigid mountains. An array of unique enemy types Engaging traversal through caves, chasms, and decrepit architecture. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

row.name: Endure Island
row.detailed_description: Basic Explanation On a deserted island, there was a repeated phenomenon of large numbers of infected individuals appearing and then disappearing. As a result of the investigation, it was discovered that a virus was the cause, and the organization to which the protagonist belongs began an investigation. The player’s goal is to uncover the mystery of this virus and eradicate it. This game is developed using Unreal Engine, and we have released videos explaining the development process up to version 0.1 on YouTube. We hope this will be of some help to anyone interested in game development. Virus Research The abnormal phenomena occurring on this deserted island are caused by the virus. It continuously mutates and multiplies, gradually making the environment more hostile. The player's objective is to research and eradicate this virus. First, you must explore various areas and collect items from which the virus can be extracted for research. Your role is to understand the virus's characteristics and interactions, and then bring the results back to headquarters. Research takes time, but you can speed up the process significantly by conducting research simultaneously at multiple facilities or by injecting a large quantity of the virus into specific equipment. However, you can't begin anything without first acquiring the virus. Players won't just wait around either. As the story progresses, you'll be able to release the virus from your research facilities. For example, you can release a virus found in the 'forest' into the 'city,' causing changes that wouldn't normally occur in that environment. Promote virus proliferation to improve investigation efficiency. Trigger mutations through interactions between different viruses. Utilize virus interference to mitigate environmental degradation. Since there are viruses that cannot be acquired solely through exploration, it's crucial to uncover their interactions and continue your research. However, be careful—recklessly releasing viruses can quickly make the environment much harsher. Escape The player always has one most important goal: to survive and return from the deserted island alive. If you fail to make it back, you’ll lose everything you've gained from the exploration. Call a helicopter via the radio attached to the virus research facility and escape. However, it will take time for the helicopter to arrive, so act before the situation becomes too difficult to survive. The virus on this deserted island has the characteristic of repeatedly appearing and disappearing, so the next time you explore, you'll start from the same initial conditions. Moreover, items you obtain on the island likely have viruses attached, so you can't bring them back to headquarters. Your equipment will also reset to its initial state. Memory Knowledge obtained by completing quests, repaired equipment, and unlocked doors are saved as 'memory' and carried over to the next investigation. This memory can lead to the development of new scenarios in future explorations, so be sure to actively progress through quests alongside virus research. Mutants Mutants are created through virus mutations. They spread contamination around them, so long-term close combat should be avoided. Mutants appear frequently depending on the virus's state, but by stabilizing the mutation, you can prevent their appearance. Progression Players can grow through the skill tree, acquiring new abilities, enhancing their stats, and expanding the range of items they can craft. Additionally, as virus analysis progresses, weapon mods and virus inoculation features will be unlocked, significantly broadening the scope of gameplay.
row.short_description: On a deserted island, a recurring phenomenon of large numbers of infected individuals appearing and disappearing continued. It was discovered that the cause was a virus, and efforts to uncover the virus and eradicate it have begun.
