row.name: Cards of Binokee
row.detailed_description: Cards of Binokee is a trading card game with the aim of collecting different cards to be able to assemble a powerful deck of cards. With this deck of cards, you can then compete against different opponents. With each completed game you collect orbs (in-game currency), which you can use to expand your card collection. Play with your deck of cards against the computer in various game modes to train, gain experience and expand your card collection through the orbs you earn. Collect more than 1000 cards Over 1000 different cards with different strengths can be collected throughout the game. This also includes rare cards and cards with various elements. Open chests to collect cards With the orbs you earn, you can always buy new chests to expand your card collection. There are different chests to choose from which ones each containing five new trading cards. Depending on the selected chest can also stronger cards or rare cards may be included. With the new cards, you can then keep improving your deck of cards. One card can change everything There are different, freely selectable/combinable game modes. Depending on the game mode or selected game mode combination, it can therefore also happen that one single card changes the entire duel.
row.short_description: In this turn-based trading card game, you can face off against different opponents with your deck of cards over and over again. With the orbs you earn, you can constantly expand your card collection and thus redesign and strengthen your deck.

row.name: Instant War
row.detailed_description: Join an alliance and defeat your opponents, using a large action panel available: army reinforcement, battle tactics, real-time strategy, assault forces, drone and even airstrike. In this 4X game, you can fight for strategic territories or resources points. Choose wisely how to manage your resources and massive army in order to defend your base from the other players. All your actions are in real-time strategy, so you can cooperate with your friend in order to defeat the toughest foes. As a multiplayer 4X game, the key to your victory will be your military strategy. Key features - Massive army: develop the military force that suit you the best! Choose between more that 50 different units (including tactical units). Each of them have their own specialties, strengths and weaknesses. It's your duty as a war commander to build the best army and military tactics for all situations. - Base building: Personalize and expand your Headquarter. Optimize your defense system, supervise military, medical, technical or A.I researches and create a farming empire that will allow you to take advantage of the other MMO strategy players. - Real-time Strategy: Team-up with your friends or with your alliance and lead night raids to your enemies' bases. Take part in a real 4X RTS warfare and destroy your opponents! - In-game events: Participate in daily events: PVE world boss, cross-server warfare, special events (Halloween, Christmas, etc.) - Alliances: Forge strategic alliances with other players and create the best RTS pro army. Find the best battle tactics, assemble your armies and lead your coalition to the top! - Dynamic battlefield: Use 3D terrain at your advantage to ambush your opponents in true real time strategy fashion. Storyline Year 2040. States have collapsed and war rages on, unleashed technology has created a new generation of warfare. Discover secret weapons, grow your empire and become the one and only true Commander of this new order! From the ashes of the Old World, new nations have risen and become geopolitical superpowers. The arms race is back and fiercer than ever. Extensive budgets are poured to develop new tactical weapons powered by AI.
row.short_description: Embark on a military strategy 4X RTS game, in a world where your battle tactics and your massive army are the keys to victory. Instant War delivers an amazing battlefield experience in a realistic military game. As a commander, you develop your military base and lead your army to victory!

row.name: Duelyst II
row.detailed_description: DUELYST II is a free, fair, competitive tactics game. Build your collection of beautifully animated pixel art cards and put your skills to the test on the ranked ladder. Position your units on the battlefield and destroy the enemy General to claim victory in strategic turn-based combat. Construct a deck from hundreds of unique cards - use minions, spells, and artifacts to discover new strategies and devastating combos. Choose from six powerful factions: Lyonar Kingdoms, Songhai Empire, Vetruvian Imperium, Abyssian Host, Magmar Aspects, and Vanar Kindred. The Factions Lyonar The Lyonar Kingdoms are proficient close quarter fighters who use Provoke and Zeal establish a massive presence on the battlefield. Utilize their healing prowess and you can whittle down your opponents in a war of attrition. Songhai Subterfuge is no stranger to the Songhai Empire, who steal the initiative with their displacement, ranged and backstab techniques. They're also masters of spell synergy, weaving devastating damage combos. Vetruvian The Vetruvian Imperium focuses on ephemeral Dervish summoning and specialized minions. Use a myriad of buffs and debuffs to swing the fight in your favor, and equip powerful artifacts to make your General a lethal force. Abyssian Masters of Deathwatch, the Abyssian Host know best how to profit from demise. They create deadly Shadow Creep and outnumber their opponents with an army of Wraithlings - weak alone, strong in numbers. Magmar As resilient as nature itself, the Magmar Aspects are a powerful force to reckon with. Their Grow and Rebirth abilities require foes to invest heavily into tearing down their units, lest they get torn themselves. Vanar The Vanar Kindred are an elite group of tacticians with the tools to manipulate the battlefield. Utilizing Infiltrate minions and Walls, they'll exercise swift and precise removal. With the cold as their ally, nothing runs away far. The world of Mythron awaits... - Dream Sloth Games has no affiliation with Counterplay Games. We extend our thanks to them for releasing much of the original Duelyst source code under a Creative Commons license in 2022.
row.short_description: Choose your faction, construct your deck and put your strategy to the test in the evolution of the ultimate collectible tactics game.

row.name: The Chronicle
row.detailed_description: When a mysterious package appears in his living room, Detective Walter Miles is suddenly transported to a World War II Era newspaper building. You, in the role of Detective, will need to explore this strange but breath taking environment, collect the gems to activate the portal and escape. Along the way you'll explore and learn the back story of this strange environment. Maybe you'll solve the mystery of the reason that you are here, and who is responsible for this abduction. The programming and art, etc., is handled by master 3d artist Don 'Artstrong' Armstrong, bringing his 10 plus years of 3D art experience to a brand new game. Much assistance was provided by Chris 'Warcabbit' Hare, and also code tutoring assistance was provided by William Davis. I utilize every scrap of Unreal 5 and it's new technologies. Warning: This game does NOT hold your hand, Explore and solve the mystery to escape. NOTE: The Chronicle is a planned series of chapters, Chapter 1 is WIP. I will continue to update and add content over the next few months to a year, until it is completed. Then I will move on to the next chapter in the series.
row.short_description: When a mysterious package appears in his living room, Detective Walter Miles is suddenly transported to a World War II Era newspaper building. Can you solve the mystery and escape?
row.notes: None Gore Hack and Slash violence.

row.name: Mate
row.detailed_description: About this game 'Violence should not occur under any circumstances.' Mate is about the perpetrator of school violence, the main character, about the mistakes he made due to the disappearance of the victim. It is a game that depicts a person living in extreme anxiety and suffering mentally. Players become even more exhausted by hallucinations and nightmares. You continue the game by controlling the protagonist, the perpetrator of school violence. Will the protagonist be able to sincerely apologize to the victim and receive forgiveness? Mate is a story-based third-person game The game begins with the protagonist's hallucinations and nightmares, and includes puzzles and physical control elements. A multi-ending game where every action you take changes the outcome of this story. Game Features Mate was created by a student who is a solo university developer, and all the assets except for a part of the sound and one poster were created by myself. Any sounds used without production are credited with in-game sources. It is drawn in the background of the developer's nationality, Korea, but the historical circumstances, characters, and names are fictional characters that have nothing to do with reality.
row.short_description: Mate is a third-person story-based game with a multi-ending game with puzzles and physical controls.The protagonist, the perpetrator of school violence, is anxious that his actions will be revealed to others, which leads to psychological hallucinations and nightmares.
row.notes: violence, murder, blood

row.name: Old Roots
row.detailed_description: Old Roots is a survival horror game, inspired in the siberian enviroment. When you are a hunter and you found something going wrong in the forest, what would you do?. Explore and find new things, or just practice shooting with your cans? In the forest, be careful where you step, there is so many bunkers from WW2 hide inside the earth, and some of them are haunted! Maybe the ancient viking gods where not a myth, and you must be stealthy or you will end death!
row.short_description: Old Roots: fight your fear and survive your fate. Inspired by the geography of Siberia and with inspiration from games like Doom or Hellblade, you will have to face your own fear and overcome your enemies... without losing control.
row.notes: There is some violence and graphic scenes.

row.name: Dragon Kingdoms: A Legend's Beginning
row.detailed_description: Dragon Kingdoms: A Legend's Beginning is an RPG that seeks to recapture a long-gone era when games were more than just graphics and FMV cutscenes. They were fun. It takes place on a world that has been nearly torn apart by a war that happened long ago, between thirteen races, of which only a few remain. Features: Fishing! (fish off logs or rocks in or near bodies of water) You start with a default rod and default bait but can upgrade through the course of the game. It's even said that fish can be found in pools of acid or even in lava, and if you're lucky (or unlucky?) you can catch a 'fish' big enough to pull you in! Spelunking! (the Hills Cave southwest of Lakeland Town right at the start of the game is said to be endless. Whether or not this is true, the monsters within get stronger and stronger as one progresses) Combat! (like most any RPG, there is combat, and in this case, it's turn-based, side view. There are currently dozens of monsters you'll face and this number will increase as development progresses.) Fast Travel! (for your convenience, there are multiple forms of fast travel that operate in a tiered system, from shrines on the map that take you to waypoints on various parts of the map, to a traveler that takes you to other parts of the starting island, to a friendly giant that can take you to other parts of the nearby continent, and even a dragon that can fly you around the world! And there are STILL other forms of fast travel) Adventure! (true, there are roads strung across several maps, but some of the best stuff is found off the beaten path- such as a sunken treasure chest in a pond, a cave that requires a canoe or boat to enter, a nearly lost civilization that lives in the mountaintops...) Questing! (there are quests that you can undertake, such as helping a surveyor for a new road into the mountains defeat some monsters that have been slowing down work, or stopping a massive bird from terrorizing nearby travelers, or even finding out just what IS up with this guy known as 'The Traveler' that continuously tracks everything the party does?) Upgrading (you might decide that Frosty Sword is worth keeping around and forge it into a Frosty Sword +1, +2, +3... there's something to be said about a tough old blade. Whether it is up to using it over shiny new equipment is another question) Minigames! (get on a friendly giant's shoulders and have him carry you across the land! But he'll come across some dangers, too. Jumping over obstacles, fighting tough enemies, or even finding a superboss or two- sometimes the troubles get bigger when you are bigger.) .
row.short_description: Dragon Kingdoms: A Legend's Beginning is an RPG that seeks to recapture a long-gone era when games were more than just graphics and FMV cutscenes. It takes place on a world that has been nearly torn apart by a war that happened long ago, between thirteen races, of which only a few remain.

row.name: Elohim Eternal - Prologue
row.detailed_description: A FREE Prologue to Elohim Eternal: The Babel Code, a turn-based RPG indie title inspired by Xenogears and Shin Megami Tensei. Play as Joshwa as he helps an ex-Judge let go of his past. Battle beasts with mechanical parts using elemental and divine magic. This Prologue is an introduction to the full game, Elohim Eternal: The Babel Code. It takes place one day before the events of the full game. It will take about 1-2 hours to complete. Playing this Prologue will give you a good taste of what to expect for Elohim Eternal: The Babel Code.
row.short_description: A FREE Prologue to Elohim Eternal: The Babel Code, a turn-based JRPG-inspired indie title inspired by Xenogears and Shin Megami Tensei. Play as Joshwa as he helps an ex-Judge let go of his past. Battle beasts with mechanical parts using elemental and divine magic.

row.name: Awake
row.detailed_description: Awake is an isometric puzzle game about a young girl named Aya who is suffering from insomnia. Accompanied by her trusted plushie Bunnard, Aya must navigate various obstacles in her path as she moves between different planes of consciousness. Join Aya on her journey to explore the depths of her dreamscape and uncover the root of her anxieties. Players will navigate various puzzles by sliding and otherwise manipulating the obstacles in her path. But here's the twist: there's two sides to every puzzle. In order to progress through our game, players will need to seek puzzle solutions from a different angle...

Aya must navigate various obstacles in her path as she moves between different planes of consciousness. Join Aya on her journey to explore the depths of her dreamscape and uncover the root of her anxiety.

row.name: Gleeb Glob
row.detailed_description: Gleeb Glob is a physics-based 2D precision platformer, following a fatigued employee who's lost their head. Climb the corporate ladder by racing to the top through a series of challenging platforms. Run solo or race with others in competitive multiplayer matches. Collect and unleash a variety of unique power-up items to get ahead in the journey to the top. The stakes are high and so is the competition. Don't slip up! One wrong move could send you falling back to the bottom.
row.short_description: Gleeb Glob is a physics-based 2D precision platformer following a fatigued employee. Climb the corporate ladder by racing to the top through a series of challenging platforms. Run solo or race with others in competitive multiplayer matches.

row.name: NinjaThea
row.detailed_description: Mischievous critters have stolen all the fruit from the local grocery store. It's up to you, brave little NinjaThea, to punish the critters and gather all the fruit as fast as you can. A short and fun 2D platformer, inspired by the creativity and imagination of a 4-year old little girl. Run, jump and slash your way across 7 different stages, collecting a variety of fruit while avoiding traps and evil critters. Your every run is timed, so you ca go back and try to best yourself. Good luck!
row.short_description: Casual 2D platformer with a cute ninja girl theme.

row.detailed_description: Our game is a basic tower defense game where monsters are coming in through a portal are trying to destroy your tower! The only way to stop them is to send out your units, level up your tower and try to outwit them!
row.short_description: Our game is a basic tower defense game where monsters are coming in through a portal are trying to destroy your tower! The only way to stop them is to send out your units, level up your tower and try to outwit them!

row.name: Fungiman
row.detailed_description: Fungiman is an atmospheric and challenging first person survival horror game. You find yourself in the forest, as in fifty thousand billion other games. You admire nature, beautiful flowers, trees and mineshafts and do not even suspect that 'He', the warden of the Fungar forest, the Füngiman, has been watching you all this time. Why is he following you? He makes sure that no one touches his donuts — the main source of his füngus power. But you also need these donuts, simply because you are a human, and these donuts are really delicious. And you want to collect and eat them all. It would seem that the Füngus will be angry if you eat his donuts... or not? Features: • Füngiman changes his behavior and tactics throughout the game • Two levels: classic and reworked • Diverse locations • Secret minigames • Multiplayer
row.short_description: Just a game about a friendly fungus. There's nothing wrong, is there?

row.name: Godumas
row.detailed_description: GODUMAS is a first-person action horror co-op. Explore the strange island solo or with a team, solve location based puzzles and find a way to escape. Communicate with your friends using in-game voice chat, but remember to talk quietly because who knows who will hear you. Avoid the local inhabitants that will try to hunt and sacrifice you. Gameplay features: Co-op: Play with up to 4 friends, explore the island and find a way to escape; Proximity voice chat: Communicate with your friend using ingame chat, but remember to whisper because enemies can hear you; Replayability: Over 500 unique item spawn locations, so every game feels different; Customizable gameplay difficulty : Play how you wanna play; Enemies with unique behaviors: 4 enemy types that have different ways that they attack you; Scalable difficulty: More players equals more enemies, more items, more treasure, more fun; Stealth: Sometimes it’s better to avoid enemies; No hand holding: Map does not show your location, so get your bearings using POIs and other landmarks; Gameplay: Escape the island using one of two routes. Collect items to open their specific exits. Hints have useful information about locations of exits and useful items. The information on them is only visible to players who picked it up. Enemies will try to stop you from escaping. You can ward them off using a flashlight or a special amulet. You can sneak to avoid enemies detecting you, distract them by throwing stones or hide in bushes and hope that they leave. When you are hurt you can’t move, but if you or a friend has a healing syringe you can be healed. You can also be sacrificed and become a ghost. As a ghost your job is not over. You can help your team to escape, search for items, etc… or not. Story: One night out partying your group of friends bump into a strange guy in your local city port bar. After buying him a few drinks, he starts telling stories. One of those stories was about a rich isolated island where he once lived, but a horrible event took place one night and he had to run for his life. No one believed him. After some harassing and name calling the stranger would reveal the location of the mysterious island. Of course, the smartest decision was to get on your dad’s boat and visit the island. Near the mysterious island everything goes south when the ship sails into a storm. You and your friends are transported to the mysterious island. The boat is no longer seaworthy and at first sight, it looks like you are stranded for the time being. After moving more inland you understand that something is very wrong with this place. It looks like it is infested with strange humanoid creatures and cultist types. The island that was once an isolated, but bustling religious land with villages, shops, local mining and lumber industry, now stands abandoned and forgotten with strange creatures and occult members running around.
row.short_description: GODUMAS is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Explore the strange island, solve location based puzzles, run or sneak your way through local inhabitants and find a way to escape… before you are sacrificed.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

row.name: Railroads & Catacombs: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Players will board a train and lead their team through the land of madness and desolation. And you will need to make supply runs during the treacherous journey, surviving while already fallen into despair. Make sure you are ready to face those sinister creatures. Bosses will end your pathetic lives with no hesitation. Navigate in skirmish and attack the enemy using a crushing blow. Conquer the unknown or be conquered by it, nobody knows the answer... The locomotive is connected to 12 different types of carriages, it’s the only sanctuary in this world of madness. Get away from this ominous land, find a safe place. Meet other survivors, 5 classes with unique deck builds. What’s your choice, a soldier to fight with your? Or a backup stationed on the train? Pairing two of the five combat styles, there are more than 120 card building combinations. Find your meta combinations, so your venture may last longer... Prologue content: Assemble your vanguard squad by recruiting survivors with different classes. Explore the first location, challenge 2 wicked bosses! Learn about soldiers and engineers’ vital role on the journey!
row.short_description: Start your training in Railroads & Catacombs! Learn how to build your cards in the most effective way. Test your deck against the first boss and master your strategy for the full game.

row.name: Welcome To The Backrooms
row.detailed_description: Welcome To The Backrooms The halls stretch onward into infinity, segmented by elevators, paths, and walls. You found yourself here after tumbling through your door. Whatever you were doing before, it is no consequence now. Explore your new surroundings, seek out the lost pages and words of those that came here before, or perhaps even after you. Craft a future for yourself in this place. Hope beyond hope that the noises you hear on the outside of your hastily constructed camp come from within your own mind. Survive the Backrooms, an infinite liminal space in which you are alone. Above all else, never lose your way, your mind, or your sense of self to the madness of your own senses. Features: THIS GAME IS CURRENTLY IN EARLY ACCESS AND WE WILL BE HAVING LOADS MORE UPDATES IN THE FUTURE. In depth player health system including: Sanity, Thirst, Stamina, Heartrate, Enhanced Blood System, and Body Temperature. Infinite, procedurally generated levels with fully random entity encounters. Sandbox open world. Crude crafting system and Building system to allow you to protect yourself from the horrors of the Backrooms. Random lore to uncover in your journey through the backrooms.
row.short_description: Welcome to the Backrooms is a indie horror game developed by Brickmade Productions. This game will bring you the ultimate Backrooms survival experience, crafting, lore, entities, and a very in-depth health system which will keep you checking your watch non-stop.
row.notes: Elements of Psychological horror. Blood and gore.

row.name: Around The World
row.detailed_description: Around the World is a basketball variant played by shooting 3 point shots from selected areas around the arc. This is a quick paced mini basketball game. Chose f rom a casual free practice where you can play/shoot as much as you want. The standard format, where you need to shoot 7 consecutive shots before you run out of balls. The fast paced drill, a time attack where you have to win within a set amount of time. Key Features Stress-free Practice mode, allows you to shoot hoops just for fun. Time-attack to be the best of the best. Compete against other players by recording your name on top of the leaderboards. Customize your experience from as few as one ball or ten ball limits.
row.short_description: Basketball mini-game, shooting 3 pointers in sequence to complete the game. Played in a time based format or number of balls, or casually in practice mode.

row.name: Advanced Map Generation
row.detailed_description: Advanced Map Generation is a simulation of Earth using natural processes and realistic formulas. Its primary purpose is to teach about worldbuilding from the perspective of real-world equations. These processes include Solar Insolation (heat from the sun and atmosphere), the Coriolis Effect, Oceanography, and several others (this will list be expanded in the future). Wherever possible, the links to these sources and additional equations are included. This game will be expanded in future into a survival game utilizing these concepts (in 1-3 years). This program was made using the Godot Game Engine.
row.short_description: Advanced Map Generation is a simulation of earth using realistic formulas and processes, such as using tectonic plate interactions to generate terrain. In the future, it will be developed into a survival game using these processes.

row.name: Knock the Bloody Door Down
row.detailed_description: It's hard to be a human in a world of vampires, isn't it? Knock the Bloody Door Down is a solo-developed narrative adventure game in which you explore an underground society of vampires. Walk, jump, and climb your way through a side-scrolling pixel art environment. NOTE : The game was designed with 1920x1080 displays in mind. If you have the ability to set your display to 1920x1080, then doing so will result in the optimal gameplay experience. Q & A Q: Hmm, a side-scroller with vampires. So it's kind of like Castlevania? A: Good question! No. Q: Why is it free? A: Because maybe the real treasure was the fishing minigames we played along the way. Q: Is the game good? A: No, but don't let that stop you from enjoying it!
row.short_description: It's hard to be a human in a world of vampires, isn't it? Explore an underground society, uncover its secrets, and make friends along the way. What awaits you on the path ahead - adventure? Or merely more heartache?
row.notes: Profanity, minor depiction of blood, discussion of violence, murder, and suicide.

row.name: Everything Has Arms
row.detailed_description: It's hide-and-seek on steroids in VR. And everything has arms! Gameplay Hunters are looking for the heavily 'armed' items in this multiplayer VR prop-hunt game. As mimic you blend in and fool the hunters, high-fiving other mimics for victory. Hunters need to find and catch the flexing flower pots in this fast-paced hide and seek game. Everything has arms in Everything Has Arms. In Everything has Arms you either take on the role of a Hunter or become a Mimic. Mimics can disguise themselves by possessing objects and hide as them. Score by high-fiving other mimics and staying in the game as long as possible. You can only stay in object-form for a limited time, after that your arms pop out. As soon as the hunters spot you, you need to bolt and lose them before they catch you. Hunters need to find and chase down the Mimics. Their finger guns will slow them down and hinder their jumping ability. (Mimics can fire flares with their own finger guns, signaling other Mimics positions on the map.) Mimicking / Hiding All objects that are armless can be possessed by grabbing them with your hand. Press the trigger to use the object as your body. You hide by putting your hands in front of your face, but remember: You can only hide for a limited amount of time! Be smart and use it to get away from the hunters. Movement Well, everything has arms and that’s how you move in the world! You scoot around by propelling yourself with your arms and hands. push yourself away from the ground, similar to a monkey. Grab onto walls with the trigger to hold on, push away from the ground to jump. You can increase your jump by using two hands to push. The movement relies on physics, so you can also wall jump if you time everything right. We definitely recommend Room-Scale VR. Hunters As hunters, your goal is to identify the Mimics in the level, chase them and catch them. Your finger gun fires sticky goo to slow Mimics down and signal them on the map. Mimics can hide from you in object form for a limited time. Mimics Mimics have to play a dangerous hide and seek game. To hide, simply move your hands in front of your face and you become the object you currently possess. Score by high fiving the wall-mounted hands or other mimics. Your flare-finger-gun gives you the ability to point to places in the level for other mimics to see, but the hunters can also see it. The hunters will try to catch you, escape them by running away or by cleverly disguising yourself.
row.short_description: High-five a cannon, chase a flowerpot or escape the vicious hunters in Everything has Arms, a fast-paced hide and seek VR game. Room-Scale VR highly recommended.

row.name: The Dead Sea Scrolls Adventure
row.detailed_description: The Dead Sea Scrolls Adventure aims to greatly enhance the learning objectives of the course, JST 3144: Dead Sea Scrolls, in an enjoyable manner for the students playing it at University of Central Florida. Players play as Dr. Jerusalem Jones, an explorer set on finding out the history behind the 7 major Dead Sea Scrolls. Along the way, the player gets to meet a whole cast of characters and traverse across the deserts and caves near the Dead Sea as well as the streets of Bethlehem to learn about the history behind these relics. Players will be quizzed along the way to test their knowledge! The Dead Sea Scrolls Adventure was developed by Cave3 Studios, a group of students at the Florida Interactive Entertainment Academy, over the course of three months. Key Features: A range of historical characters with voice narration Educational conversations and quizzes Multiple locations Interactive Maps Controls: WASD to Move Mouse to Look Space to Interact ESC to Quit
row.short_description: Play as Dr. Jerusalem Jones, an explorer set on finding out the history behind the 7 major Dead Sea Scrolls. Along the way, the player gets to meet a whole cast of characters and traverse across the deserts and caves near the Dead Sea and Bethlehem to learn about the history behind these relics.

row.name: 百将群英传

row.short_description: 《百将群英传》是一款以三国乱世为背景的攻城策略卡牌游戏。国漫的画风融合3D建模写实，加强人物特点的展示；同时创新的玩法设计带来新的游戏策略体验。

row.name: Goi: Spooky Run
row.detailed_description: Play with 3-10 players in this casual battle royale game of TAG with GHOSTS! Enjoy the fun with friends or strangers, survive the ghost hunt, beware of other players, and watch out for their silly pranks! Your objective is to be the last one standing. Gather souls, tag your friends with a curse, and don’t get caught! Stop your mischievous friends from winning. We got all the classic silly pranks, from farting to slipping on banana peels! Even at the last minute, you have a chance to win! You might be down, but you are never out! Personalize your character and express your style! You can lose the game but never in fashion! Do not miss this good ghostly fun time! Play Goi: Spooky Run now!
row.short_description: Goi: Spooky Run is 3-10 players “Catch me if you can” online party survival game. Put your friendship to the test! Prank your friends, survive the ghost hunt, and be the last one standing in this chaos!

row.name: Dream Three Kingdoms 2
row.detailed_description: 《梦三国2》是由杭州电魂网络科技股份有限公司自主研发的一款将RTS元素融合到RPG网游中的即时战略网络游戏，于2015年3月26日正式运营。该作保留了前作的三国文化背景，继承了其特色玩法，优化了画面和操作体验，还基于玩家们的需求提供了有趣新颖的地图和系统 。 2021年11月5日，《梦三国2》入选为第19届“亚洲运动会”电竞比赛项目。 游戏主要分为PVP玩家之间的对战和PVE以三国历史故事为背景的合作关卡为主，玩家选择不同的英雄，参与各种竞技场的挑战，通过团队、国家的配合以及个人的操作意识来击败对手，取得最终胜利 。 梦三国2中PVP的竞技地图有“娱乐*三国无双“、”英霸*天命无双“、”天命*荆州争霸“、”官渡之战“、”天命*官渡“、”三国志大战“等10多张公平竞技地图。 游戏开始前，玩家可以从130多名三国英雄中选择自己想操控的英雄进行战斗。在竞技地图，需要与队友合作击败对手达成一定次数，或者推掉对方基地来取得游戏的胜利。 PVE副本地图有“黄巾入侵“、“虎牢关大战“、“江东平定战“、“千里走单骑“、“三顾茅庐“等50多张副本地图。 副本地图会带入玩家装备属性进行作战，提前制作与强化装备，会让你在PVE地图中如虎添翼。在副本地图，需要与队友合作，根据副本条件，通关副本取得游戏的胜利。 梦三国2世界里，诸位三国名将的命运，历史如何演变，这一切将由玩家来亲身体验和作出抉择。 注意： 本游戏含有内购 需系统语言环境设置为简体中文，才可正确启动梦三国2。
row.short_description: 国风与电竞的碰撞、讲好三国故事。在梦三国游戏中玩家选择不同的三国英雄，参与各种PVP的竞技场的挑战或三国背景的PVE副本，通过团队、国家的配合以及个人的操作意识来击败对手，取得最终胜利。 梦三国2世界里，诸位三国名将的命运，历史如何演变，这一切将由玩家来亲身体验和作出抉择。
developers: 杭州电魂网络科技股份有限公司
publishers: 杭州电魂网络科技股份有限公司

row.name: Party Pie: Free Pie
row.detailed_description: Set up your own server Hold your own match, support 180 / 360 panorama About the Game Dear Human Beings. Party Pie is a multiplayer social party VR game perfect for releasing stress and your instincts~ By the way, this game is VR exclusive , if you do not have VR equipment please do not download it :) Operates and Controls There is no move button or jump button, you just need bare hands, for crawling, grabbing, painting, etc., behaves like Babies or gorilla. Fun more than levels The game is full of organs that need to be cracked with physical mechanisms, your hands and brains are equally important ---- Of course, there are your not-so-reliable teammates, whether it's driving a yacht, stepping on a skateboard, climbing a wall or flying, they can bring you plenty of surprises. Play anytime In addition to the classic single-player mode, up to 16 people can play online, whether they are friends or passers-by can join in the middle of the game. Party at anytime! Show your talent Support custom skins, can be made in the game with drawing or mapping, 3 seconds to learn, you can do it ~! PS: Please don't paint on other players at will :) level editor is also in the plan, the real masters never lack the opportunity to play! There are different maps ,which include Co-op map and PVP maps. Just try everything.
row.short_description: Party Party is a VR party game, you can draw and share your own characters, chanllenge large number of unique levels with them. We will also add the map editor in the future , you can create your own levels!

row.name: Mega Serval
row.detailed_description: Something strange is afoot in the peaceful Japari Park and it's up to Serval , the aptly named serval cat, to investigate! Run, jump and shoot your way through twelve platforming stages in any order you choose, save your friends and confront the growing threat looming over the park and its animal-themed inhabitants. Through the power of friendship (and a fox's meddling), Serval can copy the abilities of the friends she saves, giving her more offensive and defensive options when traversing stages! Use these new abilities to your advantage against the game's end-of-stage bosses. 'Serveral' features: Twelve platforming action stages! Steam Achievements track your progress! Leaderboard keep track of your best times. A plethora of difficulty options to suit a variety of skill levels. Unlock abilities and find health upgrades in stages. Configure the controls to your liking! Xinput compatible! Go on safari! Friends are hidden in the game's stages. Play at your own pace in the main story or compete for the top time in race mode! Wear a maid outfit!
row.short_description: Serval's friends are in danger and it's up to her to save the day! Progress through 12 action-packed platforming stages in this 'Kemono Friends Project' derivative work!

row.name: Meat & Greed
row.detailed_description: Meat & Greed is a 3D side scroller puzzle platformer game set in a slaughterhouse. By controlling cows, chickens, and other animals, the player has the ability to manipulate the environment to solve puzzles, and eventually escape the place. Intense atmosphere of horror and visual narration will help to convey criticisms of the modern meat industry beyond a supermarket shelf. All puzzle indie game lovers, as well as environmentally cautious players will appreciate both the moral goal and the refreshing approach to movement, switching between playable characters, and narrative design of the game.
row.short_description: In the atmospheric puzzle-platformer Meat & Greed, you will experience the horrors of a slaughterhouse from the perspective of different animals. Solve riddles and collaborate with other animals to try and escape this ill-fated factory.
row.notes: Frequent animal gore and blood

row.name: Lofi Ball
row.detailed_description: Description: 'Lofi Ball Is A 3D Platforming Game, Inspired By Super Monkey Ball And Ball Race, Dodge Obstacles And Smash Through Walls To Get To The End Of Each Level And Find Multiple Ways To Complete Levels, Mess Around In A Test Environment And Play Bonus Levels That Were Scraped From Being A Normal Level Or Just A Funny Or Random Concept' Steam Deck This Game Works On Runs Well On The Steam Deck Key Features: Ball Customization From Ball To Dice There Are Plenty Of Skins And Colors To Customize Your Ball, There Is Also Different Materials To Change Your Balls Look Plenty Of Hand Crafted Fast Paced Levels That Range In Difficulty A Endless Level Procedurally Generated Levels Timer
row.short_description: Lofi Ball Is A 3D Platforming Game, Inspired By Super Monkey Ball And Ball Race, Dodge Obstacles And Smash Through Walls To Get To The End Of Each Level And Find Multiple Ways To Complete Levels, Has Endless Mode And Infinite Levels
row.reviews: “Fun, relaxing game. I like that I could change the color and shape of my ball to add a little personality. The bananas were my favorite level due to the odd shapes. It was a good idea to add a level randomization option so that there's always a new level to roll around” Neptune “Fun, simple, and challenging. Very satisfying graphics and love the smooth controls and vibe it gives off.” Tryftz “good game, would lose track of time playing something like this. Try it out!” 8/10 – Poachedgoose

row.name: Blast Off Far Away
row.detailed_description: You are TAYGAHLOO, a proud astronaut who has just been launched into deep space on a vital mission to bring the hit cryptocurrency, Squid Coin, TO THE MOON! Literally. However, your spaceship has CRASHED, leaving you stranded in space. Worst of all, these weird SPACE SQUIDS have all come out of hiding to steal your precious limited supply of OXYGEN. You will have to maneuver from planet to planet using your trusty SPACE GUN & mighty GRAPPLING HOOK to make it out alive. With a never ending assault of squids and an ever-increasing difficulty, you will have to master these mechanics in order to survive. Hopefully by the time you get back home, your cat, Joe, hasn't emptied out the kitchen. Leap from planet to planet to replenish your ever-dwindling oxygen using your trusty space gun! Fight against an ever increasing number of enemies in an ever expanding map! Upgrade your abilities and weapons with your hard earned crypto-coins in the shop to improve your odds of survival! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Shoot to move, move to live, live to shoot! Blast Off Far Away (B.O.F.A.) is a space-themed, top-down arena shooter, with a focus on fast-paced arcade-esque gameplay, with the unique twist where movement is limited through the use of the player's gun.

row.name: Kogarashi
row.detailed_description: Kogarashi tells the story of Abura Akago, a fire demon that lived ignoring the ice demon Yuki Onna and her evil deeds, until one day she went too far and stole the soul of his mother. At that moment Abura Akago armed with his flaming sword decided to free the region from the evil ice spirit and her demon army. 3D Hack N’ Slash combat against several enemy types that will test your skills in different ways. Epic battle against a unique final boss. Two final attacks that will let you execute your enemies or unleash a fiery dragon that will push all foes away. Beautiful frozen medieval Japanese aesthetic style, featuring an original soundtrack. Optional collectibles revealing the lore of the world. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Kogarashi is a 3D Hack N' Slash game on which you control Abura Akago, a fire demon that fights against the evil spirit Yuki Onna and her army of ice demons.

row.name: FOG - Fear Of Going
row.detailed_description: F.O.G (also known as FOG) brings classic action-RPG game mechanics to a third-person camera and dynamic movement. Battle through the nine circles of hell in a psychedelic watercolor painted world. Unleash your creativity to create a character build that will take you all the way to the gates of heaven, alone or with friends. Pick five of twenty weapon types and pick one of seven damage types. When you die, come back stronger with the gear and experience points you earn. There are always new character builds to try and gear to optimize including new content and frequent updates! Massively online server is located in Washington, US for online p.v.p and co-op. Internet connection not required.
row.short_description: Your new action-RPG addiction. Battle through the circles levels of hell in a psychedelic watercolor painted world. Unleash your creativity to create a character build that will take you all the way to the gates of heaven.

row.name: Psycho地雷InLove : 싸이코지라이 인 러브
row.detailed_description: 'Excuse me... What's the menu for lunch today?' With that one word, our fling began. It's natural for a normal Eunta A, who has nothing superior, but he's never talked to a woman. Ryu Sun-ah, who greeted him warmly for the first time. Wouldn't it be okay for a lifetime with her? A, who has never been in a relationship, win the heart of Ryu Sun-ah! Eun-Tta's psycho-jirai in love, let's start! --------------- About this game & features--------------- The game is played in three phases - early, mid and late The user will have four conversations with Sun-ah in each phase, and Sun-ah will ask questions related to her once. The user answers the question based on the information obtained from the previous line with Sun-ah, and if it is correct, the likability increases and if it is incorrect, the likability decreases. This favorability determines the ending at the last phase, and users can view various CGs and illustrations. --------------- Operation--------------- Select: Right-click Metabolic progression: right-click, scroll down mouse, enter key Rollback : Scroll over mouse (Note: Rollback may cause errors) Image Skip: Keyboard ESC Key ----------------- How to play------------------- Answer Sun-ah's questions and build up affinity through in-game options. A date event will be held at the end of each of the four questions, and you can view various endings depending on your preference on the last date. -----------------Resolution------------- The game is fixed at a 16:9 ratio resolution for optimal play. Please note this when adjusting the resolution.
row.short_description: A simulation of an outcast romance!
row.notes: Contains descriptions of some blood and death

row.name: TheFighters Online
row.detailed_description: Developer Note This game was created as a passion project by a solo indie developer. Development is no longer active , and the game is provided as-is for those who wish to experience it or explore the early work of the developer. Thank you for your understanding — and for supporting indie games. Indie fighting game The game contains 3 game methods 1- Chapters 2- Local multiplayer (3D) 3- Online ( 3D ) In the Online mode, you are going to face a real person and fight them to get more and more ranks to open your mission and get EXP to build your own character and make him stronger, there are 5 Ranks in the game for each rank you are going to get EXP to build your ability, for each win, you are going to get 2 points if you lost the game, you are going to lose 2 points if you faced any problems, please send an email to (skullsameh.work@gmail.com) enjoy
row.short_description: Online fighting game

row.name: Starwalker - The Last Cylinder
row.detailed_description: The last cylinder 80 kilometers of spinning metal rock adrift in space, far, far into the future - humanity's final outpost. Inside this massive space habitat, centuries of famine, disease, war have eroded our once-mighty civilization into a medieval post-apocalyptic society and stripped away our technological heights. You enter this world with randomly assigned attributes - strength, stamina, and agility. Your mission is clear: traverse the cylinder's expanse to enhance these traits and stay alive at all costs. Born with advantages or flaws beyond your control, you must adapt to survive. Most don't make it past several hours, but hopefully you can and bring change to our broken world. 1. Humble Beginnings As A Simple Village Dweller Starting in a cluster of medieval huts, you must quickly master the basics - finding water, gathering food supplies to quench your thirst and hunger and to maintain your strength. Though the cylinder seems empty at first, other survivors will soon arrive. Some will become allies. Some want lure you into deadly traps. Choose your path carefully. Will you embrace the rugged path of a daring explorer or for the ways of a simple village dweller thriving amid the bonds of community to increase your attributes unassumingly and elevate yourself into the steampunk area? 2. Adventure Awaits Unleash your inner adventurer, and explore each and every dip and hill inside the habitat, from soaring mountains and lush meadows to serene lakes and freshwater rivers; and immerse yourself in the quiet hamlets and bustling villages peppered across the cylinder. As you traverse this untamed land, battling countless perils, you'll be growing stronger and stronger, honing your skills and mastering the arts indispensable for survival. With every kilometer traversed, you will gain 2% strength, running speed via agility, and stamina to cover even greater distances without experiencing fatigue. Complete quests for additional stat increases. 3. Rise Through The Ranks Days of survival forge you into someone extraordinary. Your heightened abilities - earned through countless trials - will give you physical prowess that not many can match and days of survival forge you into someone extraordinary.. Master the art of leadership through voice communication ('V' key). What begins as simple survival can evolve into true influence as others recognize your strength and wisdom. Forge alliances with like-minded compatriots, establish your tribe in this harsh world and become a leader truly worth following as you build a reputation among the stars. Witness your physical prowess and societal influence reach staggering heights with each day you survive as you break through barriers that would have once seemed insurmountable. Know that the competition will be fierce, but the rewards, limitless. But remember adventurer: You only have 1 life, leaving you with a single question to answer: How long will you survive? Graphics by Lighthouse.
row.short_description: Interstellar Spacepunk Survival Permadeath MMORPG. Survive in humanity's final outpost, far far into the future. Traverse the untamed land, overcome countless perils across each and every dip & hill, mountains, lush meadows and serene lakes, make new allies and build a reputation among the stars.
row.notes: Characters can fight with each other and also die.

row.name: Pewt 'em Up!
row.detailed_description: Pewt 'em Up! is a retro inspired arcade space shoot 'em up. The game features a Stage Mode in which you follow the story of Cadet Claire Voyage, a roguelite Endless Mode, lots of upgrades, achievements, extras like gallery, music player and more.
row.short_description: Pewt 'em Up! is a retro inspired arcade space shoot 'em up with lots of upgrades, achievements, extras and more.

row.name: Endlanders : First Encounter
row.detailed_description: Build your deck, glitch through enemies, translate unknown languages and decipher the mysteries of this universe, in this grid-based real time combat indie game. Endlanders features two main characters with diverging storylines in the same universe, fighting and exploring their way through vastly different planes with anachroninstic themes. The game features : A grid-based real time combat, where our two characters have distinct gameplay styles : Fast-paced tension, with multiple spells and a huge variety of enemies : A deck-building system, where cards are instant spells : And a translation system, where by collecting runes the player will be able to advance the story further : Glitching through terrain and objects to find hidden areas : The game takes place across many planes, and each character visits a few of them, exploring, researching and trying to understand a strange substance called Source, which appears on all living (and some times not) lifeforms. Players will keep their thoughts on their log which is updated throughout the game through interactions. Each character analyzes the mysteries of this substance in their own manner, offering different insights. Our two playable characters are : Cosmos, who has a more combo-oriented fast combat style, and their attacks emphasize by building combo points using 'Tempo' cards, and using 'Finisher' cards that deal more damage based on the amount of combo points. However if some time passes and they haven't landed a hit, the combo points reset to zero, and since finisher cards deal most of the damage, starting a combo but letting it fall flat will decrease the damage output. Cosmos is more concerned with the 'why' questions regarding this substance, and their log has entries that explore themes of purpose, faith and existentialism. and Quls, who has a more reactive calculated combat style, and their attacks fill the tank with gas by using 'Combiner' cards, or deplete it by using 'Diffusant' cards. However being at the edges (full tank or empty tank) might cause unexpected outcomes, such as explosions or debuffs, so the player need to be careful. Being at edges however has its own rewards, since Quls's attacks deal more damage if their chemtank is empty or full. Quls is more concerned with the 'how' questions regarding this substance, and their log has entries that revolve around how to use this substance, how to create it, and it's interactions. Our characters could be conceived as binary opposites on their thoughts and actions, however the more players indulge on the story the more they will understand that things are more complicated. The prologue only features the first plane and only 1 playable character, Cosmos.
row.short_description: Build your deck, glitch through enemies, translate unknown languages and decipher the mysteries of this universe, in this grid-based real time combat indie game. This version features only one playable character and serves as the prologue for the game.

row.name: MONSTER CARDS
row.detailed_description: Bring your original deck of cards and play against each other! That's 'MONSTER CARDS'! This game allows you to build your own deck of original cards and play against each other! Since these are your own original cards, they tend to be overpowered, but the game balance is maintained by using extremely simple game rules and a compatibility system. You'll have a blast with your family and friends playing online! 【Creating Original Cards】 The strength of a monster is determined by setting various parameters in addition to rarity, skills, and attack power. Finally, you can create your own cards by drawing the monster's appearance as you like! 【Play with your own original deck! Once you have built your deck, you can fight in card battles that can be played by up to 8 players. When your turn comes, simply play a card from your hand on the field. Determine your opponent's compatibility based on their card illustrations, and use your skills to turn the battle to your advantage! 【Recommended for...】 I like card games I like to draw pictures. Looking for games that can be played in a large group
row.short_description: Bring your original deck of cards and play against everyone!

row.name: Symphony Of Motion
row.detailed_description: WHAT´S THIS ALL ABOUT? Symphony Of Motion offers a new unique way to create and experience music without the need for any prior musical knowledge. Whether you're a seasoned musician or a complete beginner, this is a new and intuitive way to create and experience music. In its simplest form, you just move your hands around to create unique sounds, melodies, and rhythms. There are no “wrong” notes to worry about (as you always play in a specific scale) and you can always stay on perfect tempo with the build-in perfect timing assistant. For the more experienced musicians, it also offers new levels of expressional depth with its unique motion-based synthesizer modulation, multi-pitching drums/melodic pads, a lot of customization options, a built-in looper, and a drum kit creator. LIVE MOTION-BASED SYNTH MODULATION Symphony Of Motion offers a new level of depth to musical expression, as the sounds follow the movements of your hands like an orchestra follows the movement of it's conductor. You can dual play and live modulate any of the 100+ synthesizers with acceleration, angular acceleration, position and rotation - plus there are multiple different motions to modulation options to choose from that all sound different. LIVE DRUM PITCH SHIFTING You can play any drum sample at a varying pitch by tilting your wrist to different angles while playing. This gives you the ability to play unique and fresh-sounding beats with an added layer of depth in your expression. MELODIC PADS Melodic pads are percussion pads that play musical notes rather than drum hits. For example, you could create a multi-octave xylophone, orchestral drum, or cowbell set in any note or scale you want. Melodic pads also have varying pitches, so one pad can play many different notes by changing the angle of your wrist or by transposing it by pressing down on the trigger button. This allows you to play a multi-octave melody - just by hitting a single melodic pad! DRUMKIT BUILDER You can duplicate, reposition, scale, change pitch/volume/color/shape/settings, and the sample of any drum and melodic pad to make your own dream kits. LOOPER You can record, cancel and undo previous recordings with the build-in one-button looper. There's also a view where you can adjust the volume, stop or delete any previously made recordings. You can also visualize any synthesizer recording so that you can see what was being played while the loop was being recorded. PITCH BENDING While playing the synthesizer you can pitch bend from any note to any other note or play totally fretless. FEATURES Build in tutorials that guide you on your journey Drum and melodic percussion kit builder Large selection of motion reactive synthesizers and different modulation options to choose from Live pitch shifting drums Multi pitched melodic percussion pads Easy to use one button looper Recorded loops overview and volume control Perfect tempo automation (Quantization) Many customization options Mesmerizing audio-reactive environment
row.short_description: An innovative musical playground that turns your motion into music. Featuring a large selection of motion-reactive synthesizers, multi-pitched drum and melodic percussion pads, a built-in looper, and a drum kit builder that will keep you jamming for hours on end.

row.name: Downtown Jam
row.detailed_description: In Downtown Jam, pull off a selection of stylish tricks and grinds to make yourself a nuisance to the corporate overlords running your city. From the chilled-out tutorial zone, into the cities center and then out into the dark, industrial Old Town. Revolt against Dr. Taste’s evil soda corporation by shredding the streets on your skateboard! Kickflip, grind and wall-ride your way downtown and beat your friends on the leaderboard! • Customize your cool cat with different Skateboards, outfits and character skins. • 3 levels of non-stop tricking and grinding. • A simplified control scheme throwing back to the Skateboarding games of yore. • Try and reach the highest score on our global in-game leaderboard. This game was created by nine university students studying Games Development at the University of Gloucestershire.
row.short_description: Revolt against Dr. Taste’s evil soda corporation by shredding the streets on your skateboard! Kickflip, grind and wall-ride your way downtown and beat your friends on the leaderboard! Trick and grind your way onto the leaderboards or wipe trying.

row.name: Entropic Float: This World Will Decay And Disappear
row.detailed_description: The one thing made certain in the Loop Anomaly that suddenly appeared in Black Rock Desert in 2024- No matter what the individuals trapped inside might try to do, their version of the world will fade away when the clocktower strikes midnight. It's up to you to influence their choices and determine the method through which each loop will disappear. As you step into the shoes of Kanatsun, Amelie, and Rashmi over the course of nine different timelines, discover the secrets of the characters and the clocktower alike. Push your protagonist into making good choices, and see the loop simply rewind, granting its victims the opportunity to recall the events which transpired... Or dive into poor decisions and watch as Entropy overtakes the loop, leaving you the only one to remember the way the timeline fell apart. How was this Anomaly formed? Why did these particular people get trapped inside? What is the source of the Entropy, and who is the Enemy? And most of all, how can the Anomaly be escaped? Morning, Noon, and Night. Kanatsun, Amelie, and Rashmi. Explore the different permutations of this time loop and bear witness to all eighteen endings, and you just might be able to find a path to set free the fourteen individuals trapped inside the Anomalous Clocktower. ✭ Entropic Float contains 9 routes, 18 normal endings, and 1 true ending. All 18 endings are required to unlock the true ending. There is a spoiler-free walkthrough available, and the game includes options to jump from one ending to the branching point for the other ending.
row.short_description: A free drama-mystery visual novel with a modern fantasy setting. Reach out to the fourteen people trapped inside to find the truth through eighteen endings, influenced by but not exclusively bound to your own system time.
row.notes: Full list of content warnings is available from the main menu, but includes themes of death, abuse, substances, and bigotry. The game also includes adult language.

row.name: Hide And Seek Scramble!
row.detailed_description: Three players. Two teams. One kidnapped bunny! Play as three different characters in this fast-paced, competitive multiplayer game. As the Vacuum, you've captured the Bunny and are being chased! Explore the city and complete unique tasks before you're caught. As the Bunny, your job is to communicate with the Robot! Give clues to your whereabouts as you see landmarks and other hints around the world. As the Robot, use information from the Bunny to track down and stop the evil Vacuum! Ask questions and stay observant to gain the upper hand.
row.short_description: Three players. Two teams. One kidnapped bunny! Play as three different characters in this fast-paced, competitive multiplayer game.

row.name: Splat Cat
row.detailed_description: Play as an artist in this puzzle platforming game, painting their way through their discovery of art, and the creative block that lies within the medium. As the game progresses, you dive deeper and deeper into your insecurities, doubts, and fears as an artist, and begin to encounter different types of monsters while trying to reach your goal. Finally, defeat the personification of these insecurities about your art in an epic boss battle before revealing the beautiful artwork you made along the way.
row.short_description: Wielding only your paintbrush, traverse your way through this 2D platforming artistic landscape and fight your creative block!

row.name: Silver Lines
row.detailed_description: Play by listening to a line from a movie while choices of actors or movies appear on screen. Pick the correct actor and/or movie the line comes from. The faster you answer the greater your score. Some takes may show choices by name, others by image. Play 8 takes per round. How many rounds can you go? Challenge yourself in solo play, or sign up to level up, earn golden tickets, challenge your friends or the community, access cross-platform leaderboards, or suggest more movies. Your details will never be shared. Get the best scores, unlock those achievements and show everyone the master of the silver screen you truly are! Featuring Filmdom Acting Moments Thousands of acting moments throughout fildmdom's Eras and Genres. Challenge yourself and find out how far you can go. Challenges Signup and get access to cross-platform challenges after every round. Send your great run as a challenge to a friend or the community. Couch-Multiplayer Gather with friends and go against each other via local WiFi in free-for-all or team-based couch multiplayer matches. Who's that one friend that's definitely in your team? Best experienced with headphones on
row.short_description: Who's the fannest of them all?
row.notes: Some quotes and sounds from movies may contain strong language.

row.name: BRAiN VOMiTS GARDEN
row.detailed_description: BRAiN VOMiTS GARDEN is a single/multiplayer experience developed by a small group of independent artists. Our objective is to connect as many friends or strangers online to work together and discover the garden: A realistic, stylized land powered by Unreal Engine 5. Upon entering the world and sharing your name, you will have access to a number of features for your character. Throw on a fresh shirt or some kicks that best fit your style in the wardrobe room. Share your artistic creations or personal tag with others worldwide using the built-in network paint mechanics. Discover hidden realms by solving a range of puzzles. Activate cooperative side quests to uncover rare items, achievements, and story experiences. Or simply kick it with your friends and enjoy a virtual show at the central performance stage.
row.short_description: Connect with friends or strangers to explore the vast realm of BRAiN VOMiT. Paint, discover hidden sidequests, and express yourself in a beautiful, multiplayer world.

row.name: Watch Your Back
row.detailed_description: DESCRIPTION: Studios Sant Marc welcomes you to Watch Your Back, our first PC game for Steam made by Students! You are some small-time journalists, exploited by your boss. When an abandoned Cold War-era shelter is discovered, your boss sends you there to do the story of a lifetime. Only you two will know what awaits you in there... FEATURES: Explore! Discover the secrets of the shelter, investigate what happened inside there by finding refugee logs and find out how to get out of there alive! Survive! Survive in this labyrinthic shelter full of noises, obstacles and... monsters! Find a way to get around them before they hunt you down! Cooperate! You will have to decide who is exposed to the dangers of the shelter and who sacrifices himself and stays behind to watch the cameras and guide the other player to the exit. But beware, you will have to communicate with each other constantly, because only the watcher has the necessary information to escape from the shelter! Graphics! Unreal Engine 5's next-generation graphics and lighting engine brings Watch Your Back's shelter to life. All rooms are full of details.
row.short_description: You are some small-time journalists, exploited by your boss. When an abandoned Cold War-era shelter is discovered, your boss sends you there to do the story of a lifetime. Only you two will know what awaits you in there...
row.notes: Watch Your Back contains violence, blood and gore, as well as a political conspiracy plot that may be offensive to some people. It can produce jumpscares in some circumstances.

row.name: Workaholic
row.detailed_description: A miserable existence at the lowest rung in life is not for you! Armed with only your own two hands and unshakeable determination, you won't stop until you reach the top. Slaughter your way through a procedurally generated corporate building, weaponizing furniture, staplers and burnt toast, as well as more questionable contraptions, like the scammer and the KeyDoor, to reach your goal. As you defeat the weird and murderous denizens of the building your salary and power increases, while the experience gets steadily more unsettling. Other realities start seeping through the cracks of both your strained psyche and the office landscape around you, as you ascend the skyscraper toward the showdown with the final boss. Will you dominate the leaderboards by mastering the tower and taking down the boss, or will you end up face down in the gutter again?
row.short_description: Workaholic is a frantic rouge-lite FPS where you go on a rampage through a hellish office space as your grasp on reality crumbles.
row.notes: Contains depictions of violence and gore, substance abuse and gun violence in a semi-realistic workplace setting. The game also depicts altered states through flashing, bright lights and images that might not be suitable for persons with a photosensitive disorder.

row.name: Stormgate
row.detailed_description: The full Ashes of Earth campaign is available in-game for $24.99 USD. Regional pricing will vary. Plunge into the heart of battle as the ultimate battlefield commander fighting for survival in a science fantasy universe, where Earth’s fate hangs on the edge of oblivion. Human defenders and their faithful robot allies stand defiant against two warring alien factions: a race of warlike demonic invaders and their technologically advanced angelic rivals. Together, these three are locked in a relentless struggle for dominance. Stormgate puts you  in command of futuristic armies in epic real-time strategy battles. Fight for the Future Dive into the ultimate test of strategic warfare with three highly-asymmetric factions: the stalwart Human Vanguard, the relentless Infernal Host, or the highly-advanced Celestial Armada. Team up with friends and command legendary Heroes to conquer the challenging AI in co-op mode, or test your mettle on the global stage in a hero-free competitive ranked ladder focused purely on player skill. Get ready for an innovative 3v3 mode, currently in development, with a no-elimination policy to ensure you always taste victory or defeat together, as a unified team. Next Generation RTS Stormgate takes RTS gaming to new heights by harnessing the power of Unreal Engine 5, supercharged by our proprietary SnowPlay technology. This combination delivers an unparalleled responsive RTS gameplay experience. Our use of globally distributed servers aims to connect players from around the world, supported by advanced Rollback technology for silky smooth and stutter-free gameplay. This combination of cutting-edge technology and ultra-modern infrastructure mean you can focus entirely on defeating your opponents instead of struggling against lag. Explore a Post-Apocalyptic Science Fantasy Universe Stormgate’s story-driven Campaign drops players into the role of mighty Heroes fighting for the fate of the world. The free Vanguard prologue chapter includes three playable missions, with more campaign chapters available for purchase and new chapters to be released. Gameplay Evolved Flex your skills with an enhanced interface designed for both depth and approachability. With streamlined inputs and automatic control groups, it’s easier than ever before to just have fun while leaving the skill ceiling sky-high for those who want to push themselves to their limits. Unleash Your Creativity The Editor empowers you to craft your own game experiences with the most advanced yet user-friendly RTS toolset available. Integrated seamlessly within the Stormgate client, it allows for swift iteration and polish of your maps, mods, and custom games. Sculpt intricate terrain, customize units, and then share your creations with the community. With the Editor, ignite your imagination and bring your unique visions to life–you’re invited to redefine the boundaries of RTS gameplay.
row.short_description: Stormgate is a free-to-play RTS in active development. Featuring competitive 1v1, 3P co-op missions, and an evolving campaign, Frost Giant aims to build the next great RTS, guided by player feedback. A 3v3 mode is also on the way, so join our development journey today!
row.reviews: “As a competitive RTS, Stormgate is what's next” 8/10 – IGN “Stormgate is definitely an RTS title worth playing” Game Rant “Stormgate is shaping up to be a brilliant blend of modern and classic RTS” PC Gamer

row.name: LUNARBALL
row.detailed_description: Kick, punch and dribble your way to success in LUNARBALL, your next favourite sport! Featuring 3v3 team-based gameplay, play with random queued players in Quickplay, or organise a custom match in the Server Browser.
row.short_description: Competitive 3v3, team-based sport set in space! Kick, dribble and punch your way to victory!

row.name: Zuria
row.detailed_description: Build your own unique tank! Using special tool you can create unique shape. With this tool you can: Scale chassis parts Move and rotate any part But you have to follow some rules: Don't leave parts midair Don't make parts intersect each other Dont exceed chassis, movement, weaponry and modules points Following these rules you can immediately test your machine If you are satisfied with results, save and battle with other players!
row.short_description: Build your own tank and battle with other players! Using building tool create unique shape, add weapons, movement and compete with other players in construction skills.

row.name: NecroCity: Prologue
row.detailed_description: CHECK OUT MORE GAMES FROM OUR FRIENDS About the Game NecroCity: Prologue is a part of the full version of NecroCity and is completely free. The most important is that prologue allows you to get into the world of NecroCity so you will be fully ready before the final product release! Welcome to NecroCity: Prologue, a mix of city building, strategy and tower defense. Defend your undead outposts from the persistent forces of the so-called “good”! Show those living what rattles your bones with an army of skeletons! Show your older brother that you are no longer a child! File your taxes! That’s right, take on the role of the young Prince of Undead, trying to prove himself. Expand the bureaucratic glory of the Undead Kingdom across all the lands by establishing new outposts. Summon workers, mine bones, capture souls, and protect your Ziggurat at all costs. Place traps, employ ghosts and skeletons, use magic, add mods to spice things up, or ask your friends - Ghouls to help you out. It is up to you to pick the best strategy! All is quiet in the Undead Kingdom, the land of order and structure, ruled by the bureaucratic Lich King. That is until his younger brother sets out to prove his worth and accidentally gets way over his head. Help the young Prince establish new outposts across the vibrant world and defend them from the stubborn heroes and other varying forces of good. Build your outposts on varied grid-based maps. Summon adorable skeleton workers to gather and produce resources, and power your building with (Necro)Energy™. Explore the area, adapt to your surrounding and be prepared to face waves of enemies. Use active pause in the game to develop a strategy. Build extravagant defences, using walls to route your enemies and strategically placing traps. Turn your workers into deadly soldiers by building barracks and towers. Strengthen your defences even further with a range of passive buildings and mods. With a unique system of mods, you can change the way your very defences work. Add chain lightning to your fireballs or use your enemies’ very own life force to heal your soldiers! Or why not both? Mix and match different mods to better suit the situation you found yourself in. Meet and befriend a cast of interesting characters. And then send them to fight for you on a field of battle! Discover new allies, listen to them bicker, learn their abilities and upgrade them to make them stronger. Pick when to deploy and use their skills since good timing can turn around the course of a fight.
row.short_description: NecroCity: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Take on the role of the young Prince of Undead, trying to prove himself in the world of the Undead Kingdom. Push back the hordes of monsters and build your fortress! 🔥

row.name: Portal with RTX
row.detailed_description: Portal with RTX is a free DLC for all Portal owners developed by NVIDIA Lightspeed Studios. Experience the critically acclaimed and award-winning Portal™ reimagined with ray tracing and NVIDIA DLSS 4 with Multi Frame Generation Every frame of gameplay is upgraded with stunning full ray tracing, new, hand-crafted hi-res physically based textures, and new, enhanced high-poly models evocative of the originals, all in stunning 4K.  In Portal with RTX, full ray tracing transforms each level, enabling light to bounce and be affected by the scene’s geometry and materials. Every light is ray-traced and casts shadows, global illumination indirect lighting naturally illuminates and darkens rooms, volumetric ray-traced lighting scatters through fog and smoke, and shadows are pixel perfect. The addition of RTX Neural Radiance Cache also enhances the quality of ray-traced indirect lighting, while improving performance resulting in a more accurate and responsive lighting model. Portal with RTX is compatible with all ray-tracing capable GPUs.
row.short_description: Experience the critically acclaimed and award-winning Portal™ reimagined with full ray tracing and DLSS 4 in this free DLC for Portal owners. Start thinking with portals, with RTX on.

row.name: Yeah Jam Fury
row.detailed_description: GET THE MANGO The Newgrounds classic Yeah Jam Fury now has a new permanent home on Steam! Test your speed and ingenuity in over 40 levels of smiling face blocks. Utilize all three of your egos to create blocks, scale walls, and destroy everything in the way of your righteous fruit! Default Control Scheme: A, D - move left, right W, Space - jump 1 - switch to Yeah 2 - switch to Jam 3 - switch to Fury Q - quickswitch M - see mango location P - Pause And remember, controls are always available in the settings menu. Enjoyed this game? Check out its sequel below!
row.short_description: Yeah Jam Fury tests your speed and ingenuity in over 40 levels of smiling face blocks. Utilize all three of your egos to create blocks, scale walls, and destroy everything in the way of your righteous fruit!

row.name: Knock & Run
row.detailed_description: JOIN OUR DISCORD About the Game Get ready to flex those skills! Knock & Run is a fun PvP game where you gotta hit your opponents with your balls to emerge victorious. Objective: Be the last player remaining on the field to win the game! Instructions: Transform a white ball to your color by touching it. Use the balls in your color to knock down other players. Keep playing until only one player is left standing, and that player will be declared the winner! Features Unique casual game, score as much as you can. Endless fun! Local multiplayer - up to 4 players 5 types of maps, procedurally generated Credits Narrator: Trenton Castillo We would like to extend our gratitude to Maya for her valuable support and creative ideas, and to Oded for contributing to the initial concept!
row.short_description: Grab an orb and prepare to fight - It's about to go down. Compete your friends and knock down everyone!

row.name: Kaz's Adventure
row.detailed_description: Return To A Familiar Style Of 2D Platformers Kaz's Adventure aims to faithfully recreate the charm and fun of the old games we used to enjoy but with a present day gameplay twist and additions Traverse Through 5 Amazing Worlds! Kaz's Adventure has 5 amazing worlds to explore and defeat with 6 levels in each of the worlds Collect Jars Of Power! In each level you can find a jar to collect, Reaching certain milestones will unlock new modes and levels to play and enjoy Dangerous & Unique Enemies Throughout your travels you'll encounter different enemy's in different worlds, some may be from a previous world but mutated in a way that makes it act different or new enemies which make your time in that new world unique and exciting Create Your Own Levels Create Your Own Levels In The Level Editor Which Can Be Unlocked By Reaching A Certain Milestone In Collectibles
row.short_description: Traverse through 5 beautifully designed worlds with over 30 fun and exciting levels and try out the CO-OP mode with an extra 2 worlds worth of free content!
row.reviews: “Too many games these days release without the modern quality of life features such as achievements, and cloud saves. Kaz's Adventure does an outstanding job at both, as seen throughout the title and game. Achievements are clearly one of the strongest points of the game, and I would love to see more in-game.” 10/10 – QA Beta Tester
row.notes: This Game Includes References To Trauma And Jumpscares, If You Experience Anything You Deem Abnormal, Please Stop Playing And Talk To Someone Or Consult A Doctor!

row.name: Drain Runner
row.detailed_description: Venture into The Drain's treacherous waterways in Drain Runner, a student project made by a group of aspiring game developers! Play as Killbert, a stubborn criminal scavenger who braves The Drain at the promise of priceless treasures from a bygone era. Use his magnetic arm and killer instinct to survive the denizens that inhabit The Drain as you rail-grind and blast your way through a series of evocative trashpunk environments. Collect valuable items and complete objectives to improve your odds of survival! Core mechanics: - Rail grind on pipes to quickly get out of harm's way and gain a positional advantage on enemies - Watch as The Drain itself evolves in real time during your playthrough - Attract and repulse objects with Killbert's magnetic arm - Complete objectives and explore the environment to get powerful buffs - Master traversal to escape The Drain's intermittent floods as they wash pieces of the level away Controls: WASD - Move Left Click - Shoot Right Click - Magnetize E (on ground) - Melee E (on rail) - Boost E (in air) - Ground Slam E (with magnetized item) - Repulse S (on rail) - Switch directions A/D - Switch orientation
row.short_description: Survive the ever-evolving hazards of The Drain as you rail grind, magnetize, blast and ground pound your way through this fast-paced action roguelike!
