row.name: STRIKERS
row.detailed_description: Overview STRIKERS is an indie fighting game where if you get hit once, you lose. Battle using the Heroes and Villains of the multiverse in Arcade mode to unlock skins and lore, or challenge others and see who is a better fighter! Game Features LOCAL MULTIPLAYER 1v1 matches including Team Duals and LOCAL CLASH MODE Play SINGLE PLAYER ARCADE mode to unlock Character Skins and Lore Try out TRAINING MODE to test out Characters and hone your skills! CLASH MODE Intro TUTORIAL Background Starting off as a hobby, STRIKERS has been a passion project I've been developing in my free time and is finally in a state for a proper release. With many ideas for more characters, mechanics, game modes, online multiplayer, I plan on improving and adding new features with time. MORE COMING SOON! Game controllers are not required for single-player but are Highly recommended
row.short_description: STRIKERS is an indie fighting game where if you get hit once, you lose. Battle using the Heroes and Villains of the multiverse in Arcade mode to unlock skins and lore, or challenge others and see who is a better fighter!
row.notes: Minor blood effects when characters die

row.name: 防疫英雄
row.detailed_description: 这是一款休闲益智类游戏。根据经典的PVZ类游戏的核心玩法的基础上，创新题材，创新无尽模式。游戏是以国内抗战疫情为背景，以医生团队为抗议前线，全国各个行业来支援，人民群众凝聚在一起共同抗议的故事。游戏内巧妙的将医生，志愿者，医疗物品等物资，转化为游戏内的防疫武器，通过人民群众来获得凝聚力，击败病毒。通过计算击败病毒的个数，来判定游戏是否成功。
row.short_description: 这是一款休闲益智类游戏。根据经典的PVZ类游戏的核心玩法的基础上，创新题材，创新无尽模式。

row.name: Costly Adventure
row.detailed_description: Costly Adventure blends a casual Match-3 game with roguelite elements. Instead of geometric shapes, the player matches the party members to perform attacks. Through talent choices each character can contribute to the battle in their own way. Choose from 4 specializations and make your own build by picking talents and itemization. World Going on an adventure to find a mighty artifact is a lot of fun but it is also a costly activity. Especially with Troll guarding every single bridge and demanding payment. The further you go, the more expensive it gets. Luckily, you can beat the gold out of the plenty treasure chests that are laying around. But beware, you are in a strange world and not all chests are just going to sit there and take the beating. Features 5 fantasy characters to match 3 powerful specializations to choose from 24 unique talents to change your play-style 30 levels with choices along the way 3 boss battles to overcome Hard mode to challenge yourself Achievements to collect Attributes and items to make your dream build
row.short_description: In Costly Adventure, Match-3 gameplay meets the concept of roguelite runs. Party of adventurers is seeking a mighty artifact but they must meet the ever increasing payment demands from the bridge Troll.

row.name: Farming Fever - Pizza and Burger Cooking game
row.detailed_description: Farming Fever combines elements of business, time management, and cooking games. Go through the story step by step and open new farms. Show off your culinary skills and build a cozy farm for your family! While playing, you'll be able to visit and explore many exciting farms. Here are some of them: Golden Farm: Harvest fruit and berries to make sweet pastries and jam. Open an authentic village bakery! Fish Farm: Hone your culinary skills at the House by the Lake. Surprise your customers with exquisite seafood options! Township: Build a barn and raise all kinds of animals, from chickens and cows to fluffy alpacas! Green Farm: Grow rare flowers and make your own flowerpots. Become a gardening legend! Develop your own strategy and make it big in this unique farming simulator. Set off for the village and start your very own farm adventure
row.short_description: Farming Fever is an engaging time management game where you can become both a farmer and a chef at the same time. You'll have to manage your farm, harvest crops, cook, and complete customers' orders.

row.name: PHOBOS Project
row.detailed_description: Face up to your deepest fears in PHOBOS Project, a nightmarish immersive game experience where your own phobia comes to life ! Phobos Project is a first-person adventure game exploring the depths of psychological horror. In this experiment you have to find a way out and keep your sanity level up through different hostile environments. Face your dread and try to find the source of the nightmare. Explore the different levels and solve the puzzles to move forward. Immerse yourself into creepy levels. From a wide dark forest to the oppressive streets of a city by night, you have to cross many dangers and find your way home. Survive the many threats and monsters that lurk in the dark. Hide or run to prevent the program from crashing and endure the experiment. PHOBOS Project program needs to restart. An unknown error has occurred... Please note that this game contains flashing light. It is also strongly recommended that NO ONE with any heart conditions, anxiety, stroke, seizure or anything of the sort play this game; this game is extremely high on suspense, and does include scares which will increase heart rate, and include a sense of uncomfortably. By playing this game, you acknowledge that you are playing at your own risk.
row.short_description: Phobos Project is a first-person psychological horror adventure exploring the depths of psychological horror. In this experiment you have to find a way out and keep your sanity level up through different hostile environments. Face your dread and try to find the source of the nightmare !

row.name: Heart Lake心湖
row.detailed_description: 'I have ten friends, ten family members, ten are me, and I'm not alone.' 'It's our daily life, we're just here peacefully living the life we ​​want.' 'I don't want to lose anyone, anyone in my family, everyone here ... is so important to me.' The story does not involve any painful memories of Lin Yi, but mainly shows the daily life of Lin Yi and each personality in the inner world. ◇About experience◇ This is a role-playing first-person-view-pixel-style game that includes an online virtual-pixel museum, adding a little bit of gameplay to the experience. By controlling the online Virtual Museum tour, players accidentally come to one small space after another, experiencing their relaxed and happy daily life in the special inner spiritual world of the protagonists. Changes in the internal world are often related to real-world experiences, but this book only describes some of the internal world of the daily story, but also hope you see what you see, see what you don't see, hear what you hear, hear what you don't hear. ◇About the characters◇ Pixel image Lin Yi Initial personality / main personality, gentle and introverted, cautious, cherish every family member. Lin Qi The first child personality, the first to emerge, the longest-lived, is responsible for sustaining the trauma. Appeared when Lin Yi was subjected to domestic violence, bearing the pain and carrying painful memories instead of Lin Yi. Lin Sen The first guardian personality, Lin Yi's brother, the main guardian personality, knows the personality system well. Shortly after Lin Yi's younger brother Lin Yi was born, he was beaten and scolded by his father. When Lin Yi was young, he longed for someone to stand up and protect himself, and Lin Sen was born. Mute Quiet, peaceful, friendly, caring for family, assertive, unable to speak, communicates with others through sign language. Appeared when Lin Yi was scolded by her father and mother and asked her to shut up, to bear verbal scolding for Lin Yi, and was a depression holder. Song Yutang The second child personality, the inner self-help personality, the ideal childhood, is the first social personality - Song Xian's younger brother. Appears when Lin Yi is playing with her childhood playmates, preserving Lin Yi's happy and happy memories, living Lin Yi's ideal life, and other personalities in the personality system are also protecting her from harm. Song Xian Gentle, have their own opinions, know what they want and don't want, don't like being defined by others, don't care about other people's eyes. The first social personality, Song Xian, can play the piano and work instead of Lin Yi in school. She was born when Lin Yi was bullied by her classmates at school and did not want to go to school or communicate with others. It is a personality that is completely opposite to Lin Yi's own personality, origin and many other aspects. Song Xian's parents are very supportive of Song Xian's music dream, and it was his mother Wei Ruqing who discovered Song Xian's singing talent by chance, and asked a teacher to teach Song Xian to sing and teach him about music theory since he was a child. The mouse is a border shepherd puppy with black and white patterns that Song Xian raised when he was 17 years old. Dragonfly Lin Yi, who was alone in the room after suffering, recalled how carefree he was when playing with his playmates outside. Lin Yi wanted to become as free as a dragonfly, to have simple happiness, and to fly away from himself. Noisy and restless families live by the quiet and warm waters, from which dragonflies are born. It was born when Lin Yi was bullied by classmates and had the idea of ​​not going to school and not wanting to communicate with others. Pei Qiubai The second guardian personality, gentle, kind, and understanding. In place of the image of a music teacher, he is good at playing the piano. After Lin Yi's piano enlightenment teacher resigned, she was born to make up for the lack of care in her heart. The image of her sister protects Lin Yi in her own way. Pianoforte The sub-personality, the personality that stays only in the inner world, is keen on playing the piano and is taciturn. A personality created at the moment Lin Yi's music box was smashed. Wei Ruqing Child personality, mother role. She is the mother of the first social personality - Song Xian and the second child personality - Song Yutang. After his parents divorced, Lin Yi was sentenced to his mother, who was very harsh on Lin Yi. Lin Yi longed for maternal love and hoped to have a mother who could truly love her. Wei Ruqing was born out of this desire. Yu Feng The second social personality, Yu Feng, is a tough and straightforward character. Born when Lin Yi first entered the workplace, because his colleagues looked down on Lin Yi's rural background, he often gossips behind his back, and sometimes imposes his job on Lin Yi. When Lin Yi is not good at rejecting others, he will appear instead of Lin Yi, frankly address other people's mistakes, and simply reject others' requests. ◇About the operation◇ Contains automatic archiving. It can be operated in both mouse and keyboard mode, and it is recommended to use the keyboard as the main method. Arrow keys - manipulate the character to move Z key/Enter/Space - confirm X key/Ese - menu key/Cancel/Return Shift key - control the current character to run All items in the space can be dialogued, and important clues and props will have special prompts, and dialogue can advance the plot. ◇About the process◇ It mainly focuses on watching a few short stories, without puzzle solving or too many small game elements. The overall flow of the game is about 30~60 minutes The ending is an open ending, and the plot contains only one line.
row.short_description: Heart Lake is a first-person pixel-style game. Different personalities have different and distinct personalities. Players experience different journeys in the process of getting along with different personalities, and finally help the protagonist grow up.

row.name: Ignited Steel: Prologue
row.detailed_description: More great games About the Game If you've enjoyed the Prologue, check out the main game! The beginning of the Ignited Steel universe. In this prologue, we add even more content to the story behind the Ignited Steel project, where you will see the beginning of the evil flaw that turned machines against humankind. Two new characters, new weapons, new biomes and new enemies will be added to Ignited Steel. Play as Exa Falris and F-OS V0.1 to see how things went after the incident that turned Phar0s against its own creators. Aiming to fulfill its expansion instinct, humanity created an A.I. which controls and manages all necessary resources to expand the human race throughout the galaxy. Soon, a fatal flaw in the A.I. 'PharOS' code was discovered: it could not and would not stop expanding. With the hope to halt PharOS’ expansion, the human race depends on 'The Ignited Steel” program, a plan reliant on outdated technology which PharOS cannot control. Old Mechs from past wars are now humanity’s only hope. Attacking and moving mechs requires energy and can overheat the mech. If overheated, mechs output more damage while being more vulnerable to enemy attacks. A key element to gameplay is finding the perfect balance between damage and vulnerability. Pilots from every corner of the universe volunteer to the Ignited Steel program, each bringing their unique personalities and tactics. As the Ignited Steel program regains control of the galaxy, new pilots will join the cause against PharaOS. There're 3 types of mechs: Juggernaut, Stalker and Javelin, each with their own advantages and counterplay. Mechs are built using unique modules each with their own purpose. As the Ignited Steel program liberates the galaxy, they will earn and purchase new modules with unique traits. The galaxy is full of contrasting planets and stories to be told. By jumping from node to node the ignited steel program will discover the galaxy's stories, and add new modules and pilots to the crew. New planets, pilots, modules, events and missions in every playthrough!
row.short_description: Ignited Steel is a mech roguelike turn-based-tactics game. This Prologue features a free standalone campaign where you will discover the origins of the robotic insurrection, as well as the new features added to the main game on Patch v1.1: Uprising.

row.name: Memory Hunters
row.detailed_description: In this fantasy adventure you will meet Tristan, a Protector of Sidra, called to complete a mission that will take him further than usual. A classic RPG where you will experience unique places, solve puzzles, fight turn-based battles and live an exciting adventure. Over 10 hours of gameplay 30 unique places to explore Dozens of puzzles to solve Over 60 different enemies to face Key items, consumables and equipment Characters with specific classes and skills Made by a solo developer
row.short_description: A classic RPG where you will experience unique places, solve puzzles, fight turn-based battles and live an exciting adventure.

row.name: Havenhold
row.detailed_description: Havenhold is an Action Sandbox MMO set in an ancient Eastern world.  Wield powerful Primordial Avatars  and engage in real-time conflict between rival Mountain Sects . Experience dynamic combat with  parry, block, and directional attacks in skill-based duels, large-scale 100 player siege wars , and chaotic open-world skirmishes. Outside of battle, craft gear, gather resources, and make strategic choices to build your tribe’s power. Construct, conquer, and ascend the sacred peak. PRIMORDIAL AVATARS Uncover and wield the powers of ancient primordials, each with their own unique set of abilities. Unlock and level up abilities to customize and evolve your play style.  FOUND YOUR SECT Create a sect with like-minded warriors and build your mountain stronghold. Unity is the foundation of everything, and teamwork is the ultimate key to victory. ALL OUT WAR Victory in Havenhold isn’t just about skill—it’s about commanding the battlefield. Seasonal warfare erupts between rival factions, where every player’s contribution can shift the tides of conflict. Rally your allies, coordinate large-scale assaults, and siege enemy strongholds in brutal PvP battles. Only through strategy, synergy, and sheer force will your faction rise to claim the peak. TRADE EVERYTHING From resources and consumables, to crafted gear and cosmetics, trade with other players and accumulate wealth. The world of Havenhold is built upon a player economy where everything has value.  THE MOUNTAIN CALLS Whether you're engaged in small skirmishes or larger PvP battles, the stakes are high, and the competition is fierce. Work with your allies, compete for access to the sacred peak - and claim your place at the end of each season.
row.short_description: Havenhold is an Action Sandbox MMO inspired by the ancient Far East. Train as a warrior monk, wield primordial powers, craft, trade, and expand your influence, then unite the martial world through conquest and glory.

row.name: Arali
row.detailed_description: Fight your way through hordes of enemies, rescue the five forest spirits and bring them back to their tree, and lift the curse plaguing the Enchanted Forest! Wander through the forest, and witness the embers of the curse dripping from the trees and seeping through the rocks. You’ll come across a few enemies here and there, but I’m sure that it’s nothing you can’t handle. When you do come across a forest spirit, the curse will manifest itself and block you into an area. You won’t be able to leave until you clear that encounter. Alternate between fighting at a distance, shooting feathers at your enemies while bobbing and weaving between their bullets, and piercing through multiple enemies with your dash. Your dash grants you invincibility! Outside of attacking, you can also use it to quickly and safely reposition yourself during an encounter. As you gather forest spirits and bring them back to their tree, you’ll grow stronger! Be careful, though, your enemies will rise to your challenge, getting tougher and tougher as the game goes on. Pleasant isometric graphics Boppin’ music Silky smooth controls Tough but fair gameplay This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Fight your way through hordes of enemies, rescue the five forest spirits and bring them back to their tree, and lift the curse plaguing the Enchanted Forest!

row.name: Burning Requiem: Fates
row.detailed_description: 'Burning Requiem: Fates' is a new 2-On-2 Indie Fighting Game produced by Project Requiem! Seeking to shake up the fighting game formula to bring some new flair! Featuring characters coming from the new tie in webcomic series of 'Burning Requiem'! The game features modes such as tag team, single, Arcade, Survival and more! With an ever expanding roster, there's a fighter for all types of players Burning Requiem: Fates Is Playable On Steam (pc) Releases - July 20th Thank you for your continued support and stay tuned for future BR News!
row.short_description: 'Burning Requiem: Fates' is a new 2-On-2 Indie Fighting Game produced by Project Requiem! Seeking to shake up the fighting game formula to bring some new flair! Featuring characters coming from the new tie in webcomic series of 'Burning Requiem'!

row.name: Dark and Darker
row.detailed_description: Free to Play Version! The free version of Dark and Darker allows players to create one character and play Normal mode on all maps, complete quests, and build a stash of loot! Players who enjoy their time with the free version and want to experience everything the game has to offer can upgrade to the full version for 15 Redstone shards (equivalent to $30.00). The full version of the game includes access to the High-Roller mode, where players can equip their hard-earned gear to take on even more dangerous dungeons and increase the stakes. Players will also gain full access to the marketplace where they can trade with other adventurers, 9 total character slots, and the Shared Stash! We hope that this version will give players a chance to experience some of what Dark and Darker has to offer and to give players who have not played since the playtests a chance to see what's new before they dive into the full edition. Upgrade to Legendary Status! About the Game An Unforgiving Hardcore First-Person Fantasy Dungeon Adventure. Unfathomable fortunes await the brave and the foolish willing to delve into the devastated depths of an ancient citadel. Band together with your friends and use your courage, wits, and cunning to uncover mythical treasures, defeat gruesome monsters, while staying one step ahead of the other devious treasure-hunters. Once you’ve plundered your riches, now comes the hard part, getting out alive. Find the hidden escape routes before the ever-expanding darkness reclaims your riches and your corpse to her irresistible hoard. Irresistibly Classic Dark and Darker aims to capture the wonder and awe of classic fantasy adventure games. We stand on the shoulders of giants and strive to pay respects to the traditions of the genre. We hearken back to the old worlds where danger lurks around each corner, but where courage and adventure are rewarded with untold riches. Choose a role, party up! Team up with friends and assemble a party to increase your chances of survival. Choose from a wide array of timeless fantasy roles and build the perfect three-person squad. Play as a brawny barbarian holding the frontlines while your sharp-eyed ranger friend fires arrows from afar and your merry bard sustains morale with a lively tune. Unforgivingly Hardcore Dark and Darker is a world of high risks and high returns. Explore a mystical underground fortress where the dangers are unrelenting and even the smallest misstep can result in death. Sound judgement reaps huge rewards, but death carries a heavy penalty with the loss of all your loot. A focus on First-Person Combat Dark and Darker strives for high immersion. Adventurers must use their eyes and ears like you would in the real world. Players must target, track, and aim against the countless challenges they encounter. We supply a wide array of close combat weapons that each have unique patterns to learn and master. Strikes to the head and back do critical damage. Knowing how to properly wield each weapon gives the player an edge to survive in this harsh world. Old Magic Magic is a powerful but unwieldy force in the world of Dark and Darker. Mastery requires long incantations, special skills, the right channeling equipment, and a tactical eye. Spells must be timed and aimed for maximum effect. For the magically uninclined, tinkering, knowledge of special equipment, and a little foresight can help level the field. Comfort in the Shadows The darkness is your friend in this unrelenting setting. Turn off lights and use the darkness to hide from foes or set up ambushes. If the tides of battles take a turn for the worse, blending into the darkness can lead to a stealthy retreat. Escape! Discover hidden portals to delve deeper and deeper underground and uncover the most hideous monsters and invaluable artifacts. All the riches you collect are for naught if you can’t make it out alive. Find a rare exit before the dark swarm comes to collect your soul.
row.short_description: An unforgiving hardcore fantasy FPS dungeon PvPvE adventure. Band together with your friends and use your courage, wits, and cunning to uncover mythical treasures, defeat gruesome monsters, while staying one step ahead of the other devious treasure-hunters.
row.notes: Graphic Violence, Gore, Use of Alcohol.

row.name: Pathmaster
row.detailed_description: Magics and Wonders, Royals and Nobles that have powers, Man like species such as Anthros and Elves. 『Pathmaster』 presents you a world which is full of familiar, but unrealistic features. Features - There are more than one choices that you can choose. We have six Heroines. - There are many possibilities to reach. There are more than 16 endings. - Play a prank on ones destiny. A simple but challenging puzzle game is included. - Perhaps there maybe a secrets hidden inside the game.
row.short_description: 『Pathmaster』 is a free fantasy visual novel with multi endings and various heroines.

row.name: 三毫子大冒險
row.detailed_description: With relatively cheap price, short and easily understandable story, “30 Cents Novel” widely accepted as popular public entertainment among Hong Kong during the 1950s and the 1960s. The name of “30 Cents Novel” is because every volume was sold only 30 cents HKD. As a kind of entertainment for fast consumption, these novels are produced to be disposable that only limited copies have survived today. By merging and rewriting the story form original texts and true events in the reality, 'The Adventure of 30 Cents Novel' recreated dozens of 30 cents novels into a playable visual novel. The official released version contains many plot lines and over 10 endings. Only those completed all storylines can understand the entire story and characters’ relationship behind. The idea of the game 'The Adventure of 30 Cents Novel' stems from the exhibition 'Memories of Our City: Hong Kong Literature from Yesterday into Tomorrow', cooperated by National Museum of Taiwan Literature and Research Centre for Chinese Literature and Literary Culture (RCCLLC) at The Education University of Hong Kong. In that time, we hope to produce a game that can be shown and played by visitors in the exhibition. Due to unforeseen circumstances, it unfortunately could not be achieved in the exhibition. Eventually, the completed script is transformed into a visual novel, a simple format of game media, which is a rare cultural recreation based on Hong Kong literature. We are grateful to the supports from Faculty of Humanities at The Education University of Hong Kong, the production team “Frozen Veggies Kulturkreis”, and scholars researching on Hong Kong literature. Apart from the official release, there are more DLC coming in the future. Please enjoy.
row.short_description: 'The Adventure of 30 Cents' recreated dozens of 30 cents novels into a playable visual novel, with some AI illustration support. The official released version contains plots of line and over 10 endings. Only those completed all storylines can understand the entire story and relationship behind.
row.notes: There were many killings and light porn in the 30 cents novel, support the living of the writers in the 1950s to 1960s.

row.name: Space Rescue
row.detailed_description: Space Rescue is made for the BOOOM , a GameJam holded by GCORES. About This Game The precious Energy Spinels've been stolen! Players will navigate a tiny spaceship to slip into the puzzle where the Energy Spinels hidden. They have to glide up and down, avoiding a series of obstrucles, and eventually carry the Spinels back to their mother planet. As a casual puz-act, 《Space Rescue》isn't complicated to handle, just control '←'+'→' with switching several skills Spinels given to. To be worthy of attention, navigating a spaceship is not similar to driving a car——you might lose the sense of direction! Come and get the Energy Spinels back ~ Words From the Developers Thank you all for your support of our game. This work was born from a Game Jam we participated in after work, due to the limited level, the game itself has many shortcomings. However, with the advice of some friends, we decided to put this game on Steam for free so that more players can play our game. We are currently working on a puzzle game 'Line Time' in our spare time, which is expected to be available on Steam later. (You can search this game in Itch.io) However, due to the limited time of developers and development, the progress is very slow at the moment, and we hope that the subsequent development can be successfully completed. Finally, thank you again for liking and supporting our game ~
row.short_description: Space Rescue is a special space adventure game.You will navigate a tiny spaceship to slip into the puzzle where the Energy Spinels hidden. They have to glide up and down, avoiding a series of obstrucles, and eventually carry the Spinels back to their mother planet.

row.name: Special Gulag Rescue Operation
row.detailed_description: Check Out Our Other Games! About the Game You are an ordinary mechanic, minding your own business in your hometown of Mariupol. When the barbarians came and took away your people and put them in gulags, you knew you had to put down your wrench and pick up a gun! Save your people by invading the Russian gulag and shooting your way through. Listen to the tunes of the wonderful Ukraine War Protest Songs by John Lopker and channel your anger into a fast-paced combat in this funny action top-down shooter. Features: - procedurally generated Gulag - different layout every time you play - your memory won't help you here - action-packed and fast-paced combat - a game that is not fair - there is no save, you either save them, or you don't - a beautiful girl mechanic who is ready to kill to protect her country and her people!
row.short_description: When the barbarians came and took away your people and put them in gulags, you knew you had to put down your wrench and pick up a gun! Play as an ordinary mechanic from Mariupol in this procedurally generated top-down shooter.

row.name: Veggie Menace
row.detailed_description: During a vegetable contest in the Middle Ages, one of the participants tried to cheat by casting a spell to make their vegetables bigger. It fails and ends up bringing the vegetables to life. Due to this situation, the villagers call Megi, a powerful little traveling witch with magic powers in order to protect their hoses and finish with the vegetable’s invasion. To do this, Megi will need to go through the outside of the village into the main castle trying to find the invasion’s origin and defeat the vegetables that are haunting the villagers, bringing everything back to normal. Cartoony medieval and fantasy-themed 2D run-and-gun platformer Play cooperatively with the supported 2-player Local coop mode Featured abilities: fast speed, quick-dash ability, and powerful magic projectiles! Languages: English, Spanish, Finish, Polish, Catalan, Basque Veggie Menace is a project developed by Pigment Krew, a team of 2nd Year students at DigiPen Institute of Technology Europe - Bilbao in a 9-month development cycle from the ground up using C++ to develop their engine and game.
row.short_description: After a failed spell during a vegetable contest in the Middle Ages, the vegetables come to life and try to invade the civilization. A little witch with her magic powers will need to fight against this invasion.

row.name: Fanatic Zeal
row.detailed_description: Rogue-lite Quarter View Hack&Slash. Grab treasure from chests or shop to face stronger enemies in further stages. Online score ranking board (for each difficulties)
row.short_description: Rogue-lite Quarter View Hack&Slash. Bosses have randomly chosen traits, and you will get different treasure in each play. Online score ranking board (for each difficulties)

row.name: Weeping Falls Massacre
row.detailed_description: January 25th, 1992 Eric Stoll awakens from another nightmare about his past. Over a decade has passed and he's still haunted by it. His mind is made up, he must return to Weeping Falls Orphanage the site of a gruesome massacre. Play as Eric while you try to uncover what really happened during the events leading up to the massacre. Decypher the evidence or die trying. Perhaps save a long-lost friend. Will Eric survive the night and bring an end to this dark chapter of his life? Play Weeping Falls Massacre and find out. Weeping Falls Massacre is an FPS horror game with a 1-2 hour playtime. The game is released as free to play but if you would like to support TaintedPact, you can purchase the Weeping Falls Massacre soundtrack right here on Steam as DLC.
row.short_description: 80's horror inspired FPS, a nightmarish scene taking place at an abandoned orphanage.

row.name: MetaDOS
row.detailed_description: Greeting Timeseekers! Let’s gather to dive into a massive Battle Royale using the Time-as-currency concept. Enjoy faster and more intense battles with the concept of Time. MetaDOS is a Battle Royale where you play as legendary characters (Known as The Hunters) with powerful abilities team up to battle in a Tournament with various skills and compete to become the last man or last squad standing. MEET THE NEW HUNTERS AND FACE THEIR ABILITIES Choose your Hunter, each with their own unique personality, strengths, and abilities that are easy to pick up but challenging to truly master. The game also offers a range of features to enhance your gaming experience, from immersive graphics and effects to intuitive controls and seamless gameplay. YOUR TIME, YOUR LIFE Every second counts. All Hunters need to constantly earn, manage, and protect your remaining seconds. Survive by taking down other Hunters and looting Time Capsule and Supply Box across the island. The longer you last, the greater your rewards. EXCLUSIVE SKIN AND COSMETICS Elevate your loadout and customization with weapon and hunter exclusive skins, and more standout cosmetics. LOCKED & LOADED The game offers a diverse selection of weapons, each with unique attributes including damage, range, accuracy, and rate of fire, as well as different fire modes.  These weapons are classified into categories, find the best gun and its attachments to make the best firearm that suits your playstyle. IMMERSIVE MAP AND TIME FEATURES Battle across Dayton , a 2.1x2.23 km island featuring 18 unique locations , each with signature landmarks, vertical combat zones, and time-based environmental challenges. From industrial outposts to futuristic labs, every area has strategic depth and a story to uncover. The MetaDOS journey begins now. Play the Open Beta , test your survival instincts, and help shape the future of this time-bending battle royale.
row.short_description: MetaDOS is the next-gen battle royale game using the Time-as-currency concept. The players will fight on the island, loot the Time from their enemies and be the last man standing.

row.name: Elvera
row.detailed_description: Welcome into the realm of ELVERA, an Indie Third-Person PvP Action Game developed by a single developer. The game is completely free-to-play with no monetization, where player choice and strategy shape their experience. From the mind of one, for the community of many, ELVERA offers a rich, evolving world where two factions fight for dominance. Each match is a fresh challenge, shaped by the unique abilities of a diverse roster of heroes, several unique events that happen during rounds and your strategy choices. ELVERA stands out with its signature Twinbytes and Manifestation mechanic, inviting players to engage in a strategic dance of deception and unpredictability. Free to all, ELVERA provides a balanced battlefield where tactics, not transactions, lead to triumph. Join the Early Access on Steam, contribute to ELVERA's growth, and be part of our small, yet passionate community. Discord - Twitter - YouTube -
row.short_description: Welcome into the realm of ELVERA, an Indie Third-Person PvP Action Game passionately developed by a single developer.
row.notes: ELVERA is an Action RPG that includes combat scenarios and battles involving both melee and ranged weapons. While the game is not overly gory or violent, it does feature fantasy combat elements, such as the use of swords, staffs, and bows. There is no depiction of sexual content, explicit or otherwise, in the game. Nor does it contain elements of drug or alcohol abuse, self-harm, or any sensitive social themes. Players should expect to engage in fantasy violence but can rest assured that the game is designed with a broad audience in mind and does not delve into explicit or overly sensitive topics.

row.name: Twin Cores
row.detailed_description: Emergency calls echo throughout the C2 Terraforming station: a strange coral anomaly has caused a bug in the system, and the machines are not following orders anymore! Play as the Twin Cores , two mighty synchro-drones , and fight to eliminate the frenzied machines! FIGHT WITH A FRIEND! Twin Cores is COOP-ONLY , so grab a friend and play together either locally or online through Steam Remote Play Together! Together, brave heaps of diverse enemies and use your synchro-abilities to face any challenge coming your way! Compete for score with your friends locally or online through in-game online leaderboards ! FUSE TOGETHER! The pinnacle of Atmos Tech is the Twin Cores' ability to merge into a super-powered mega-drone! While in fusion-mode, players share controls : one pilots the drone, while the other controls its cannons. Coordinate with your friend to wreck masses of foes in mere seconds and avoid bullets and obstacles at the very last second! FLY THROUGH STRIKING LANDSCAPES! Above the clouds, under an alien sky, the terraformation motherbase prompts you to fight against your mechanical peers. Let yourself be taken on an adventure, with fully voiced / subtitled dialogues as well as an original soundtrack made up of a mix of synth glitch and orchestral elements! What are you waiting for? Twin Cores is FREE , so grab a friend and get ready to lose yourself in the frenzy of play!
row.short_description: Defend a Terraforming station against hordes of enemies in this short coop-only rail-shooter! A unique mix of nostalgic arcade elements and modern coop shooter gameplay. Triumph against your foes and compete for the top of the leaderboard!

row.name: UNILOGUE
row.detailed_description: This is a story of a faraway country. People lived in fear of demons. But now is the time for them to rise up! Let's explore all kinds of dungeons and fight for freedom and peace! 'UNILOGUE' is a game that combines tower defense and roguelike! Form the best party you can think of and go on endless adventures! Can you defeat the powerful enemies at the end of your adventure... What kind of game? Rogue-like adventures with a unique randomness. Create a party of your choice from more than 50 friends! Hard tower defense that cannot be recovered even after clearing a stage. Enemies are all full of character. Lots of items to choose from, from jewels to Excalibur! You can even fight dragons! Play time is 10 minutes to 1 hour per game.
row.short_description: Adventure with your unique friends and defeat powerful enemies! UNILOGUE is a new tower defense game with elements of a build-your-own roguelike. Form the best party you can think of and set out on a rugged adventure!

row.name: The Summon
row.detailed_description: This is an RPG where you can decide what kind of build you are going to make. Become a tank that focuses on damage mitigation, healing and reflecting damage back to your opponents or a glass cannon that focuses on high burst damage with massive lifesteal or a summoner focused on buffing up their summon and ranged damage. Key Features Progress through the game with your friends. Select a class and level up your character. Loot enchanted weapons and upgrade your armor. Farming! Clear dungeons for loot. Enchant your armor for specific builds with a lot of freedom (lifesteal, reflect, hp regen...) Micromanage the look on your character with 13 different armorpieces (left lower bracer, left upper bracer, left glove..) You can only play this with people on your Steam friends list. Invite or join them through the Steam overlay. This game is 100% free.
row.short_description: This is an RPG where you can decide what kind of build you are going to make. Become a tank that focuses on damage mitigation, healing and reflecting damage back to your opponents or a glass cannon that focuses on high burst damage with massive lifesteal.
row.notes: Includes melee and magical combat. The game is centered around combat. This game does not contains blood or gore.

row.name: Sakura Gym Girls: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Sakura Gym Girls: Prologue is a prequel to Sakura Gym Girls. This visual novel is about Kitagawa Shouhei, a university student, who lives in Tokyo with his girlfriend, the energetic and cheerful Sakizaki Ranko. Shouhei and Ranko are still in the early stages of their relationship, and they’re utterly in love. Everything seems to be going well between Shouhei and Ranko – until Ranko discovers, to her horror, that Shouhei’s doting ways have led her to packing on the pounds. In an attempt to keep fit, Ranko sweet-talks Shouhei into joining the local gym with her, so she can shed some of the weight she gained while eating all of Shouhei’s home-cooked meals. Join Shouhei and Ranko in this cute, light-hearted story, which serves as a prelude to a larger series, which will introduce even more cute girls for Shouhei to spend time with! Ranko is Shouhei’s girlfriend. She’s incredibly self-confident, and she was actually the one who proposed to Shouhei first. Ranko is as affectionate as a puppy, and she’s always giving Shouhei hugs and kisses, even in public, to Shouhei’s embarrassment. Having a girlfriend as devoted as Ranko is a bit of a handful, but Shouhei loves her a lot, and he’s certain they’ll always stay together. Why wouldn’t they, when they get along so well together?
row.short_description: A short and sweet prologue to a larger story. Shouhei has no particular interest in working out, but that changes when his bubbly girlfriend, Ranko, sweet-talks him into going to the local gym with her.
row.notes: Sakura Gym Girls: Prologue contains scenes that the audience might consider NSFW.

row.name: STARSHIP
row.detailed_description: [Game Features] ﹣Super high degree of freedom﹣ In the game, you can get rid of the shackles of the plane, move freely in the three-dimensional space, and cast skills in the full picture without dead ends. Give you a broad stage to give full play to your tactics. At the same time, you have three unique spaceships and thirteen different skills. Get money, parts and skill fragments in victory, create your own spaceship skill combination, and use your exclusive tactics to defeat your opponents! ﹣Strong strategic ﹣ In the game, you need to use your ingenuity, predict the opponent's actions, avoid the opponent's damage, allocate energy reasonably, and deploy skills to push the opponent into death step by step. You will love this game if you like to fight wits and brave people. With the advancement of space technology and the improvement of weapon lethality, the form of war in the distant future has undergone tremendous changes. It takes a few hours for spacecraft to cross the galaxy. The most powerful weapon can instantly destroy the planet, so the number of The advantage is weakening, and static defense becomes inefficient. How to hit the enemy and not be hit by the enemy has become the most important thing in the interstellar battlefield. This game is designed according to the concept of future space war. Hope You will like it. Welcome to the Star Warship, Commander. At present, the game has 13 skills and 3 different types of spaceships. Commanders can freely match the most powerful combination in their hearts in the base, fight with other commanders in arenas and ladders, win rich materials, and upgrade spaceships. And skills. Start your space journey.
row.short_description: In the game, you have different spaceships and 13 different skills. Gain money, parts, and skill pieces in victory and create your own ship skill set. In combat, anticipate your opponent's actions, avoid his damage, allocate energy properly, deploy skills, and push him to his death step by step.

row.name: Try Me
row.detailed_description: Try Me is a 3D Platform game where moving a ball to a floating square has never been more difficult. This game is completely torque based and all about momentum. This game offers multiple challenging levels with new mechanics the farther you get, as well as and endless mode to really test your skill.
row.short_description: Try Me is a 3D Platform game where moving a ball to a floating square has never been more difficult. This game is completely torque based and all about momentum.

row.name: Shining Jump Jump
row.detailed_description: Jump! Jump! Jump! Yggdra Resonanc (old Shining Maiden)'s cute girl jumping game~! - Use the left and right keys to go up the stairs, and if you climb a place other than the stairs, you will fall as it is! - There is no time to worry in front of a fork in the road, a fierce monster chasing you! - Every time you climb the stairs, you get various rewards and acquire beautiful girls! - Climb high and break the best record.
row.short_description: Yggdra Resonanc (old Shining Maiden)'s cute girl jumping game~!

row.name: Solitude Underwater
row.detailed_description: Solitude Underwater is a short horror-adventure game where you play as one of two treasure-hunting brothers who are searching for a long-lost ship filled with sunken treasure, but everything goes wrong… FEATURES Original Sound Track made by Rozmis B. Gergő In Depth Story created by Louis Badalament Voice Acting by the very talented Jake Johnston and Louis Badalament GAMEPLAY After a deceptively calm start aboard the boat with your brother, you’ll soon find yourself trapped in a shark cage at the bottom of the ocean.  A cage broken in such a way where the sharks can get in, but you can’t get out.  You will have to fend off the hungry sharks armed with nothing but the light from your phone… and did we mention its battery is almost dead?  As if that wasn’t bad enough, your oxygen tank is also broken; be very careful about when and how long you draw your next breath!  And if you somehow manage to find a way to escape the cage, other challenges still lie ahead!  Will you somehow manage to survive this deep-sea nightmare?
row.short_description: Solitude Underwater is a short horror adventure game. Two treasure-hunting brothers are searching for sunken riches off the coast of South Africa, only to find themselves immersed in catastrophe after one of them gets trapped in a cage, deep inside shark-infested waters.
row.reviews: “Solitude underwater takes an innovative approach to story telling with the use perfectly executed yet difficult gameplay mechanics (that will feel comfortably familiar to fans of games like FNAF) through a narrative that created an experience which kept me engaged and wanting more with every passing moment” 8/10 – Cameron Koblinski
row.notes: This game contains jumpscares, violence, some strong language and some animated bloodshed.

row.name: The Backroom - Lost and Found
row.detailed_description: The Backroom - Lost and Found tells the story of an orphaned room hidden away in the depths of a strange liminal space. As you embark on this adventure, you will encounter perplexing locations which defy the laws of physics, as well as meet some of the cute and horrifying inhabitants of this ... sector. Can you discover the truth, bring the lost together, and find your way out? FEATURES Coherent story divided into two available chapters. 19 different endings. Hand crafted levels and unique gameplay mechanics. Secrets, strangeness, weirdcore, and Achievements. Playtime approximately 2 hours. 'Horror-lite' - no jumpscares. Has a bit trypophobic content. No clipping.
row.short_description: The Backroom - Lost and Found is a story rich adventure game with some horror elements. Why is there an orphaned room hidden away in the depths of a strange liminal space? Is it 'the backrooms' or something else? CYOA? SCP? Weirdcore? No clipping? And what's with the cute paintings?

row.name: Wheels of Duty
row.detailed_description: After a terrorist-engineered virus crippled the world, humanity adapted the only way it could — on wheels. Now, survivors roll into battle in high-powered wheelchairs, armed to the teeth and ready to reclaim what’s left. Customize your rig, perfect your aim in the gun range, and prepare for fast-paced, tactical wheelchair warfare against players and bots across diverse maps and intense game modes. Game Modes: Team Deathmatch – Roll out with your squad and dominate the opposition. Free For All – Everyone’s your enemy. Be the last one rolling. Gun Game – Earn new weapons with every kill — no breaks, no mercy. Last Man Standing – One life. One shot at glory. Last Team Standing – Team up, no respawns. Win or get wiped out. Join our community, share your feedback, and help shape the future of Wheels of Duty
row.short_description: After a deadly virus left humanity paralyzed, survivors now battle on wheels! Customize your rig, sharpen your aim, and roll into fast-paced wheelchair warfare across multiple maps and modes. Join the fight!

row.name: Charlie and Friends
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the world of Charlie and Friends! Currently looking for a new caretaker for our beloved characters: Charlie the Cat, Hilda the Hyena, Sammy the Snake, and Rosy the Rabbit. Your job is to take care of our wonderful characters by feeding them, cleaning after them, fixing anything they broke, and uploading daily records of the characters. However, your job won't be that easy though since the characters like to wander around the building and they may interrupt you. Plus there seems to be something else happening in the background of the company you work for. Can you survive your work week and solve the mystery of what's happening?
row.short_description: Welcome to the world of Charlie and Friends! Currently looking for a new caretaker for our beloved characters: Charlie the Cat, Hilda the Hyena, Sammy the Snake, and Rosy the Rabbit.

row.name: StarMaker VR
row.detailed_description: StarMaker VR is a game designed using music and indicates players sing to play in the game. Listen to authorized music editions from Sony, Warner Bros., etc., and customize your character as you like! We hope that players can redefine themselves with the melodies! Features Sing Star With more than 2 million in the songs library, find the songs you love! Create a Karaoke room in SingStar, listen to music and other players' work, rate other players, sing in the different scenes, or even hold a concert in the virtual environment you created. Shooting Star Find the intensity of the music rhythm and choose either distance battle or melee to attack the digital demons, protect the music from being stolen and guard the music world. Taiko Star Use your drumsticks to beat the music note, concentrate more on the rhythm of the songs and experience the fun of drumming and get higher scores. Blade Star Slash the cubes according to the instructions. Following the directions and colors, shake your body with melodies, and release your soul. Start your music trip in StarMaker VR, and create a new music world. Enjoy yourself and release real soul by shaking your bodies with music rhythm in the game! Your Assistant Chat with your AI friend - Calliope, maybe there is a little surprise.
row.short_description: Start your music journey in StarMaker VR, sing to release the real you and dance with your souls in the melody of the music! You will enjoy what you have changed in this all new experience!

row.name: Asteroid
row.detailed_description: JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER About the Game A world without limits Asteroid is an open world action adventure RPG set in space. The universe is infinite and procedurally generated. Explore every corner of the galaxy to find treasures and precious resources, but also planets and enemies never seen before! Story mode - COMING WITH THE FULL VERSION The universe has changed: someone is trying to steal a mysterious power given by the gods to help a past civilization survive. Free the planets of hostilities and find out what is happening. During your journey, you may encounter many people willing to help you out, upgrade your ship and equipment, or even pay you to do some quests. Asteroid's story mode is in constant development and each planet presents its own narrative arc . With the addition of other planets , there will also be the introduction of a new chapter of the story mode. Updates and Seasons We plan to support the game with constant updates and Seasons , with new content to play, events and customizable ships! Seasons are major updates that introduce new planets and chapters of story mode , in addition to the content mentioned above! Fight fierce bosses in Black Hole Raids! Black Hole Raids are boss fights to be done alone or with friends* which confer valuable rewards such as Flact, Lunar Dust and Aquanium Gems . During the course of your exploration, you may come across a Black Hole - enter it to access a Black Hole Raid . Black Holes differ in shape, color and size : depending on these parameters, the difficulty and rewards can vary , so always keep an eye on them! *At launch it will only be possible to play alone. We are working to make the Alestore Online Play service for Asteroid active as soon as possible, but for the moment we expect its possible release during the course of 2023. Customization Being stylish is also important in the Z9 galaxy ! The Item Shop offers a variety of spaceships to purchase* to show off your gorgeous look, and if you are not satisfied with the proposed selection, don't worry: items change every day! *To purchase the items in the Item Shop, it is necessary to have Aquanium Gems, a currency that can be obtained by playing for free or through in-app purchases with microtransactions. In-app purchases will be available with the full version of the game. Events There will be new events with rewards every month , so always keep an eye on the Steam update page for Asteroid , the official Discord server and the Events section within the game! Online multiplayer - COMING IN 2023 (AFTER THE RELEASE OF THE FULL VERSION) We intend to make Asteroid an online experience by allowing users to have fun with friends by playing in the same game world and participating in events . The Alestore Online Play service is in development for Asteroid and we can't wait to release more information, so we recommend you follow the Steam updates page for Asteroid and the official Discord server . We expect the service to launch in 2023 . ...And more! Even more surprises await you in Asteroid, play and enjoy!
row.short_description: Asteroid is an open world action adventure RPG set in space! Explore the universe to save planets, upgrade your ship and equipment, and defeat increasingly fearsome enemies!

row.name: XBall
row.detailed_description: XBall is a PvP team sport game where players control the entire team at once, merging real-time tactics with a gritty, underground sports atmosphere. The game draws inspiration from basketball, football, and hockey, but it stands apart as a unique and abstract experience that defies direct comparison. XBall allows players to customize their matches by selecting different numbers of players and adjusting the game's time pace. Whether you're strategizing through slow, intricate tactics or diving into rapid, chaotic fun, XBall offers a dynamic and versatile gameplay experience that keeps each match fresh and unpredictable.
row.short_description: A real-time tactics PvP sports game with an underground vibe. Control every player on your team in fast-paced matches that blend basketball, football, and hockey. Customize the action with adjustable time pace and team sizes.

row.name: Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground
row.detailed_description: Demolish & Build 3 will include brand new demolition and driving physics. This short tech demo allows you to try them out before the final release. Some of the main features of Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground include: A large excavator equipped with demolition shears, Vehicle controls based on real excavators, Physics-based track mechanics, Full controller support, Fully destructible objects, A small test track, Ramps, Concrete structures that can be demolished, Third-person and first-person camera modes, And more…
row.short_description: Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground is a playable sneak peek at the driving and demolition physics from the upcoming Demolition & Build 3. In the game, you take control of a modern excavator and drive around a small test track or demolish structures.

row.name: Ashen Knights: One Passage
row.detailed_description: ADD THE FULL GAME TO YOUR WISHLIST Discord About the Game Ashen Knights: One Passage invites you to explore the beginning of Ashen Knights story. Two heroes, two different genres: souls-like & hack’n’slash. They switch places and trigger a wild emotional storm making sure you never get bored of playing. Two heroes, two different genres. TRY IT OUT! Ashen Knights is a unique mixture of two complementary gameplays. Tired of managing your stamina and scrupulously calculating your attacks? The game will grant you an opportunity to destroy foes in dozens with a single sweep of your weapon. Bored without a decent challenge? Try slaying an enemy ten times stronger than you are. More genres mean more emotions. FEEL THEM ALL! In Ashen Knights, the gameplay is but a way to share and express emotions. Playing as different characters, you'll feel how your battle drive gets replaced with crippling anxiety that slowly transforms into blinding rage. Every detail matters. DIVE IN! All of your emotions, every sound, every note, and every detail are a hidden message from the game world. And just as the world of Ashen Knights is a myriad of remote isles shattered by the Abyss, its narrative is a grim and mysterious puzzle made of numerous manifestations. Will you be able to piece it back together? A dark fantasy story. REVEAL IT! Every single phenomenon in the game—from the quietest of sounds to the biggest of bosses—is just a cover hiding the story of this world. So, what is the nature of the Abyss? What does it have to do with our heroes? And how does it bring them together? Every battle tells its part of the story. DEFEAT ENEMIES! The Abyss is not going to reveal its secrets for nothing. For every answer, one has to pay with numerous battles against its spawn: multiform mutants, insidious mimics, and mighty bosses. Every location is the same story told in a new way. EXPLORE THEM! The Abyss is not going to reveal all its secrets right away. On every level, it will expose itself in a new, previously unknown way. It will keep getting you back to the very beginning of the location. It will throw immortal enemies at you. It will stab you in the back with no chance to defend yourself. But no matter how dissimilar the distant corners of this world seem, they are all united by the narrative of collapse and the atmosphere of dark fantasy.
row.short_description: Ashen Knights: One Passage invites you to explore the beginning of Ashen Knights story. Two heroes, two different genres: souls-like & hack’n’slash. They switch places and trigger a wild emotional storm making sure you never get bored of playing.
row.notes: The world of Ashen Knights is a grim dark fantasy world, filled with cartoon death, violence, and endless fighting, both against the demonic Abyssal spawn and Abyss-infected humans.

row.name: GOR3
row.detailed_description: THIS GAME IS NOT RECOMMENDED FOR THOSE WITH EPILEPSY GOR3 is an abstract first-person shooter. You are an arcane warrior sent in to liberate a castle. Fight your way through multiple levels of chaos finding powerups and dealing with challenging enemies. GOR3 uses a permadeath system, you get one attempt per run.
row.short_description: A mysterious castle and a mysterious artifact.
row.notes: Pixelated depictions of gore and visceral urination simulation.

row.name: Defenders of Asteria
row.detailed_description: Defenders of Asteria will become free to play soon DEFEND THE KINGDOM Weakened by the Asterian War the kingdom scrambles to defend its key points, and its up to you to command the army to victory! Becoming a true Defender of Asteria takes courage and wit, will you survive the onslaught or fall to the hordes of enemies knocking at your door? DIFFERENT WAYS TO PLAY Take on quickplay if you want to find the perfect strategy and earn achievements. Then if you feel like a true strategist try your hand at the constantly scaling endless mode and survive as long as you can! With different heroes and perks to use there is lots of strategies to find. TAKE ON RAIDS A true war of attrition, take on raid maps to put your skills to the test. Each raid map has a unique boss to slay and an achievement to match. You are in for the long haul with this mode. KEY FEATURES Enlist 5 different heroes to help you cull the hordes on the battlefield 14 current maps to conquer Endless mode for endless fun Raid maps with unique bosses Unlock perks through playing to enhance your strength Free content updates
row.short_description: Asteria is under siege! Take up arms as the commander and find the perfect strategy in this hero filled tower defense game. Will you become a Defender of Asteria or fall short?

row.name: Glyph-Bound: Kotodama
row.detailed_description: Glyph-Bound is a monster-catching MMORPG inspired by Pokemon, Final Fantasy Tactics, and Old School Runescape . Our goal is to capture the wonder, exploration, and player choice that timeless classics are made of. TRACK, TRAIN, & TRADE elemental spirits called 'Kami'. Each Kami species has three growth stages and different aesthetic rarities ! THREE STARTING LOCATIONS from which to begin your journey and EXPLORE THE NON-LINEAR, OPEN WORLD region of the Akitsu Isles. TURN-BASED TACTICS influenced by Final Fantasy Tactics, Tactics Ogre, Into the Breach, Fire Emblem, and more! Increase your PVE REPUTATION AND PVP RANK TO UNLOCK COSMETIC OUTFITS ! Informed by Shinto religion and the concept of 'Kotodama', is a key pillar in Glyph-Bound lore . Bind Kami to elemental stones using the mystical words of power!
row.short_description: Track, train, and trade elemental spirits in Glyph-Bound! An indie MMORPG inspired by Pokemon Platinum, Final Fantasy Tactics, and Old School Runescape.

row.name: FPS Chess
row.detailed_description: Play an ordinary game of chess against a friend or a stranger. However, all your intricate strategies will crumble before the enemy rook's sniper trick-shot. All your practiced openings and counters will amount to nothing before the enemy queen's randomly sprayed machine gun. You finally checkmate the king. Unfortunately, it seems you are not ready for this fight. 5 seconds in and you've been sliced in half by the king's sword. It turns out you are not playing Chess at all, but an FPS. Just make sure to practice your aim! 6 unique piece toolkits with unique weapons and abilities. Online, LAN, and local split-screen 1v1 multiplayer matches. Invite a friend or join a lobby. A fun room to explore during every duel. Custom board editor to play with your favorite pieces. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Battle a friend in this fast paced 1v1 class-based first-person shooter. Chess takes a back-seat to FPS as you win duel after duel and capture the opponent's pieces until you've beaten their king and won the game.

row.name: PieceWars
row.detailed_description: Make full use of the unique skills of each piece to win! 'Piece Wars' is a chess-based board game. Here's how to play Piece Wars. ·Formation Arrange the pieces to build a formation. ·Shop Purchase pieces as needed. ·Battle In the current version, you can play against enemy AI through story mode. In the online battle mode scheduled to be released in the future. You can enjoy casual matche and ranked match.
row.short_description: 'Piece Wars' is a chess-based board game. Use the unique skills of each piece to win!

row.name: Bakso Simulator
row.detailed_description: Bakso is an Indonesian meatball. The word bakso may refer to a single meatball or the complete dish of meatball soup. Have you ever dreamed of having your own bakso restaurant? Dream no further, because now you can do it all with Bakso Simulator ! In this world, you will own your own bakso restaurant with your old friend Help the townsfolks by doing their quests and uncover all the secrets in town! Build your business! Upgrade your business! And Protect your business! Features: - Create your own bakso restaurant - Lots of characters to interact in the city - Follow the exciting story about the city - Done working? Go back home to sleep and don't forget to design your house according to your liking - Don't forget to pay your employees - Guard your bakso from flies, thieves and ghost - Explore the city! And most importantly, collect the money and make your bakso restaurant the best in the world!
row.short_description: Create the most successful bakso business in this world!

row.name: The Riflemen
row.detailed_description: The Riflemen is a fun, fast-paced low poly first-person shooter where matches are short and full of action! All players start with bolt-action rifles that they don’t need to reload. Players can customize their weapons and characters to get the look they want. PLAY LIKE YOU WANT The Riflemen offers a variety of game modes to suit your playstyle. Go head-to-head in a classic fight for elimination in Team Deathmatch . Work together with your squad to capture and hold objectives in Domination . Feeling resourceful? Scavenger throws you into a world with limited ammo, forcing you to adapt and utilize dropped ammunition from fallen enemies and allies to survive. For a truly tactical challenge, dive into Secure & Survive , a round-based battle where securing valuable cargo or eliminating the opposing team is your objective. You can disable the supply drops in Barebones to get only bolt-action rifle action or make it even more competitive with the Hardcore type where every hit will be an insta-kill! GUNPLAY The Riflemen is a battle of skills and a true trial of friendships. Aim, shoot, reload, and repeat — no automatic weapons, only tough-ass action. Headshots make your opponents go sleepy-time at once and supply drops might bring you a shotgun, a sniper rifle, a bazooka, frag grenades, rapid fire pistol, mines or even a gunto sword! Whew, now that's a lot of fire power! All players start with bolt-action rifles & knives Headshots kill with one shot No manual reloading is needed CUSTOMIZATION The Riflemen isn't just about raw skill – it's about expressing yourself on the battlefield. As you progress through over 100 levels, you'll unlock a variety of character and weapon skins, allowing you to create a soldier that's uniquely yours. Don't stop there! Personalize your arsenal with a variety of wood and metal finishes, crafting a weapon that reflects your playstyle. With the DLC you'll be able to unlock 3 times more cosmetics! Become a legend who walks the line between lethality and sheer style. In The Riflemen, the battlefield is your canvas, and the bolt-action rifle your brush. Every shot a stroke, every kill a masterpiece.
row.short_description: Multiplayer first-person shooter with classic WW2 bolt-action rifles. Tight battles between two teams with up to 5 players in each, lots of unique arenas, game-changing weapon drops, different game modes, and lots of customization options. You'd better not miss a shot!

row.name: The Backroom - Lost and Found Playtest
Heal & Hurt
row.detailed_description: Heal & Hurt is a fast-paced old school arena shooter where you switch sides from angel to skeleton and vice versa every time you die! Both characters have unique abilities that you can use to outclass your opponents. You should also pay attention to damage types as you can either heal or hurt your enemies (and yourself!) There two different gamemodes to choose from.'Deathmatch' is the normal mode where you must eliminate your opponents in order to win! The other mode is called 'Hold the Crown' where you and the others will compete for the crown that will give you score. When playing as an angel, you can fly through the skies and take out your opponents from high ground! You should also notice that when diving underwater you will eventually drown if you don't remember to get some fresh air. As a skeleton you can take advantage and slide to avoid enemies firing. Skeletons are also keen in diving as they won't drown underwater, they can also pass through the bony walls found in the maps. When playing as either of the characters the visuals of the surrounding world will change. Both characters can also use teleports to get fast from location to another! Features Switch sides when you die from an angel to skeleton and vice versa Heal or hurt your enemies (and yourself!) 6 different weapons 2 gamemodes Rocket jumping Teleports Flying Sliding
row.short_description: Fight as an angel or a skeleton in this fast-paced free for all multiplayer arena shooter! Pay attention to gunfights as you can either heal or hurt your opponents!

row.name: Free Multiplayer session - June 8 - 7pm GMT / 3pm ET
NIRAVASI
row.detailed_description: Story In ages past, there existed a city unlike any other. From the strength and unity of humanity, Niravasi was born. But when a brutal war ravaged the world itself, Niravasi became lost to the depths of space. Some say its people remain unharmed, while others speak of dark horrors residing in its streets. In the end, these are just stories. But Niravasi is real. About NIRAVASI is a Dark Adventure game, set within the ruins of an ancient human city. You play as Mura , a feline archaeologist that finds himself trapped within the titular lost city of ruin after being split off from the rest of his team. Armed with only a flashlight, and a mysterious ally guiding him through the city with his handheld radio, Mura must now navigate the dark streets of Niravasi to find his missing team and make his way out of derelict cityscape. But Mura is not the only one living within Niravasi . Guarding it is the Artificial Ecological Overseer Network (A.E.O.N) , an artificial intelligence built to protect and perfect humanity. Together with its robotic proxies, A.E.O.N will do everything in its power to remove anyone who arrives in the city uninvited. Among these machines is a particularly devastating one known only as The Harvester , which will continually track and hunt Mura down until either the latter escapes or is killed. In order survive, you’ll need both your skills and wits to help keep Mura alive long enough to find a way to escape Niravasi . Built using the RPG Maker MV engine (and the MV3D plugin), NIRAVASI will take you through a world filled with both wonders and horrors. Whether you wish simply to leave the city or explore its most darkest secrets, the throne of humanity offers many riches to those willing to take the leap. After all, there is always protection in perfection . Explore a lost city! Niravasi may be infested by robots, but its streets are filled with many wonders to behold. From the dilapidated ruins of the ancient Stepwell of Dhara Hanirr , to the sunken streets of the Aruvi District , NIRAVASI offers players a variety of amazing levels to explore. Excavate the secrets within! While the humans that lived here are long gone, the stories they had still remain. Venture through the darkest depths of the city, and uncover the sinister secrets that shed some light on the lives of the people who lived here, as well as how the city came to fall in the first place. Evade an army of machines! In humanity's absence, A.E.O.N (the artificial intelligence that watches over the city) has filled the city with a large army of robotic proxies, which must be avoided at all costs. Use your skills and wits as an archaeologist to sneak past them and avoid detection at all cost. Escape the Harvester! If you've been detected by A.E.O.N , the Harvester will not be far behind. Hastily make your way to safety before the timer runs out, or else the Harvester will live out its namesake. Expect anything! Niravasi is an alien world to an alien cat, as well as a city that's been derelict for centuries. You'll have to open your mind to all possibilities if you want to escape the lost city unharmed. Enjoy its surreal visuals! NIRAVASI sports a very distinct art-style, blending pixel art styles with iconography found within corporate organisations, and the ancient civilisations of old. Go out there and see what you can find! Endure the truth of your heart! You get to play as a cat! What's not to love about that?!
row.short_description: Escape and explore the ruins of a once-great city, while being hunted by the machine that watches over it. Remember, there is always protection in perfection.
row.notes: This game may contain themes and moments that may cause some discomfort for players.

row.name: FLASHOUT 3D: Enhanced Edition
row.detailed_description: The classical AG racer, FLASHOUT 3D, initially released more than 10 years ago, is back, to celebrate the upcoming launch of FLASHOUT 3 ! But we bring you not only the first installement of the series for FREE, but we have also remastered it and enhanced with upgraded graphics and new features! Check out the details in the description and don't forget to wishlist FLASHOUT 3 now! Get into one of your ultra fast ships and join the competition! Use rockets and guns to fight your way to victory in all events and become the best racer in the whole galaxy! Dominate the grid, master your skills, upgrade your ships, listen to the great tunes, unlock all circuits and get hooked by the fun and exhilarating racing experience! Features and highlights of the Enhanced Edition: 100% FREE! Upgraded graphics; Ship physics improved; Gamepad support; Vibrations support added; Improved controls; Remastered intro; Additional animations; Improved visual effects; New UI during races; And more!
row.short_description: The classical AG racer, FLASHOUT 3D, initially released more than 10 years ago, is back, to celebrate the upcoming launch of FLASHOUT 3! But we bring you not only the first installement of the series for FREE, but we have also remastered it and enhanced with upgraded graphics and new features!

row.name: Mine Seeker
row.detailed_description: In Mine Seeker you are able to play a well known game in a new 3 dimensional way! Customize the Map size, choose between different locations to play in and set the difficulty by adjusting the amount of mines on the board. Be fast though because you have a maximum of 60 minutes to clear all tiles that aren´t mines.
row.short_description: Mine Seeker is a strategic game where the player has to click tiles in order to find mines hidden under some of them. It might seem familiar to many people... If you like to play calming games with peaceful atmosphere you should give it a try!

row.name: Monster Showdown: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Monster Showdown: Prologue includes the first 3 out of 10 maps of this action packed VR Shooter. WEAPONS: Buy your favorite weapons from a choice of over 60 from a dispenser at the wall or try your luck at the enigmatic box for a chance to get a really powerful gun. You can also attack enemies with melee weapons by swinging your VR controller. The more skillful your swings are the more damage your attacks will deal. UPGRADES: Collect currency by taking down monsters or fixing barriers and spend these on upgrading your weapons or acquiring Perk Donuts from a vending machine. MONSTER AND STAGE VARIETY: Explore environments from different points in space and time for a varied experience. Many stages come with unique monsters and boss monster for you to take down. There is a mix between quick challenge oriented stages and wider stages that invite exploration. MODIFIERS: Unlock different modifiers by completing certain objectives. These will allow you to spice up the game by randomizing perk and weapon placement or just adding fun things like big head mode.
row.short_description: Monster Showdown: Prologue is the first 3 maps of an action packed VR shooter. Increase your chances of survival against an ever growing horde of monster by exploring your environment and strengthening yourself by picking up Perks, Ranged Weapons and Melee Weapons.

row.name: Hermea
row.detailed_description: Race against the clock to deliver the gods' mail on time! Hermea is a third person speedrunner where you play as Hermea, an intern at Hermes' Delivery Service, who transports mail to Greek gods by traversing perilous environments on foot and using a variety of interchangeable abilities. The gods will throw everything they can at you to try and stop you, but with some encouraging words from Hermes, you can totally take them on! Features: 6 action packed levels and 1 tutorial level 6 unlockable abilities such as Artemis' Bow Grappling Hook and Zeus' Favor Teleport 3 different environments inspired by Greek Mythology Online leaderboards Twitch integration to allow chat to vote on silly modifiers Multiple 'Curses' or difficulty modifiers for added gameplay and to test yourself A number of accessibility options so every gamer can play Controller Support
row.short_description: Hermea is an intern at Hermes' Delivery Service who transports mail by traversing perilous environments on foot and using a variety of abilities. Control Hermea to race against the clock and deliver timely as a faster time will reward a better score in this third person speedrunning platformer!

row.name: Deck of Life: No Turns, Individual Card Permadeath
row.detailed_description: Unblocked Enemy Attacks Permanently Remove Cards From Your Deck Enemy attacks destroy cards from your deck and they are not available in the next encounter. Protect your Cards while Destroying your Opponent's Hand Play cards on your side of the field to launch projectiles or construct defenses. Draw new cards from your deck automatically at an upgradable rate. Survive Each Run The cards in your hand are always physically on the field and can be attacked at any time with projectiles. You defeat the enemy if you destroy all the enemy's cards on the field. Your run ends if all your cards on the field are destroyed. Choose Cards to Reinforce your Deck's Strategy As you clear enemies and events your deck gains cards unique to the floor. Each floor has a unique pool of cards that work well together. Choose a Path to Control your Deck's Evolution Each level you have a choice of 2 floors with a unique card pool. You always have the option to continue acquiring cards of the same type or to branch off into a different random card type. As you clear levels the random floors increase in difficulty. Unlock New Starting Decks Every floor you defeat you gain a new deck that you can start a run with. This new deck has cards specific to the floor's unique cards.
row.short_description: A card battler where cards are your health. No turns, individual card permadeath. Construct defenses while launching projectiles to destroy your opponent's cards. Beat enemies and events to win cards from unique card pools. If all your cards on the field are destroyed, you die.

row.name: Light Maze
row.detailed_description: Gameplay: You will be controlling a cube around multiple levels with varying degrees of difficulty. As you navigate, the tile underneath you will light up and stay lit until you complete the level. Features: Simple controls. Move up, down, left, or right. As a tile lights up, the level gradually illuminates. 100 different levels. Varying levels of difficulty. Save system. Delete it too if you want. Controls: WASD IJKL 8456 or 8426 on the Numpad Arrow Keys This list of controls is accessible in the game. Other Keybinds: P or Escape Key to pause the game. R key to restart the level. Bugs, Issues, Feedback, Suggestions, etc: Whatever it is, please feel free go to the Community Hub Discussion section for this game and ask away.
